izzyondroid:com.akslabs.cloudgallery.name: Chitralaya CloudGallery App
izzyondroid:com.akslabs.cloudgallery.summary: Transform Telegram into your personal, unlimited photo cloud storage.
izzyondroid:com.akslabs.cloudgallery.description:
Never Lose a Precious Memory Again!
 Chitralaya CloudGallery (चित्रालय - "House of Images" in Sanskrit) is your personal photo fortress that transforms Telegram into unlimited, truly private cloud storage! Say goodbye to the anxiety of losing precious memories and hello to unlimited backup freedom.
 🌟 Chitralaya CloudGallery is a simple open-source Android app that turns your Telegram account into a private photo cloud storage — no signup, no servers, no tracking.
 Your photos go straight from your phone to your own Telegram chat, giving you free, practically unlimited backup space with full control over your data.
 It’s not a company or a service — just a open-source tool made by a privacy-minded developer who believes your memories should stay yours.
 I’m just another user like you, tired of the usual “cloud storage deal” — free at first, then you pay with your money... or even worse, with your privacy.
 So I built something different — Chitralaya CloudGallery. It’s not a company, not a service. Just a simple, open-source tool — a bridge between your Android phone and your Telegram account.
 🤔 Why even build this? I was using Google Photos like everyone else. Free storage, nice features, AI magic… but then I realized:
 Google scans my photos to “offer me memories” → which also means they read them. Google uses user data to personalize services, show relevant ads, improve products,services. We users don’t even know or read what other privacy-concerning terms we’ve agreed to at the time of sign-up. And will they only use data collected from Google Photos to improve Google Photos — or does it include all Google products? Sharing a link doesn’t mean it’s private — anyone with that link can see your photos. Needs to compress images when free storage is full. One day, “free storage is full” and they said: “Pay up for more storage.” Google, builds entire business models around data.
 That’s when it hit me: my photos aren’t mine. I wanted something unlimited, private, and mine. And then I looked at Telegram.
 But wait… Why Telegram? Can’t Telegram see my photos?
 Here’s my honest take: Telegram encrypts your data in transit, but not end-to-end (like Signal). So if they really wanted to, they could peek. But let’s be honest — so can Google, iCloud, OneDrive, or any cloud you don’t run yourself. The only way to have absolute control? Run your own server. But not everyone can afford or maintain that.
 Still, it’s your call. I’m not here to sell you Telegram. I’m just here to hand you the option.
 🛡️ Transparency First I don’t want you to blindly trust me either. Here’s how CloudGallery works:
 Your bot token & chat ID are stored securely in Android keystore (AES encryption). Your photos go directly to your Telegram account — no middle servers. I don’t track you, I don’t log you, I don’t even know who uses this app. The app is open source. You can read the code yourself. Now, let me be fully transparent about limitations too:
 Bot API has quirks → it can’t read your old messages without chat IDs. That means if you reinstall the app fresh, you won’t automatically see your past uploads. To fix that, CloudGallery keeps a local JSON database of synced images. This JSON file is also backed up to your Telegram so you can re-import it on another phone. But warning ⚠️: This database is plain text (readable JSON), not encrypted. If you leak it, others can read metadata. Keep it safe. That’s your responsibility.
 ⚠️ Important: The database only stores metadata and image IDs — it does not contain the actual images.
 Can someone access your images with just the IDs? No, they would also need your bot token and chat ID.
 I’m being this honest because I believe trust starts with showing both the strengths and the flaws.

fdroid:com.landerlab.lplanner.fdroid.name: Lplanner
fdroid:com.landerlab.lplanner.fdroid.summary: Mixed-gas decompression planner: ZHL-16C, VVAL-79 and VPM-B. Works offline.
fdroid:com.landerlab.lplanner.fdroid.description:
Lplanner is a decompression planner for trained mixed-gas divers. It plans
open-circuit and closed-circuit dives on air, nitrox, trimix and heliox, with
three decompression models to choose between.
THIS SOFTWARE CAN KILL YOU. It is experimental and certainly contains bugs.
Never dive a schedule from it without verifying that schedule against tables
or software you trust, and never use it without formal mixed-gas
decompression training.
MODELS
* ZHL-16C — the Buhlmann set, with gradient factors or a conservatism
 percentage, and optional Pyle deep stops.
* VVAL-79 — the U.S. Navy Thalmann EL-DCM, exponential uptake and linear
 elimination, with the published nine-compartment air parameter set. Air,
 nitrox and oxygen only: the Navy publishes no helium parameters for this
 model, so a dive carrying helium is refused rather than computed against
 numbers that do not exist. Use VPM-B or ZHL-16C for trimix.
* VPM-B — the Varying Permeability Model of Yount and Hoffman, in Erik Baker's
 implementation, with conservatism 0 to 4. Checked against Baker's own
 published output on his 80 msw trimix benchmark: 13 of the 18 stop times
 match exactly, with the first stop one 3 m increment deeper and four minutes
 more total stop time, for the reasons set out in the manual.
All three share one decompression engine, written in C, which is the same
engine the macOS and iOS builds use. Identical input gives an identical
schedule on every platform.
WHAT IT DOES
* Multi-level dives, open or closed circuit, with setpoints and Scamahorn
 slide.
* Automatic deco gas selection by maximum PO2 and maximum END.
* Repetitive dives: carries your tissue loading forward, ages it against the
 real clock while the app is closed, and requires you to state a surface
 interval before it will plan again.
* CNS percentage and OTU tracking, gas consumption per mix, time to fly.
* Gas density warning following Anthony and Mitchell.
* Configurable stop grid, last stop depth, ascent and descent rate bands, and
 extended stops on a gas switch.
* Plan log, share, and print.
PRIVACY
The app declares no Android permissions at all, including no internet
permission. It cannot transmit anything, and there is no analytics,
advertising or tracking of any kind. Your dive, your settings and your saved
plans stay in the app's private storage on the device.
Free software under the GNU General Public License v3.

fdroid:com.meteocompare.app.name: MeteoCompare
fdroid:com.meteocompare.app.summary: Compare 21 weather models, 10-day forecasts, local alerts and detailed charts.
fdroid:com.meteocompare.app.description:
MeteoCompare is a free, open-source and ad-free weather app that compares multiple models instead of hiding uncertainty behind a single forecast.
21 MODELS · UP TO 10 DAYS
Compare 21 reference models: AROME and ARPEGE (Météo-France), ICON and ICON-D2 (DWD), GFS, HRRR and the new NOAA AIGFS, ECMWF IFS and AIFS, UKMO, GEM, the new JMA GSM, MET Nordic, KNMI/DMI HARMONIE, MeteoSwiss ICON-CH2, ACCESS and GRAPES.
Daily views now cover 10 days. Shorter-range models are shown only while their own data is available: MeteoCompare never invents or extends model output.
CHART VIEW AND VISUALS
The new Chart View lets you explore up to 10 days hour by hour on a 240-hour timeline. You also get:
- Today summary and hourly timeline;
- min/max spread bands and model agreement levels;
- model-by-model tables;
- forecast evolution around 24 / 48 / 72 hours and the “Key takeaway” section;
- local model ranking;
- resizable home-screen widgets.
LOCAL WEATHER NOTIFICATIONS
Notifications are optional and off by default. For selected favorite cities, MeteoCompare can show:
- a daily summary at the time you choose;
- an alert when models diverge strongly;
- a “Forecast revision” when the Key takeaway signal detects a meaningful temperature, rain or wind change.
Everything is computed on-device with WorkManager, with no push server. Events are deduplicated to avoid unnecessary repeated notifications.
TABLETS, FOLDABLES AND LARGE SCREENS
On wide windows, MeteoCompare switches to a master/detail layout so the city list and forecast can remain visible side by side. The interface adapts to tablets, large foldables and resizable Android windows while keeping the compact phone layout.
4 V3 FORECAST ENGINES
Choose how the central forecast is calculated: Multi-consensus, Local calibration, Scenarios or Adaptive. A dedicated Engine Comparison page runs all four strategies on the same raw data so their differences stay visible.
UNDERSTAND UNCERTAINTY
MeteoCompare keeps current model convergence separate from local historical reliability. Related models share voting weight so variants from the same numerical lineage cannot artificially increase confidence. Forecast evolution also shows how a forecast changed roughly 24, 48 and 72 hours ago.
SEA / COAST AND WARNINGS
For compatible coastal cities: waves, swell, sea temperature and estimated tides. For cities in France, MeteoCompare also relays official Météo-France vigilance information. Marine information is indicative only and is not intended for navigation.
SUPPORT METEOCOMPARE
MeteoCompare is developed without ads, subscriptions or premium features. If the app is useful to you, you can support development through Liberapay, GitHub Sponsors or Ko-Fi. Donations are optional and unlock no privileges: everyone gets the same app.
PRIVACY
No account, no ads and no analytics SDK. Favorites, preferences, caches and history remain on the device. Weather and geocoding data are mainly provided by Open-Meteo.
MeteoCompare is free and open-source software licensed under Apache-2.0.

fdroid:de.saschahlusiak.freebloks.name: Freebloks
fdroid:de.saschahlusiak.freebloks.summary: Strategy board game similar to the famous board game Blokus
fdroid:de.saschahlusiak.freebloks.description:
This is the Android version of Freebloks 3D, an implementation of the famous board game Blokus. Try to place as many tiles on the board as possible, keeping in mind only two simple rules: your tiles must touch a corner of one of your previously placed tiles, but they must not share an edge. Can you play more tiles than your opponents? 
RULES
Each player has 21 Tetris-like tiles: 12 tiles with 5 squares, 5 tiles with 4 squares, 2 tiles with 3 squares, 1 tile with 2 squares and 1 tile with 1 square. 
Players take turns in placing one tile onto the 20x20 board. The first tile for each player has to be placed in their corner of the board. Each following tile has to touch a corner of one of your previous tiles, but it must never share an edge. It may share edges with the opponents' tiles though. 
If a player has no more possible move, they have to pass. The game is over when no player can place a tile. 
For each player, the squares of all their tiles on the board are added up. The player with the most points wins. 
HOW TO PLAY
- Swipe the list of available tiles with your finger. 
- Select and drag a tile onto the board. 
- Rotate or flip the tile using the 4 handles. 
- Place the tile in the desired position. The tile will appear green if the position is valid, and red otherwise. Possible corners are highlighted on the board for convenience. 
- Tap the tile in a valid position to place it. 
- You can rotate the board at any time to see the opponents' tiles. 
Quit the app at any time, your current game will be saved and restored on next start. 
FEATURES
- Supports 2-player modes, with 2 colors (Original, Blokus Duo and Blokus Junior), 4 colors (2 each),
- Customizable board sizes other than 20x20,
- Play against the computer or humans on the same device,
- Play online against your friends,
- Play with friends via Bluetooth,
- Hint and undo options,
- Looks great on tablets, too!
The game is network-compatible with Freebloks 3D for Windows and Linux: http://www.saschahlusiak.de/freebloks-3d/

fdroid:fr.ralala.hexviewer.name: HexViewer
fdroid:fr.ralala.hexviewer.description:
This application offers the following features :
* Opening all files without a corresponding Android application.
 * At first, the file can only be saved via "save as" and due to Android permissions reasons, the only way to make it appear in the list of recent files is to reopen it.
* Display of the file in hexadecimal (or plain text) with the possibility to modify the content (in hexadecimal only).
* Saving the file on the smartphone/tablet.
 * Due to file permissions, after a "save as", the list of recent files cannot be updated with the new file location.
* Search option in the open file (hexadecimal and plain text modes).
* Optional entropy highlighting in the hexadecimal view to spot random-looking data.
 * Lines are colored according to the Shannon entropy computed over fixed 256-byte blocks of the whole file (random-looking data such as keys, hashes, encrypted or compressed content scores high).
 * The color and the sensitivity can be changed in the settings, the feature is disabled by default.*
(1) At first, the file can only be saved via "save as" and due to Android permissions reasons, the only way to make it appear in the list of recent files is to reopen it.
(2) Due to file permissions, after a "save as", the list of recent files cannot be updated with the new file location.
Caution: Opening files that are too large seriously degrades application performance and can suddenly stop the application on low-resource devices.
**WARNING:** This application cannot open files larger than ~20 MB on recent smartphones and less for older smartphones.
**WARNING:** Searching within the plain text view may become excessively slow when handling large files.
**NOTE:** As the entropy is computed per 256-byte block, the highlighting detects regions of random-looking data, not short isolated values such as a 32-byte key. It cannot tell encrypted data from compressed data either. It is only available in the hexadecimal view.

fdroid:life.andre.message487.name: Message487
fdroid:life.andre.message487.summary: Forward Android notifications, images and SMS to n8n or your webhook
fdroid:life.andre.message487.description:
Message487 connects selected Android notifications and new incoming SMS to your n8n workflows or another HTTPS webhook. Forward notification text and images, automate actions, or route messages to Telegram through your own workflow.
WHAT YOU CAN FORWARD
• Notifications from apps you select, including available titles, text and image attachments.
• Optional sender avatars and source app icons. Choose JPEG or PNG, image quality and size limits.
• New incoming SMS with text, sender and time. SMS forwarding is enabled separately and does not need notification access.
GET STARTED
1. Prepare a published n8n webhook workflow or another HTTPS endpoint with Bearer-token authentication.
2. In Connection, save the full webhook URL, token and your device code. Send a test event and check Journal and your receiver.
3. In Sources, enable notification forwarding, grant Android notification access and select apps. You can select all visible launcher apps, add a package manually, or opt into selecting newly detected launcher apps automatically.
4. If you also want SMS, enable Incoming SMS and grant the receive-SMS permission.
You supply the receiver and token. Message487 does not include a hosted inbox or an n8n subscription. A custom webhook does not require an n8n account. Telegram forwarding is configured in your workflow; the Android app does not depend on Telegram. Images are sent in the JSON event and need processing in the receiving workflow.
DELIVERY AND CONTROL
• Save events in a private local outbox before sending and retry temporary delivery failures in the background.
• Filter duplicate SMS and notifications independently, with a configurable time window.
• Pause capture and queued delivery, check delivery status, and manually retry or delete events in Journal.
• Identify your phone using a custom device code. Retries preserve the event ID so your receiver can deduplicate requests.
• Use English or Russian interfaces and light or dark themes.
• Check capture permissions, listener connectivity, network and delivery failures in one place.
• Preview test events or current notifications and images without sending them.
• Import and export settings. The unencrypted export includes the token by default, with a visible switch to exclude it.
• View local diagnostics and optionally share a report by email.
Journal shows delivery metadata, not message contents or image previews. Webhook acceptance does not prove delivery to Telegram or another downstream service. Android battery and network restrictions can delay delivery, and lost responses can cause duplicate requests.
PERMISSIONS AND PRIVACY
Notification and SMS capture are off by default, with no apps selected. Each source needs its corresponding Android access or permission. Only new events are captured; existing notifications and SMS history are not imported. Message487 does not send SMS or reply to notifications. Android may hide sensitive notification content; only content exposed by the system can be forwarded.
Queued message text and request credentials are encrypted on the device. Images are kept as private internal files without additional app-level encryption. Your endpoint and downstream services receive forwarded contents and apply their own retention policies. The app has no advertising, analytics or automatic crash uploads.

fdroid:tech.xvanturing.freeproxy.name: FreeProxy
fdroid:tech.xvanturing.freeproxy.summary: Route your traffic through a SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy, per app.
fdroid:tech.xvanturing.freeproxy.description:
FreeProxy turns any SOCKS5 or HTTP CONNECT proxy into a system-wide VPN on Android.
Traffic from every app — or only the apps you pick — is captured by VpnService as raw IP packets, reassembled into TCP/UDP sessions in userspace, and forwarded through your upstream proxy. Apps with no proxy support of their own end up going through it anyway.
There is no NDK code and no bundled tun2socks binary: the TCP/IP stack is written in plain Kotlin.
Features
* Multiple SOCKS5 / HTTP CONNECT profiles, with optional username and password auth
* Connectivity test that performs a real handshake before you save a profile
* Per-app routing: all apps, an allow list, or a bypass list
* Live activity log — DNS lookups and every connection, colour-coded, showing the app that opened it and the resolved hostname instead of a bare IP
* Per-profile DNS mode: resolve through the proxy (private) or directly (fast)
* Persistent notification with live upload/download counters and a one-tap disconnect
* Bypass private networks, block IPv6 leaks, stop automatically when the network drops, start on boot
* Material 3 interface with dynamic colour, light and dark themes, and a tablet layout
* English and Simplified Chinese
Known limits
IPv4 only. ICMP cannot be carried by proxy protocols, so ping inside the tunnel will not work. UDP forwarding needs a SOCKS5 proxy that supports UDP ASSOCIATE — without it, DNS falls back to DNS-over-TCP and other UDP traffic is dropped. Proxy credentials are stored unencrypted in the app's private directory (excluded from cloud backup). Per-app attribution in the log requires Android 10 or newer.
FreeProxy does not provide any proxy servers. You bring your own.

 You can find exhibits on millions of topics, from the Architecture of Liverpool to Zoroastrianism. Search for the topic you want to learn about, or just wander from topic to topic as your curiosity dictates!
 How does it work? The breadth of the museum is made possible by downloading text and images from Wikipedia and Wikimedia Commons. Every exhibit in the museum corresponds to a Wikipedia article. The walls of the exhibit are covered in images and text from the article, and hallways lead out to other exhibits based on the article's links.
 The museum is greatly inspired by educational videos that I watched as a kid, and the liminal spaces produced by early CGI. I want to recapture the promise that the internet can be a place of endless learning and exploration. I hope you enjoy your time exploring the Museum of All Things!

The dd_rescue does however not abort on errors in the input file. This makes it suitable for rescuing data from media with errors, e.g. a disk with bad sectors. This package includes dd_rhelp wrapper script facilitating data recovery. It is trying to make it so simple to recover as: dd_rhelp source target Please note Fedora ships also GNU ddrescue, which probably gives faster and more reliable results rescuing whole disks. But still there might be some niche pattern of bad sectors, which might get better covered by dd_rescue and both tools might be used with sub-sequent runs cooperatively on the same disk image.

firefox-addons:2647441.name: YouTube™ Productivity Mode
firefox-addons:2647441.description:
This product is inspired from Indistractable by Nir Eyal. According to the book, one source of distraction are the external triggers that lead us to distracting activities and thus leave less time for things that we actually intend to do.
YouTube is one such place for me on the internet where I often wander and get lost from the focus track that I plan to be on. No doubt YouTube is a great place to learn but it does have a lot of distracting content too. 
Taking cue from the book, we created YouTube Productivity Mode, with an objective to reduce the triggers. Switch YPM in “Productivity Mode” to blur all the thumbnails on YouTube so that the catchy and clickbaity thumbnails don’t grab your attention. So now if you get redirected to YouTube while working/studying, the recommended thumbnails won’t catch your eyes and you will hopefully switch back to your task again without losing your focus.
By default, YPM works on “Leisure Mode” where you’ll get the same experience of YouTube without annoying ads.
We are indie makers who believe that focus is a superpower. If this app helps you in any way, please help us too. There are a lot of ways you could help us:
- Share this extension with your friends.
- Write a review and tell us what other problems can we solve for you.
- Contribute financially via BuyMeACoffee - https://www.buymeacoffee.com/webtaculars?ref=chrome-web-store

firefox-addons:2675150.name: SVG Screenshot
firefox-addons:2675150.summary: Take scalable, semantic, accessible screenshots, in SVG format.
firefox-addons:2675150.description:
SVG screenshots offer various benefits over normal PNG screenshots, while keeping the good parts:
 🖼 Flexible : Freely select the region of the website you want to capture or capture the whole page.
 💢 Scalable graphics : Screenshots never get pixelated when zooming in.
 📝 Semantic : Text can still be selected and copied to clipboard.
 🦻 Accessible : SVG is annotated with ARIA attributes and can be read by screen readers.
 🖥 Paste into design tools : SVGs will work in design tools like Illustrator, Figma, Sketch etc.
 🔗 Interactive : Links are still clickable.
 📦 Self-contained : Inlines external resources like images, fonts, etc.
 📸 Static : Styles and layout are recorded at the time of snapshot and will not change.
 🗜 Small : Depending on the content, SVGs can be magnitudes smaller than PNGs and compress loslessly.
 🛡 Secure : The SVG will not run any JavaScript.

bluejetty:00157527:ios.summary: Fidgeting, reimagined. Fidgetable is a beautiful haptic app designed to help you focus, relax, and find joy in tactile digital interactions. Built seamlessly for iOS, it combines elegant design with shockingly deep customization to give you
bluejetty:00157527:ios.description:
Fidgeting, reimagined. Fidgetable is a beautiful haptic app designed to help you focus, relax, and find joy in tactile digital interactions. Built seamlessly for iOS, it combines elegant design with shockingly deep customization to give you a sensory experience that feels amazing right out of the box, and can be tailored entirely to you.
Whether you need a simple distraction while working or a deeply customizable sensory tool, Fidgetable delivers satisfying haptics right to your fingertips. And the best part? There are absolutely no ads. Ever.
SIMPLE & SATISFYING CORE FEATURES
- 11+ Unique Haptic Fidgets: Tap, swipe, hold, shake, or tilt your device. Discover deeply satisfying interactions inspired by everyday life, including Bubble Wrap, Snap, Bounce, Buttons, and more.
- Feel Every Interaction: Powered by deep integration with your iPhone's advanced haptic engine, every click, pop, and slide is meticulously tuned to feel incredibly realistic.
- Works Out of the Box: Open the app and start fidgeting immediately with a beautifully intuitive interface.
ENDLESS CUSTOMIZATION
- Make It Your Own: Adjust the size, color, animations, and behaviors of your favorite fidgets.
- Set the Mood: Choose from gorgeous premade themes or tweak the visuals to match your exact aesthetic.
- Share with Friends: Created the perfect fidget setup or custom theme? Share your configurations easily using custom links.
A TRULY PREMIUM FREE TIER
I hate ads just as much as you do. Fidgetable offers a generous free tier that includes all core fidgets and features with zero interruptions, zero data-selling, and zero paywalls on the essentials. It's just you and the app.
UNLOCK MORE WITH FIDGETABLE+
For power users who want to dive deeper and support a solo developer, Fidgetable+ is available as an affordable one-time purchase (or an even lower-cost yearly subscription) with Apple Family Sharing included!
- Custom Fidget Builder: Combine and edit existing components to build entirely new fidgets.
- Advanced Haptic Tuning: Dive deep and tweak the haptics to make them feel exactly how you want.
- Theme Builder: Complete control over your app's visual appearance.
- Alternate Modes: Unlock new behaviors for your favorite fidgets.
- Statistics: Learn more about how you use the app.
Built exclusively for iOS, Fidgetable takes full advantage of Apple's advanced haptic engine and frameworks to guarantee a perfectly consistent, high-fidelity tactile experience on your iPhone.
Fidgetable is designed and developed with love by an indie developer. If you enjoy the app, please consider leaving a rating!

bluejetty:00121691:ios.name: Musix Pro - MIDI Controller
bluejetty:00121691:ios.summary: Are you a Pro Musician who wants the best MIDI playing surface or a music newcomer who wants to play melodies more intuitively? Musix Pro packs more notes on the screen than any other app and does so with customizable layouts that bake musi
bluejetty:00121691:ios.description:
Are you a Pro Musician who wants the best MIDI playing surface or a music newcomer who wants to play melodies more intuitively? Musix Pro packs more notes on the screen than any other app and does so with customizable layouts that bake music theory in.
Step up your musical abilities by downloading now.
What do people say about Musix Pro?
"Anyone who loves music, regardless of skill level, owes it to themselves to experience Musix. Simply exploring the app will open musical doors you never knew existed." - 148apps.com
"Musix is a Killer App!" - apps4idevices.com
See Musix Pro in action: http://www.youtube.com/shiverware
Traditional musical instruments are difficult to learn because notes are arranged based on physical constraints. Musix Pro arranges notes based on their harmonic and musical relationships instead, allowing shapes and patterns to emerge that unlock the mathematical beauty of music. 
What is Musix Pro:
- A professional musical instrument and midi controller
- Learn one pattern and instantly play in any key
- Explore the harmonic relationships between notes
- Play music easily without sacrificing virtousity
- An isomorphic layout creator and experimentation app
- A melody exploration device
Features:
- Core / Virtual / Bluetooth Midi, OSC
- Supports all MIDI / Audiobus DAWs
- Touch Velocity Dynamics
- 8 Built-in instruments
- AudioBus Support (MIDI sender, Audio sender, State Saving)
- Hexagonal and Rectangular layouts
- Multiple built-in note arrangements
- Custom layout generation and saving
- Colourize different notes based on key, scale, and mode
- Label notes based on Solfege, or Note name 
- Multiple note sizes
- Multiple color patterns
- Note Overlap (play 3-note chords with one finger)
- Full iPhone Support
Unlike other music apps, Musix Pro provides a wide range of octaves, scales, keys, chords and modes, without limiting your creativity. With multiple built-in instruments and support for OSC and Core/Virtual Midi, most existing synthesizers work beautifully with Musix Pro as a controller.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:
Musix Pro is key agnostic, which means is that once you have learned a musical pattern (like a chord or a scale) that pattern is the same for all keys, even the dreaded A-Flat! Sharps and flats appear in the right place automatically, through the mathematical magic of isomorphism. You can learn to play melodies on a traditional keyboard by playing them on Musix Pro and watching where the sharps and flats go.
Songwriters benefit by discovering new melodies and musical relationships. Novices find it easy to learn to play. Experienced musicians are rewarded with an intuitive interface. Keys can be resized to fit your style - start with "epic"-sized keys, and as you get better you can shrink the keys fill the screen with notes.
Isomorphic keyboards are found on traditional and new instruments, from concertinas, accordions, and "jammers" to Janko keyboards, harmonic-table devices and more. Musix Pro is the only way to access all isomorphic note arrangements in one powerful customizable application. 
Musix Pro comes with a set of built-in layouts, each with its own pros and cons. The harmonic table layout allows you to play any major chord by touching three hexes with one finger. Wicki-Hayden makes modulating between pentatonic scales a breeze. Try them all and find one that works for you.
Musix Pro allows you to change the colour of the notes in your layout. You can colour the notes white and black like a piano; you can colour the notes of any scale or mode (like D-flat mixolidian) and you can colour notes based on tone centre.

bluejetty:00126588:ios.summary:
WinboxMobile – Manage Your Mikrotik Routers on the Go

Key Fe
bluejetty:00126588:ios.description:
WinboxMobile – Manage Your Mikrotik Routers on the Go
WinboxMobile is a universal app designed for both iPhone and iPad, offering full support for Mikrotik RouterOS versions 6.X and 7.X with seamless connections via API or API-SSL.
Key Features:
• Comprehensive Dashboard: Get real-time insights into resource usage, including CPU, memory, disk usage, traffic throughput, client counts, percentage charts, and Ethernet status.
• Organize & Search: Group routers by labels and easily search by name, IP/URL, or labels for quick access.
• Client Management: View key router clients, DHCP leases, wireless registrations, active hotspots, and PPP sessions. You can check details and control these clients effortlessly.
• Real-time Interface Monitoring: Track the real-time transmission and reception rates of network interfaces.
• Custom Charts: Create chart groups for specific metrics, such as CPU usage, memory usage, and traffic rates for Ethernet and WLAN interfaces.
• Advanced Router Settings: Manage CAPsMAN, interfaces, wireless settings, bridges, switches, mesh networks, PPP, IP configurations, routing, system settings, queues, and radius.
• Live Statistics & Charts: Get real-time data for WLAN clients, simple queues, firewall rules, NAT, and more.
• Batch Updates: Select and batch-enable, disable, or delete items with ease. Easily select all items and clear them.
• Logs & Tools: View router logs with search functionality. Utilize powerful tools like Ping, Traceroute, IP Scan, Bandwidth Test, and Profile.
• Script Automation & Maintenance: Run scripts, reboot or shut down routers, manage backups and restores, and check for system updates effortlessly.
• User-Friendly Interface: Enjoy ease of use with features like pull-to-refresh, search highlights, sortable lists, and drag-and-drop functionality.
• Enhanced Security: With Port Knocking, minimize hacking risks by enabling security features with just one tap.
• Team Collaboration: Share and maintain router lists efficiently within a team for smooth collaboration.
PushStats – Proactive Monitoring:
Monitor crucial statistics to identify issues before they affect your users:
• Health Monitoring: Get real-time data on voltage, power consumption, temperatures, fan speeds, and more.
• Resource Tracking: Monitor uptime, CPU load, memory usage, and disk space.
• Client & Traffic Stats: Track system active users, wireless registrations, DHCP leases, hotspot activity, traffic rates, and packet rates for Ethernet and WLAN interfaces.
• Custom Alerts: Set up alerts for key events, such as high CPU or memory usage, interface traffic drops, or link downs, with customizable thresholds.
With WinboxMobile, managing your Mikrotik routers has never been easier or more efficient. Stay in control and monitor your network in real-time, wherever you are.

Learn to code the fun way with Coddy - the gamified coding app that turns programming into a daily habit. Think of it as Duolingo for coding. Whether you're picking up Python, getting into JavaScript, building web pages with HTML and CSS, learning SQL, or diving into AI prompt engineering - Coddy helps you practice through short, hands-on lessons that actually stick.
Learn by Doing
Forget boring theory. Coddy gives you bite-sized challenges where you write actual code, run it, and see results right away. You'll work through puzzles, build small projects, and start understanding how loops, functions, variables, and conditionals really work - not by reading about them, but by using them.
Coddy's built-in code editor lets you code directly on your phone, building real intuition instead of just memorizing syntax. Whether you're learning Python, practicing JavaScript, or writing your first HTML - every lesson gets you coding from the start.
Build Real Programming Skills
Python basics? Web development with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript? SQL queries? Java or C++ for your CS course? This coding app checks your code automatically and explains what went wrong, so every mistake becomes a learning moment.
And it's not just traditional coding. Coddy also teaches AI prompt engineering - how to write effective prompts for today's leading AI tools. Learn it right here alongside Python, JavaScript, and everything else.
18+ Languages and Technologies
One app, no limits. Learn Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, SQL, Java, C++, C, C#, PHP, Swift, Rust, Lua, Ruby, R, Bash and terminal commands, and AI prompt engineering. Build websites, make apps, crunch data, get into game development, or master the command line - there's a path for you.
And yes, we have Rust and Lua. Good luck finding another coding app that teaches those.
Daily Progress That Keeps You Going
Coddy makes consistency easy with streaks, XP, badges, and leaderboards that make every day feel like progress. Keep your streak alive, earn rewards, climb the ranks. It sounds like a coding game because it kind of is - except you're building real programming skills while you play. Whether you're working through a Python course, learning JavaScript step by step, or practicing HTML and CSS - every session counts.
Personalized Practice That Adapts to You
Coddy doesn't give everyone the same coding lessons. The app tracks what you know and where you struggle, then builds custom challenges and quizzes around that. Learning Python? Your practice adapts as you improve. Picking up JavaScript or HTML? Same thing. Over 1M coding challenges, quizzes, and exercises across every programming language - tailored to your level so you're never bored and never lost.
Daily Challenges
Test yourself every day with fresh coding challenges designed to push your skills. Solve problems in Python, JavaScript, SQL and more - earn XP to climb the leaderboard.
Fresh Content Every Week
New coding challenges, lessons, and projects added regularly. Go deeper in Python, pick up JavaScript, try HTML and CSS, or start a completely different programming language.
Made for Beginners (Seriously)
Zero programming experience required. Coddy was built for the curious - students learning Python for the first time, career switchers picking up JavaScript or HTML, or anyone who wants a fun daily coding challenge that's actually useful. This learn to code app adapts to your pace, so you never feel lost.
Why 3M+ People Learn With Coddy
• 18+ languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, SQL, Java, C++, C, C#, PHP, Swift, Rust, Lua, Ruby, R, Bash, and AI Prompt Engineering
• AI-powered coding assistant that actually helps
• Gamified streaks, XP, badges, and leaderboards
• New coding challenges every week
• Works offline - learn anywhere
• Available in 9 languages including English, Spanish, Portuguese, and Japanese
Pick a language, start a streak, and see where it takes you.

bluejetty:00138611:ios.name: Pill Reminder MyTherapy
bluejetty:00138611:ios.summary:
Stay consistent with your medications and build healthy routines—one day at a time. MyTherapy helps you remember doses, understand your progress, and care for yourself or a loved one, with everyday health routines in one place.
As your med
bluejetty:00138611:ios.description:
Stay consistent with your medications and build healthy routines—one day at a time. MyTherapy helps you remember doses, understand your progress, and care for yourself or a loved one, with everyday health routines in one place.
As your medication reminder, MyTherapy fits around your day with flexible alerts and a personalized medication plan. Check what you’ve taken with the pill tracker, follow your measurements in clear charts, and use family profiles to help organize a loved one’s care.
Key features at a glance:
● Pill Reminder & Medication Alarm: Set flexible, personalized reminders for pills, medications, and treatments—reliable and easy to adjust to your routine. Confirm doses with a tap and choose from several snooze options when you want a reminder again later.
● Personal Medication Plan: Keep a clear overview of your medications, including a daily log to track what you’ve taken. Use the calendar view to look back at past entries, see upcoming tasks, and reschedule items when plans change.
● Refill & Prescription Reminders: Stay prepared—get notified before your medication runs out or when it’s time for your next prescription.
● Injection Site Tracking: Easily document and rotate injection sites to support safe and effective treatment.
● Blood Pressure & Weight Tracking: Get reminders for more than 20 health measurements and record them directly in MyTherapy. Track your weight over time with built‑in weight loss support to help you reach and maintain your health goals.
● Progress Charts & Custom Tracking: Follow your measurements and activities over time with clear charts. Add your own measurements and activities to track what matters to you.
● Apple Health Integration: Automatically sync your weight, steps, water intake, and more—so all your health data stays connected.
● Symptom & Pain Diary: Log symptoms such as fatigue, pain, or skin changes to better understand your condition and treatment progress.
● Streaks: Stay consistent—build strong routines by tracking your daily progress and maintaining your streaks.
● Health Reports & Overview: Turn your data into clear reports to support better conversations with your doctor.
● Family Profiles: Manage multiple profiles in one account to help children, parents, or other loved ones keep track of their medication and health routines.
● Personal Settings: Choose shapes and colors for your medications and customize reminder sounds. Dark mode follows your device settings.
Helpful for people managing conditions such as:
- ADHD (attention deficit/hyperactivity disorder)
- Asthma
- Diabetes (type 1 and type 2)
- Heart disease (e.g. high blood pressure, CHD, atrial fibrillation)
- Obesity
and for anyone managing multiple medications, building healthier routines, or supporting a loved one with their treatment.
Your health data belongs to you. We follow strict security practices and are independently certified to international standards, including ISO 13485 and ISO 27001.
For more information and helpful insights, visit http://www.mytherapyapp.com

bluejetty:00121677:ios.summary:

Real Monster Trucks: Take control from over 100 meticulously detailed, most are officially licensed like BIGFOOT, US
bluejetty:00121677:ios.description:
Do you love racing games and driving games? How about truck games? Well, get ready for adrenaline-pumping action with MTD!
Real Monster Trucks: Take control from over 100 meticulously detailed, most are officially licensed like BIGFOOT, USA-1, Strait Jacket, Outback Thunda, Bearfoot, Bad Habit and many more. See your collection grow in the collection screen. Use them for demolition or for simulation, the choice is yours.
Epic Multiplayer Showdowns: Brace yourself for heart-pounding simulator head-to-head action! Compete against up to 16 players in intense multiplayer battles. Join lobbies, challenge opponents, and prove you're the ultimate champion on a global stage.
Craft Your Dream Track: Recreate legendary tracks from bygone eras of TNT and Monster Jam or design your own arena for drag racing, freestyle action or crush cars in practice mode. The Level Editor contains many props to enable you to create your dream challenge.
Real-Time Damage Dynamics: Witness the jaw-dropping realism of real-time damage deformation on your truck. See your truck crumple, bend, and break under the intense pressure of the arena in monster demolition competitions.
Diverse Competition Modes: Conquer a range of driving game modes, including Drag Racing, Freestyle, and Side by Side. Each mode offers a unique challenge for every simulator enthusiast. When competing in Drag Racing you will need to beat the clock and the other trucks. Side by Side will have you go head to head at the same time against other players. Freestyle will see you cause a world of destruction in the arena whilst getting the highest score.
Dominate the Arena: Whether you're a seasoned race game pro or a newbie, MTD guarantees an action-packed, high-octane experience. Show off your skills and dominate the arena!
Global Community: Join a thriving community of enthusiasts from around the world. Connect, compete, and share your experiences with fellow fans.
Upgrades and Customization: Fine-tune your ride to perfection. Upgrade engines, transmissions, and more to gain the competitive edge. Add flags, neon lights, change chassis colors and customize your tires with lettering and colors. Customize your offroad machine and make it uniquely yours!
Stunning Graphics and Effects: Immerse yourself in eye-popping visuals and dynamic simulation effects that bring the offroad experience to life like never before.
Competitive Leaderboards: Climb the ranks and prove you're the top simulation driver in the world of trucks. Compete for glory and earn your place among the elite.
Get ready to rev your engines and conquer the arena in the most thrilling driving game ever! 
If you love a good simulator download 'Monster Truck Destruction' (MTD) now and let the monster demolition begin!

bluejetty:00123479:ios.description:
Grocery shopping (and so much more!) is now the easiest part of your day with the Hy-Vee app. This all-in-one supermarket app offers everything you need — from convenient grocery shopping and seasonal meal ideas to expert how-tos, shoppable premium products, and easy pharmacy refills.
The Hy-Vee app allows you to order groceries in minutes from anywhere. Enjoy the convenience of having a grocery store at your fingertips! Browse by category, explore sale items, check out products with Fuel Saver rewards, or simply type what you need into the search bar. Unlike other supermarket apps, we empower you to take control of your shopping experience. Make grocery shopping a breeze and find deals tailored to you — all while enjoying continuous improvements based on your feedback. Here are some of the features we think you’ll love:
Inspire your meals: Dive into our digital "Discover” experience that provides delicious recipe inspiration for every occasion, from quick weeknight dinners to festive holiday dishes. Plus, discover stylish, shoppable premium cookware and get expert video tips that elevate your cooking.
Shop anytime, anywhere: Whether you’re at work, home, or on the go, order groceries and schedule pickup (in as little as two hours) or delivery. Experience the VIP treatment our employees are known for.
Find great deals: Easily spot sale items with our sale icon or browse all discounts in one convenient place. Add sale items to your cart effortlessly.
Hy-Vee PERKS rewards: Keep track of your Fuel Saver rewards and expiration dates — no need to carry your card. Just scan your PERKS card in the app!
Health made easy: Refill prescriptions, check refill status, manage family members’ prescriptions, and stay informed with the latest health recommendations — all within the app.
At Hy-Vee we believe in providing a helpful smile in every aisle and going the extra mile for you. We’re proud to serve our communities with quality products, variety, convenience, culinary expertise, and superior customer service leading you to a healthy lifestyle. Grab your groceries and let us support you in the kitchen!

bluejetty:00065114:ios.description:
**Planning a dinner party, trip, or group gift?**
Collecting money is the worst:
Always accompanied by hundreds of messages and awkward reminders asking others to pay. And on top of that, you always end up paying for things in advance with your own money... mixing everything together.
**Moneypool is the easiest way to collect money from friends.**
Plan group gifts, get-togethers, parties, trips, dinners—whatever you need—without the headache.
Just create a payment link and share it.
Your friends can pay without downloading the app.
No more tracking payments manually, asking for proof, or sending awkward messages asking others to pay for their part.
**Create a payment link in seconds**
Just give it a name, share the link, and you’re good to go. Add a photo and description to personalize it.
**Everyone can pay with their preferred payment method easily**
Additionally, you’ll be able to visualize all payments in one single place, making collecting money less confusing.
**Receive payments without sharing your bank account**
No need to share your personal information–send a payment link and you’re good to go. Your friends can pay with a card or transfer even if they don’t have an account.
**Your data is always secure**
All of your information is encrypted and protected with top-tier security standards.
**Clear fees, no fine print**
**For whoever’s paying:**
- Free when paying from a Moneypool wallet
- 3.9% fee for card payments
- $39 MXN fee for bank transfers (SPEI)
**For whoever’s receiving:**
- Free if fewer than 30 people contribute to your pool
- If 30+ people contribute, a 4.9% fee applies to the total amount collected
Join **+1M people** collecting money stress-free
More than **10,000 five-star reviews**
**Download the app for free** and create your first pool with no strings attached
Your friends don’t need to download the app to pay
Make life easier—download Moneypool and forget about payment chaos

bluejetty:00165513:android.description:
▶ Storyline ◀
"That's why we came to pick you up. You'll become the devil's bride."
When opened my eyes… Everything I knew was changed.
Born an orphan, Seri struggled to survive.
As it turned out, the father whom she thought was dead,
had promised her soul to devils,
in exchange for unlimited wealth, 
Each one of the devils demanded Seri to be their bride....
As she slowly starts to fall into the hands of these devils,
she's pulled into crimes, will this be her end or a brand new start?
▶ Information ◀
◎ A genuine dark romance fantasy for adults
The ending is in your hands.
A pinch of arrogance, boldness and at times, a spoonful of erotism.
Become part of the story.
◎ Attractive and seductive characters
Aggressive and majestic, the devil of Superbia (doom and power) [Ruan]
"It is me who can provide you with the very best. You can be my bride."
A devil whose existence is power, no one reigns over him.
His power, followed by ruin, shines even more with the bride.
Sweet yet cold, the devil of Gula (infinite wealth and avarice) [Baro]
"What is it that you want? I have much wealth to share. I can buy anything for you."
A devil rich enough, but still greedy on the inside.
His greed turns to the bride.
Gentle yet passionate, the devil of Luxuria (lust and pleasures) [Ah-in]
"Is it pleasure what you want? Just tell me. I'll show you what climax is."
A devil that kindly stimulates human instincts and obtains them.
This time, he is going to have bride's everything.
And the man that tries to save Seri [Teo]
"Did you get dinner? Do you want me to make some?"
A man who always worries about her and becomes a strong supporter in daily life.
But is it really a strong support for her?

* As seen on CNN, Lifehacker, and Engadget.com * 
Fall asleep fast to over 600 high-quality full-stereo recordings from around the world.
• "It is one of the best apps I have used to keep me calm and to go to sleep" - V lovelyu -
• "Lull me into relaxing! -Downloaded last night and easily selected sounds to make a custom mix of favorites: chimes, rain and a really cool "celestial" sound. • "Beautiful app -Not only are the sounds fabulous, the photos are incredible. Easy to use, elegant interface. Great app!" - WebbyHess19
Sleep deeply every night, and wake up feeling fresh and energized.
Sleep Sounds HQ gives you immediate access to a massive catalog of high-quality, naturally recorded sounds. Much better than synthetic sounds and short repetitive loops, these are real-world sounds with all the richness, texture, and nuance of the natural environment. 
Imagine falling asleep to soft rain on a Bali rice terrace, a Himalayan stream, Red Sea waves, South African crickets, a warm crackling campfire, or enchanting wind chimes. 
Or … if you prefer the steady hum of 'white noise’, fall asleep to a steady blizzard, Swiss waterfall, the drone of a Dutch highway, a working flour mill, dishwashers and spinning washing machines, or pure white, pink, and brown noise. 
You will fall asleep fast and wake up feeling refreshed and rejuvenated.
What's more, Sleep Sounds HQ can be used anytime you need to block out the outside world:
• Increase your ability to focus and be creative at work by removing distractions.
• Soothe your baby or small children and create a peaceful sanctuary for you and your family.
• Transform your hotel room into a familiar sleep oasis by blocking out noisy neighbors, ice machines, and elevator doors.
• Create a calm and tranquil environment for meditation and yoga.
With over 600 high-quality audio tracks to choose from, fine-tune a collection of sounds to your individual taste.
And if that isn't enough, you can create your own personalized mixes for sleep, work, travel, nap time, or meditation, blending up to 6 sounds at a time.
Improve your sleep, your health, and your sense of well-being starting tonight.
Sleep Sounds HQ Features: 
• 600+ natural sounds recorded on location around the world 
• Long high-quality stereo recordings
• Beautiful high-definition images from around the globe
• Modern easy-to-use interface, tailored for nighttime use
• Sleep timer with slow audio fade-out, settable with a simple tap
• Easy-to-create blended mixes of any 6 sounds, with 35 trillion possible combinations
• Easy search functions to discover your favorite sounds 
• Runs in background while using other apps or when the screen is locked
• 19 sound categories, including Rain, Ocean, Rivers & Streams, Crickets & Insects, Frogs, Wind Chimes, Lakes, Wind, Water Fountains, Fire, Birds, Animals, Cars, Trains, Public Places, Household, Bells, Industrial, Soundscapes
Download Sleep Sounds HQ now to fall asleep fast.

Create characters, write scenes with AI, discover community stories, and join group rooms to create together.

Choose a character, enter a scene, and shape what happens next through your replies. Explore fantasy, mystery, science fiction, adventure, everyday life, and more.

Build characters with their own personalities, backgrounds, speaking styles, relationships, and world settings. Reuse them across different stories and scenes.

Create scenes with multiple characters, switch perspectives, and develop longer story arcs through conversation.
【Share Creative Moments】
Post character ideas, story updates, writing prompts, and memorable scenes. Discover new characters and stories created by the community.

Join group rooms, choose a character, and continue stories together with other users.
Plotto is great for:
- AI-assisted storytelling
- Interactive fiction

- Fantasy, mystery, science fiction, adventure, and everyday stories
- Collaborative writing and worldbuilding
Open Plotto, choose a character, and begin your story.

bluejetty:00021217:ios.summary:
Learn drums from your first beat to playing full songs -- step-by-step, at your own pace, no drum kit required. Tap on your phone or tablet to practice along with real drum beats across rock, pop, blues, and funk.
WHAT YOU GET
Step-by-ste
bluejetty:00021217:ios.description:
Learn drums from your first beat to playing full songs -- step-by-step, at your own pace, no drum kit required. Tap on your phone or tablet to practice along with real drum beats across rock, pop, blues, and funk.
WHAT YOU GET
Step-by-step drum lessons that start with the basics: how to hold the sticks, posture at the kit, and stick control. From there you build into full drum beats -- rock grooves, pop backbeats, blues shuffles, funk patterns -- one skill at a time.
Video lessons from drum instructors who teach beginners for a living. Each tutorial focuses on one idea so you can see the technique, hear how it should sound, and copy it without guesswork.
Slow-motion replays for the parts that trip everyone up. Drop the tempo, watch where the sticks land, then bring it back up to speed when your hands are ready.
A song library arranged for beginners. Pick a track, play along, and use the visual feedback to see whether your timing is on the beat or drifting. This is where drum practice stops feeling like homework and starts sounding like music.
NO DRUM KIT? START ANYWAY
You don't need a kit to begin. Practice the grip, the rhythms, and the song parts on a tabletop, a practice pad, or right on the screen. When you do sit at a real kit later, the patterns are already in your hands.
HOW IT'S BUILT FOR BEGINNERS
Plain-language teaching. No music theory jargon thrown at you before you've played a single beat. If a lesson uses a word, it explains the word.
Short sessions that fit a real day. Five minutes between meetings, fifteen before dinner -- progress comes from showing up, not from hour-long blocks you can never find.
Honest pacing. You repeat a beat until it locks in, then move on. Skip ahead any time, or go back and re-watch a lesson without losing your place.
Every drummer started where you are now -- counting one beat at a time. Download Learn Drums and play your first rhythm today.

Privacy Policy - http://thecookbk.com/privacy.php?appname=learn.drums.beginners

bluejetty:00153798:ios.description:
Huba Football is your all-in-one destination for immersive and real-time football live scores. Whether you're tracking live matches, analyzing team stats or individual player performance, Huba Football brings you closer to the game with clarity and depth.
App Key Features:
* Live Scores & Match Center:
Follow every match as it happens with real-time scores, game status updates, and live commentary. Home, away, and neutral venues are clearly displayed with intuitive UI.
* Detailed Match Statistics:
Access comprehensive team stats including shots on/off goal, blocked shots, fouls, corner kicks, and pass accuracy — all visualized in a clean and readable format.
* Fixtures & Results:
Stay up to date with ongoing, upcoming, and past fixtures. Navigate through daily match schedules and browse through historical results.
* Lineups & Formations:
View team formations with visual representation. Analyze how each team sets up with formations like 4-2-3-1, including detailed player positions.
* Goal & Event Timelines:
Track every key match moment: goals (normal and penalties), player substitutions, yellow/red cards, and more — all timestamped and structured.
* Player Profiles & Stats:
Explore in-depth player statistics such as goals, assists, passes completed, dribbles attempted/successful, and more. Access player transfer history and trophy achievements per season.
* Instant Push Notifications:
Get notified in real-time for match starts, goals, cards, and final results — never miss a moment that matters.
* Team Overview & Stadium Info:
Discover team insights including home ground details, stadium capacity, playing surface, and recent form with last 6 game results.
* Latest Football News:
Browse football headlines tailored for you. View articles with images and story highlights from the football world, all updated daily.
* Search & Discover Leagues:
Easily search for global competitions with season filters. Quickly access league details and navigate through team performances.
* Cards Stats:
Monitor discipline across competitions — view players with red card stats in structured and ranked format.
* Transfer History & Trophies:
Follow a player’s career journey with transfer movements and club changes. Also explore their earned trophies and seasonal accolades.
Huba Football is designed for fans who crave precision, clarity, and real-time interaction with the beautiful game. No official team or league names are required — just pure football data delivered intelligently. Download Huba Football app now.

* View and enter Progress Notes  
* Record vital signs  
* Use the full functions of CPOE  
* Access the ICW panel throughout the app  
* Review labs, imaging, and procedure results  
* Refill prescriptions  
* Document OB flowsheets  
* Enable for voice and eClinicalWorks Scribe  
* Use the built-in camera to assist in documenting Progress Notes

bluejetty:00039104:ios.name: eMedici Medical Education
bluejetty:00039104:ios.summary: eMedici is Australia's ultimate medical education platform - designed to support individuals from the very first day of medical school, through clinical placements, junior doctor and registrar years, all the way through to fellowship exams.
bluejetty:00039104:ios.description:
eMedici is Australia's ultimate medical education platform - designed to support individuals from the very first day of medical school, through clinical placements, junior doctor and registrar years, all the way through to fellowship exams. Built by expert clinicians and educators, everything on eMedici is tailored to the Australian healthcare context.
eMedici offers a range of self-assessment and learning tools to suit how you study best:
- Thousands of Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) written specifically for Australian clinical practice
- Mock Exams to help you see where you stand compared to your peers
- Case Studies that walk you through real-life patient journeys
- OSCE Stations with detailed marksheets and an interactive interface that allows you to practise by yourself or with friends
Resources include:
- Clinical Medicine: Perfect for medical students on clinical placements, junior doctors, as well as international medical graduates preparing for Australian clinical practice.
- Basic Science: Tailored to pre-clinical medical students and allied health students, covering key subjects like anatomy, physiology, pathophysiology, pharmacology, and more.
- Junior Doctor: Build your confidence on the wards with MCQs and clinical case scenarios designed to support Australian interns and residents as CPD.
- GP AKT/KFP: Prepare with confidence for the RACGP AKT and KFP exams with thousands of expert-reviewed MCQs, detailed explanations, and blueprinted Mock Exams.
- General Practice Registrars Australia (GPRA) Clinical Cases: Simulated consultations and case discussions designed for GP registrars preparing for the Australian general practice clinical exams, both ACRRM and RACGP.
- CWH/PTP: Question Bank for candidates preparing for the RANZCOG Certificate of Women's Health and Associate Training Program (Procedural) exam.
- Basic Pathological Sciences: Question Bank and Mock Exam for candidates preparing for the RCPA Basic Pathological Sciences (BPS) examination.
With over 30 years of experience in medical education and thousands of students and doctors supported across Australia, eMedici is here to help you study smarter at every stage of your career, and become a better doctor.

bluejetty:00037799:ios.description:
Stay Connected, Stay Secure with Location Tracker, Phone Finder
Step into a world where connectivity and security go hand in hand. Location Tracker, Phone Finder is your ultimate solution for staying close to loved ones, ensuring their safety, and simplifying your everyday life.
Why Choose Location Tracker, Phone Finder?
Family GPS Tracker
Create a dedicated family circle to always know where your loved ones are. Whether you’re checking if the kids made it to school safely or if everyone’s home after an outing, enjoy peace of mind with every map update.
Real-Time Location Sharing
Meeting up with friends has never been easier! Share your live location, track who’s on their way, and eliminate delays or confusion about meeting points.
Lost Device Tracking
Lost your phone or tablet? Don’t panic! Quickly locate your device and recover it with ease – a true lifesaver in stressful situations.
Complete Privacy Control
Your privacy matters. Customize who can see your location and when with intuitive privacy settings, giving you full control over your data.
User-Friendly Design
From clear maps to simple navigation, our app is designed for everyone, no matter their tech expertise. Effortless to use, even for first-timers.
SOS Signal for Emergencies
When every second counts, the SOS feature lets you send a distress signal with your precise location to selected contacts in one tap.
Energy-Efficient Design
Stay connected without draining your battery. Our app is optimized for minimal power consumption so you can stay online all day.
Regular Updates
We never stop improving! Enjoy new features, enhanced performance, and updates driven by your feedback.
More Than Just an App – Your Everyday Companion
Whether you’re a parent, a traveler, or simply someone who values safety and connection, Location Tracker, Phone Finder is designed with you in mind. It’s not just an app; it’s a trusted partner in your daily life.
Privacy & Terms
Your privacy and security are our top priorities.

CollaNote: Powerful note-taking app packed with a wide range of tools.
Note-taking, PDF markup, digital planning, and flashcards - all in one place!
BUILT FOR APPLE PENCIL WITH AN ENHANCED WRITING EXPERIENCE:
- 25+ different pens and brushes to transform your notes into artwork.
- Handwriting stabilizer for beautiful, smooth writing.
- Enjoy a calming ASMR note-taking experience.
- Infinite Arc Menu available for both Apple Pencil Pro and Apple Pencil Gen 2.
IMPORT, MARK-UP, AND EXPORT PDF:

- In-built scanner to digitize your physical documents.
- Export notes to PDF and share with ease.
POWERFUL TOOLS:

bluejetty:00026621:ios.description:
“The Smart Sleep Coach has been a game-changer! The personalized sleep plan and daily tips have helped my little one sleep longer and more peacefully.” Alice, smartsleepcoach.com
Solve your baby’s sleep with our award-winning app, brought to you by Pampers.
All-in-one baby tracker and personalized sleep plan to help you navigate sleep with confidence, now and as your baby grows. Developed by pediatric sleep experts and trusted by parents, the Smart Sleep Coach uses AI to understand your baby's unique natural rhythm, predict exactly when it is time for your baby’s next sleep and guides you step-by-step to better sleep. Say goodbye to guesswork and hello to a custom sleep plan that works for YOUR family, without ever needing to "cry it out." Start your journey to restorative sleep today!
ACTIONABLE SLEEP GUIDANCE THAT WORKS
More than just a tracker; our app uses AI to decode your baby’s sleep patterns so you can establish the perfect sleep rhythm and build healthy sleep habits that last.
SLEEP CONSULTANT, IN YOUR POCKET
Get trusted sleep guidance, personalized to your baby with a custom-designed sleep program developed by pediatric sleep experts, tailored to your baby's age, development, and temperament. Forget rigid schedules – our flexible approach adapts to your baby and is with you every step of the way. Access a wide range of expert curated of exclusive content, articles, and video workshops from leading sleep scientists and pediatricians. Your sleep questions, answered.
COMPREHENSIVE TRACKING & INSIGHTS: 
Easily log sleeps, feedings, diapers, and more with just one tap. See clear patterns and track progress over time with intuitive charts, helping you understand your baby's development and sleep needs.
NO MORE NAP MATH, JUST SMARTER SLEEP
Our AI powered schedule knows exactly when your baby needs to sleep, so you don’t have to guess when it’s time for the next nap. The app suggests the perfect windows for naps and bedtime, taking out the guess work and reducing the chance of overtiredness.
GENTLE "No Cry It Out” APPROACH: 
We believe in a supportive, responsive approach to baby sleep. We recognize that every baby and family are different, so our sleep training program offers a range of methods so you can pick the program that best aligns with your parenting approach and values.
AWARD WINNING 
Winner of the Parent Trusted, Paren

bluejetty:00143057:ios.description:
The NCP app brings all your parking needs together in one convenient and easy-to-use place, offering the ability to:
• Purchase and access a digital Season Ticket, giving you the ability to manage your account with ease
• Ticketless pay-as-you-go parking at 370+ car parks across the UK
Make sure you download the NCP app before entering one of our car parks to guarantee the best experience.
Downloading the NCP app means you can purchase digital monthly, quarterly, and annual season tickets, depending on your needs. Your season ticket will then be stored in the app, meaning you’ll never forget or lose a physical season ticket again!
Features of the NCP app include:
• The ability to pay as you go and access your season ticket, if you have one, in one place
• Extend your parking session in-app to save you having to go back to your car, you’ll be notified by push notifications from the app, so please ensure you have enabled notifications in your device settings to stay up to date
• One QR code for all your products
• Ability to favourite sites that you regularly visit in your favourites list
• AutoPay provides fully automatic recognition and payment at selected sites via your vehicle registration number (VRN)
• Map and list view of car parks with additional features
• Buy and pay for a season ticket within the app, allowing unlimited parking within your chosen site for the length of your ticket
• In-app chat function, giving you a direct line to customer service
• Pay with Apple Pay

bluejetty:00177096:ios.name: Baby kids block puzzle Puzzlee
bluejetty:00177096:ios.summary:
Puzzlee – The Educational Puzzle App for Toddlers, Preschoolers, and Young Kids
Puzzlee is an educational app designed for toddlers, with simple, colorful block puzzles that help develop memory, logic, focus, and shape recognition from an
bluejetty:00177096:ios.description:
Puzzlee – The Educational Puzzle App for Toddlers, Preschoolers, and Young Kids
Puzzlee is an educational app designed for toddlers, with simple, colorful block puzzles that help develop memory, logic, focus, and shape recognition from an early age. With an intuitive and secure interface, children explore freely, learn independently, and play without ads or internet connection. Perfect for parents looking for a calm, safe, and stimulating learning game for babies, preschoolers, and kindergarten-age children.
Builds Memory, Logic, and Early Cognitive Skills
Each puzzle encourages observation, visual perception, color recognition, logical thinking, and hand-eye coordination. Kids manipulate the blocks to understand how shapes fit together, stimulating the brain gently while strengthening visual memory, problem-solving, and pre-math skills.
Touch-Friendly Gameplay for Small Hands
Blocks are large, colorful, and respond instantly to touch. Movements are simple—drag, drop, and assemble. Children can play on their own, building confidence, independence, and fine motor skills. No reading required and no complicated actions.
Colorful Themes That Boost Imagination
Puzzlee includes a variety of toddler-friendly themes:
Farm animals
Zoo animals
Halloween, Christmas, Easter
Cute kawaii characters
Cars and vehicles
Dragons and fantasy themes
Two Play Modes for Every Child’s Rhythm
Relax mode with no timer for calm, stress-free play
Timer mode to encourage speed, memory, and quick thinking
This dual structure allows natural progression at the child’s own pace.
New: 16-Piece Advanced Puzzles
A brand-new collection of more challenging puzzles is now available:
16 pieces to assemble, increased difficulty, improved logic, and stronger concentration skills.
Simple Audio Guidance
Children can follow voice prompts and soft sound cues, making the app fully usable without reading—ideal for preschool and early kindergarten learners.
Share Completed Puzzles
Kids can share their finished puzzles with family members through messaging apps, helping them feel proud of their achievements and progress.
100% Kid-Safe App
No ads
No external links
Works offline
Secure, child-friendly interface
An Educational and Relaxing Game
Puzzlee supports early cognitive development while providing a calm, enjoyable, and enriching play experience for young children

listings.name: Baby kids block puzzle Puzzlee
listings.description:
Puzzlee – The Educational Puzzle App for Toddlers, Preschoolers, and Young Kids

Puzzlee is an educational app designed for toddlers, with simple, colorful block puzzles that help develop memory, logic, focus, and shape recognition from an early age. With an intuitive and secure interface, children explore freely, learn independently, and play without ads or internet connection. Perfect for parents looking for a calm, safe, and stimulating learning game for babies, preschoolers, and kindergarten-age children.

Builds Memory, Logic, and Early Cognitive Skills

Each puzzle encourages observation, visual perception, color recognition, logical thinking, and hand-eye coordination. Kids manipulate the blocks to understand how shapes fit together, stimulating the brain gently while strengthening visual memory, problem-solving, and pre-math skills.

Touch-Friendly Gameplay for Small Hands

Blocks are large, colorful, and respond instantly to touch. Movements are simple—drag, drop, and assemble. Children can play on their own, building confidence, independence, and fine motor skills. No reading required and no complicated actions.

Colorful Themes That Boost Imagination

Puzzlee includes a variety of toddler-friendly themes:

Farm animals

Zoo animals

Halloween, Christmas, Easter

Cute kawaii characters

Cars and vehicles

Dragons and fantasy themes

Two Play Modes for Every Child’s Rhythm

Relax mode with no timer for calm, stress-free play

Timer mode to encourage speed, memory, and quick thinking

This dual structure allows natural progression at the child’s own pace.

New: 16-Piece Advanced Puzzles

A brand-new collection of more challenging puzzles is now available:
16 pieces to assemble, increased difficulty, improved logic, and stronger concentration skills.

Simple Audio Guidance

Children can follow voice prompts and soft sound cues, making the app fully usable without reading—ideal for preschool and early kindergarten learners.

Share Completed Puzzles

Kids can share their finished puzzles with family members through messaging apps, helping them feel proud of their achievements and progress.

100% Kid-Safe App

No ads

No external links

Works offline

Secure, child-friendly interface

An Educational and Relaxing Game

Puzzlee supports early cognitive development while providing a calm, enjoyable, and enriching play experience for young children

bluejetty:00100349:ios.summary: Think you’re buying from a cool indie granola brand? Surprise—it’s owned by the same conglomerate that makes engine degreaser and (allegedly) sells your info to the CIA. Buy’r is your pocket-sized truth serum: scan any grocery product and s
bluejetty:00100349:ios.description:
Think you’re buying from a cool indie granola brand? Surprise—it’s owned by the same conglomerate that makes engine degreaser and (allegedly) sells your info to the CIA. Buy’r is your pocket-sized truth serum: scan any grocery product and see exactly who profits, from your local co-op to a megacorp with 19 shell companies and a yacht named Tax Haven.
While other apps rate your food or hand out “approved” badges, we don’t tell you what’s good or bad. We just show you the facts—who owns it, what’s in it, and how processed it is—so you can decide what fits your life, values, and oddly specific food rules.
Because real empowerment doesn’t come from a green checkmark—it comes from knowing the truth.
OUR MISSION:
We’re a small, self-funded team on a big mission: radical transparency in the grocery aisle. No corporate backing, no brand sponsorships—not even from the “cool” ones.
Whether you're avoiding shady corporate practices, trying to support real small businesses, or just tired of decoding labels that sound like marketing Mad Libs, Buy’r puts the power back in your hands—where it belongs.
DISCOVER THE TRUTH BEHIND EVERY PRODUCT:
Barcode Scanning - Point. Scan. Boom, instant dossier on the product, brand, and parent company. CIA-level info without the espionage.
Ownership Discovery - Find out if that "small batch, artisanal vibe" is real or just another product of a corporate rebrand strategy.
Brand & Company Spotlights - Deep-dives that feel like true crime documentaries—but for shampoo and salad dressing.
SMART SHOPPING TOOLS:
Custom Ingredient Filters - Whether you're allergic to gluten or just emotionally allergic to corn syrup, filter it all. Presets, breakdowns, the works.
Shopping Lists with Full Integration - Build lists that actually sync with your pantry. No more accidental double-buying basil for the fifth time.
Pantry Manager - Take control of your pantry like the food hoarder CEO you were born to be. Recipes and meal planners are in development.
Receipt Scan Import - Snap a pic of your Kroger or Walmart receipt—get your pantry logged in faster than a teenager logging into TikTok.
NUTRITION & TRANSPARENCY:
Detailed Nutrition Breakdown - We don’t just show calories—we show what those calories are hiding. Ultra-processed red flags, ingredient types, and what your food is actually made of (hint: it's not love).
Community Ratings & Reviews - Because the hive mind can be smarter than the label. See what real people think—no bots, no BS.
EDUCATIONAL & ENGAGING:
Interactive Quizzes - Think you know who owns your “indie” oat milk? Let’s test that brand loyalty.
Random Spotlight Carousel - A surprise-a-day from family-owned gems you probably missed while being hypnotized by mega-brand marketing.
31 Achievement Badges - Scan. Learn. Flex. Prove you’re not just a consumer—you’re a conscious one.
ALL FEATURES:
- Instant barcode scanning
- Ownership discovery & brand family trees
- Deep-dive spotlights on companies (yes, even the shady ones)
- Ingredient filters with preset logic packs
- Smart, integrated shopping lists
- Pantry tracking with actual usefulness
- Receipt scanning from major grocers
- Transparent nutrition + processing breakdowns
- Community-powered reviews
- Corporate guessing games (a.k.a. quizzes)
- Indie brand discovery carousel
- 31 achievement badges for your consumer resume
- Randomized daily brand spotlights
SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS:
Free Forever
Basic scans + product lookups
1 shopping list
20 pantry items
Lite spotlight access (just a taste)
Premium — $5/month or $50/year
Unlimited scans, lists, and pantry tracking
Full ingredient filtering
Full spotlight content
Receipt scanning
All quiz + discovery features
