bluejetty:00136904:ios.name: Bricks Ball Journey
bluejetty:00136904:ios.summary:
Welcome to "Bricks Ball Journey"! Bricks Ball Journey is a globally popular classic brick-breaking game.
Based on the accumulation of "Bricks Ball Crusher", we have improved all aspects of the experience and content of "Brick Ball Journey"
bluejetty:00136904:ios.description:
Welcome to "Bricks Ball Journey"! Bricks Ball Journey is a globally popular classic brick-breaking game.
Based on the accumulation of "Bricks Ball Crusher", we have improved all aspects of the experience and content of "Brick Ball Journey", hoping that it will bring you more fun. The game inherits more than 300 skill blocks and skill balls from the previous game, and introduces target as the main mode of gameplay. We also bring a new "Adventure Mode", which is the adventure story of Amelia. She meets her partner - Echo, a feline creature from an alien planet that has mysterious powers.
What are you waiting for? Let's explore the journey of the brick world together. You can constantly unlock different landscapes and themes from around the world, and you can also decorate all the scenes to your liking. 
Introduction to normal mode:
- The ball will fly in any direction you touch
- Find the best position and angle to hit each brick 
- Complete levels by collecting targets
- When breaking bricks, never let them touch the bottom
Features:
- Free play
- Smooth and accurate aiming
- 9000 + levels
- Superb physical playing method experience 
- More than 300 skill balls and skill blocks 
- Support offline (no Internet access) games 
- Support multiplayer games
- Support achievements and leader boards
- Support subscription
Subscription VIP members:
- By membership subscription, you can enjoy the exclusive rights of all members.
- Please note that subscription prices will be automatically adjusted according to different account regions.
- Disclaimer of member automatic renewal: after the purchase is confirmed, the fee will be deducted from the user account.
- Subscriptions are automatically renewed unless they are canceled at least 24 hours before the current subscription ends.
- The renewal fee will be deducted from your account according to your current subscribed contents within 24 hours before the end of your current subscription period.
- After purchase, you can enter the account settings to view the account subscription and activated services.
- You can unsubscribe during the free trial period through the subscription settings of your iTunes account. Please be sure to complete it 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged. For more information: http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098 
- You can switch off the automatic renewal through iTunes account settings. However, you cannot cancel the current subscription within the valid subscription period.
- During the free trial period, any unused part will be invalidated after purchasing a membership subscription.
Privacy Policy: http://www.iposeidonbussiness.com/PrivacyPolicy/BricksGame_New.html
Terms of use: http://www.iposeidonbussiness.com/TermsOfUse/BricksGame_New.html

bluejetty:00184234:ios.description:

Transfers- Easily transfer cash between your accounts.

Locations- Find nearby Branches and ATMs using the iPhone's built-in GPS. Additionally, you can search by zip code or address.

bluejetty:00036620:ios.description:
Aladdin Connect® allows you to monitor and control your garage door from anywhere. The Aladdin Connect® app works with any Genie Wi-Fi-enabled garage door opener or retrofit kit and can be set up in minutes. The app controls up to 20 garage door openers or retrofit kits and allows you to do the following:
• Open or close the door from your smartphone
• Check whether the door is open or closed from anywhere, using your smartphone
• Get notified if your door is opened or closed and customize notifications
• Add up to 20 family or guest users and get notified when they operate the door 
• Set up rules to automatically notify you or close the garage if the garage door is open at night or open for a long time.
• Connect to leading smart home and voice platforms
For more information, visit http://www.geniecompany.com/aladdinconnect

bluejetty:00037855:ios.description:
Planning to prioritise your health? Let the Healthians app help you!
Healthians is India’s leading doorstep medical diagnostics service provider that brings accurate medical
checkups and full body checkup packages to your doorstep.
The Healthians app is your comprehensive health companion, offering easy access to a wide range of lab
tests and blood tests at home. With our user-friendly interface, you can book tests, track your reports,
and learn about the latest health tips all in one place.
How are Full Body Checkups Beneficial for My Health?
Did you know a simple blood test a home can help diagnose a plethora of health issues? Early detection
helps in creating an effective action plan comprising accurate treatment and lifestyle changes. Full body
checkups are never a regret, but an investment towards a long and healthy life.
Why Choose Healthians?
● Presence in 250 cities
● 22 fully owned state-of-the-art labs across India
● 1,500 trained phlebotomists
● 60 lakh satisfied customers & counting
● Serving 1.8 lakh customers a month
● LIVE real-time sample tracking & reporting of lab tests, individual blood tests at home and full
body checkups.
● AI-based recommendations in reports
● Automated AI-based video health report analysis & recommendations
● Youngest CAP-USA accredited lab
● NABL accredited labs
● Free Home Sample Collection for Blood Tests
● Free wellness consultation post-test with customised diet + lifestyle recommendations
How Does it All Work?
It’s easy peasy. You just have to take the first step of booking a lab test or health checkup and we’ll
handle the rest! Here’s a breakdown
● Book a full body checkup or blood tests at home, of your choice at your convenient time slot
● Our sample collectors will visit you to collect your samples
● The sample will then be transported & tested at the nearest Healthians NABL-accredited lab
● Smart reports will be generated within 6 to 24 hours
What Do We Offer?
The list is long! But here’s a brief description of our offerings -
Accurate and Reliable Diagnostic Services
Healthians is one of the top medical diagnostics service providers in India, renowned for providing top-
tier health packages at home ranging from full body checkups to individual tests like lipid profile test,
diabetes tests, liver function tests etc, pathology lab tests. Founded in 2015, we have etched a
significant position in the market, serving over 6 million households nationwide.
Affordable and Reliable Imaging Services
We are your trusted partner for lab tests (radiology). With over 350 diagnostic
centres across 30+ cities, we have access to experienced and dedicated radiology test specialists
committed to delivering accurate results.
Herbved - Ayurveda based all natural health supplements
Herbved has a range of trusted Ayurvedic supplements that are crafted from 100% pure natural herbs
with no artificial substitutes or chemicals, ensuring authenticity and safety.
Unique Features of Healthians App
Our app offers more than just a platform to book full body checkups! Consider us your wellness buddy!
● Health tracker to track your weight, BP, and sugar
● Health Karma for your personalised health score
● Step & Calorie Tracker
● Health & nutrition articles
● Instant booking with complete order tracking for blood tests at home.
● Smart Reports with Personalised Diet Plan
● Special offers for Friends & Family
● Wellio - Your Personal Health Assistant - AI-based chatbot that’s capable of answering health-
related queries, recommending suitable lab tests and blood tests at home, helping provide
comprehensive health solutions.
To stay tuned about the latest happenings, follow us on:
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/Healthians/
Twitter - https://twitter.com/healthians
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/healthians/
Liked our app? Please support us by rating us on the app store.
Have any feedback to share? We’re all ears! Write to us at AppSupport@healthians.com

my MEO app, the easiest way to manage your MEO services

 1. Offers designed with you in mind 
See, in our stories, all the offers we designed with you and your family in mind.

Explore our products, apps and services, inside and outside the home, and have the best experience with MEO.  
 3. Manages services for the entire family 
Check your services or those of your family members, change tariffs or sign up for more services, such as Premium Channels, Netflix, Disney+ and much more. If your internet ran out before the renewal date, no problem. Buy more net and always stay connected.  
 4. View and pay your invoice 
Check your invoices and keep everything organized in one place. Activate direct debit or pay securely directly in the app. If you have any doubts, our invoice comparator helps you find out what has changed compared to the previous month.

At any time, you know what you have available, what you have already consumed and the renewal date for your net, SMS or minutes allowances. Define the limits for extra spending on your monthly fee and which services you want to have active

 7. View your contract information 
Consult and update ownership, privacy and billing data. See your contract and loyalty period  
 8. Check your cell phones PIN and PUK 
Check the PIN and PUK of your cell phones and activate 2nd copies of your card.

Go to your Profile and access all the support channels we have for you. If you need help on a more detailed topic, see the frequently asked questions, participate in our user community or find out where to find our stores and Support Lines.  
 10. Track the status of your orders 
Create requests and check the status of support requests you have made in notifications in your customer area 
With my MEO, managing your account and services is easy. Download it now and simplify your life with MEO.

bluejetty:00187516:ios.description:
Lavu is a feature-rich, modern, and easy-to-use restaurant management system that ensures everything in your restaurant runs quickly, efficiently, and accurately. It streamlines your operations while simplifying restaurant management and improving the customer experience.
Using Lavu POS's sleek and user-friendly interface, your restaurant staff can seamlessly clock in, place orders, perform customer checkouts, email receipts, and more. This eliminates the need to run tickets to the kitchen, allowing for more time with the customer and leading to higher sales!
Lavu POS is designed to accommodate national restaurant chains as well as individual food trucks, nightclubs, coffee shops, etc. Lavu POS was the very first full-featured restaurant POS App in the App Store and continues to lead the revolution in innovation and integration. With detailed reports, mobile ordering processing, and wireless printing all working in sync, Lavu POS is much more than a POS app. It is a smart and complete restaurant management solution that you can control and customize with ease.
Utilizing the Lavu control panel, you can change the layout of your restaurant, update the menu, and perform other administrative functions online. Any changes you make through the control panel are updated with a one button click on Lavu POS. This type of control makes your restaurant more efficient, flexible, and independent.
That is why Lavu POS is trusted by thousands of customers, in 65 different countries.

bluejetty:00069830:ios.description:
Know exactly when every photo was taken.
Timestamp Camera adds a clear date and time watermark to new photos or images from your gallery — so your memories never get mixed up.
Whether you're tracking your diet, workouts, study routine, baby's growth, or project progress, a simple timestamp makes every photo easier to remember and compare. Perfect for meal tracking, body transformation, parenting milestones, construction updates, and daily journaling.
KEY FEATURES
• Add date & time stamps anywhere on your photos
• Choose from 26+ premium timestamp styles (Normal, Simple, Slim, Digital, Woowahan & more)
• Customize font color to match your photo
• Import photos from your gallery and add stamps
• Save directly to Camera Roll and share to Instagram, WhatsApp & social media
• Protect your photos with a passcode lock
HOW TO USE
1. Take a photo or choose from your gallery
2. Pick your favorite timestamp style (26+ styles)
3. Adjust color and position
4. Save to your Camera Roll
5. Share on social media if you'd like
WHY YOU NEED TIMESTAMPS
When you move or back up photos, file dates can change. A photo taken in 2022 might show as 2026. With Timestamp Camera, the date and time are written directly on the photo — so you always know when that moment happened.
WHO USES TIMESTAMP CAMERA
• Diet & Fitness — Track body changes, workouts, and meals over time. Perfect for weight loss, muscle gain, and healthy eating habits
• Parents & Moms — Document baby growth and create a timeline of memories. Record first steps, milestones, and everyday moments
• Students — Mark daily study sessions or notes for easier review. Track study progress and exam preparation
• Events & Projects — Document events, construction, or project stages and share with clients. Perfect for builders, event planners, and freelancers
• Photographers & Travelers — Show how the same place looks across different seasons or times. Create before/after comparisons
CAMERA FEATURES
• Clear, bright photos using front or rear camera
• High-resolution zoom for detailed shots
• Flash support for low-light conditions
• White balance control for better colors
• HD quality photos with no quality loss
PREMIUM TIMESTAMP STYLES
Access 26+ beautiful timestamp designs:
• 7 free styles (Normal, Simple, Mini, Amatic, Glypha, Barunpen, Box)
• 19 premium styles including Slim Pack (6), Woowahan Pack (6), Digital Clock Pack (6)
• Anniversary style for special dates
• Custom colors and positioning for all styles
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
• Unlock all premium timestamp styles with Timestamp Premium
• Remove all ads for a clean experience
• 7-day free trial available
• Cancel anytime before renewal
• Monthly and yearly plans available
MORE
• Lightweight, simple design that's easy to use
• No reduction in photo quality
• Year Review feature to look back on your photos
• Stable and responsive during normal use
• Regular updates with new styles
• Available in 10+ languages
Perfect for: photo journaling, meal prep tracking, workout logs, baby books, project documentation, before/after photos, daily habits, goal tracking, memory keeping, and every moment worth remembering.
Download Timestamp Camera and start adding real dates to real moments.

bluejetty:00089592:ios.description:

HOW TRAINEST COACH WORKS
Real Human Coach
Text or call your coach when you're stuck. Get real answers, not automated responses.
Custom Plan That Adapts
Your coach builds and updates your program based on your actual results, not a generic template.
14-Day Coaching Period On Us

WHAT YOU GET
Today Plan

Unlike apps that only do one thing, Trainest gives you coaching, workouts, nutrition, and tracking in one place.

bluejetty:00161337:ios.description:
Take control of your home security with this camera monitoring app!
Still worried about the unknown status of your home? This app allows you to monitor your home's network security, supporting over 1,000+ models!
Easily find camera devices:
With just one click, scan your network and discover camera devices at your current location. Our app goes beyond basic monitoring. It uses a unique approach that combines Bluetooth and Wi-Fi network scanning to identify connected devices. We then analyze the collected MAC addresses and leverage cloud-based data to reveal detailed device information, including name, type, and manufacturer.
Comprehensive Detection Features:
Network Scanner: Identifies devices on Wi-Fi and Bluetooth networks to prevent unauthorized access.
Detailed Device Analysis: In-depth inspection of connected devices to identify any signs of unauthorized connection.
Magnetic Field Detection: This feature helps pinpoint device location by identifying unusual magnetic field interference.
Peace of mind at your fingertips:
With this app, you can control your personal space and be assured of your privacy.
Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew based on your selected plan. You can turn off auto-renewal at any time by visiting your Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00080871:ios.description:
#### App Store Editor's Choice
#### App Store Featured Recommendation
#### App Store Selected Activities
OtterLife is your personalized health management partner!
It helps you automatically track over ten types of health data such as sleep, exercise, stress, menstrual cycle, and water intake. It also provides professional data analysis and a variety of watch widgets, with gamified methods to help you easily develop healthy habits.
Have you ever encountered these problems?
- Always procrastinating, with no plan, and unable to stick to changes?
- Having unhealthy habits like staying up late, sitting for long periods, or lack of activity, but unable to break them?
- Feeling anxious and mentally drained, with each day being exhausting?
That's why we developed 'OtterLife', to help you focus on your health data and cultivate healthy habits through gamified check-ins.
Here's how to use OtterLife:
- Track over 10 health data points comprehensively to better understand your body
- Monitor stress changes, understand emotional fluctuations in time, and avoid mental exhaustion!
- Break down complex goals into daily tasks, making habit formation easier
- Unlock more accessories and items for your pet otter by completing health tasks, making self-discipline as addictive as a game!
Fully compatible with WatchOS 26:
- Watch face widget support: HRV stress detection, real-time calorie deficit, real-time metabolic rate
- Watch app functionality support: sleep analysis, stress detection, water intake recording, calorie deficit recording, activity rings, step management, and body energy expenditure analysis
【Description of Otter Life App membership service】
1. Membership includes several subscription types
Subscription period: 1 month, 12 months
2. The first subscription will be paid directly through iTunes account; the account will be charged within 24 hours before the expiration date, and the subscription period will be automatically postponed after the successful deduction.
3. You can choose whether to renew the subscription or not, if you want to cancel, please cancel in the AppleID settings 24 hours before the subscription expires.
4.Otter Life App Membership Agreement
Otter Life App Membership Service Agreement: https://post.jellow.club/otterlife-payment-en/
5.Otter Life App Software User Agreement and Privacy Policy
Otter Life Software License and Service Agreement: https://post.jellow.club/otterlife-agreement-en/
Otter Life Privacy Agreement: https://post.jellow.club/otterlife-privacy-en/

Master English & Korean through the content you love! Join 100 million users worldwide and start your language journey with BTS, K-POP stars, and your favorite K-Dramas. Whether you're a beginner or an advanced learner, Cake makes language learning "deliciously" easy with free daily updates.
Master Korean with K-Culture
Finally, a fun way to learn Korean! No more boring textbooks.
Learn with BTS & K-POP: Dive into lyrics and content from BTS, SEVENTEEN and other top artists. Understand what your idols are saying in interviews and vlogs!
• K-Drama Immersion: Practice real-life Korean using iconic scenes from trending K-Dramas.
• From Hangul to Fluency: We provide a structured path to help you master Korean.
It’s Fun & Addictive
• Celebrity & Vlogger Content: Learn from the creators you already follow.
• Cake Originals: Enjoy exclusive, high-quality content produced by our language experts.
Speak Like a Native

• AI Pronunciation Coach: Record your voice and let our AI analyze your accent. Get instant feedback to sound just like a local!
• Step-by-Step 'Classes': Master Hangul or jump into curated classes—from K-Dramas to Business English.
Just 10 Minutes a Day
• Daily Goals: Set your target and feel the rush of achievement.
• Smart Revision: Save favorite sentences and words. Our fun quizzes ensure you never forget what you've learned.
Cake’s Exclusive Features
• Daily Expression Clips: Freshly curated phrases added every day.
• Original Lectures: Top-tier English & Korean lessons found only on Cake.
• Speak & Conversation: Practice listening and speaking with immersive audio sessions.
Level Up with Cake Plus
• Experience the ultimate learning environment:
• Unlimited Hearts (No more waiting!)
• Ad-free experience.
• Access to exclusive Plus-only content and unlimited word/sentence saves.
Use Cake daily and watch your English & Korean skills skyrocket!

bluejetty:00075555:ios.description:
The original timeless classic: Hill Climb Racing is now available on Apple Arcade! Race your way uphill in this physics based driving game, playable offline!
Meet Bill, the young aspiring uphill racer. He is about to embark on a journey that takes him to where no ride has ever been before. With little respect to the laws of physics, Bill will not rest until he has conquered the highest hills up on the moon!
Face challenges in unique hill climbing environments with a wide variety of cars to choose from. Gain prizes from daring tricks and collect coins to upgrade your car and travel further distances. Watch out though - Bill's neck is not what it used to be when he was a kid! And his good old gasoline crematorium will easily run out of fuel.
Features:
New Content
We are still actively developing Hill Climb Racing+ and adding new vehicles, new stages and new content! 
Unique Vehicles
Get behind the wheel of a wide variety of different vehicles. From the iconic Hill Climber to bikes, race cars, trucks and even some outlandish vehicles such as the creepy Carantula! Half car, half tarantula, do you dare drive it?
Play Offline
Race offline whenever and wherever you want!
Wacky Stages
Each stage in Hill Climb Racing+ is a unique challenge for you to overcome with vastly different terrains and styles. How far can you reach in each stage?
Unlock and Upgrade
Tune up and fix your dream vehicle with custom parts, skins and upgrades!
Simulated Physics
We worked hard on creating a one of a kind in-game physics system where your vehicles will react to the terrain in a unique manner, can you use this to your advantage and conquer the hills? 
Daily challenges and events
Tackle the daily challenges and events to earn epic rewards! 
Remember that we're always reading your feedback and are hard at work creating new content and fixing any issues you may find. Please feel free to report what you like or dislike or any other issues you may have with the game to support@fingersoft.com.

* Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@FingersoftLtd

Privacy Policy: https://fingersoft.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00033452:ios.description:
What is this? How much is it worth? Where can I buy it cheaper? Snap a photo and Lens AI answers in seconds.
Lens AI is an AI-powered visual search and image recognition app for iPhone that helps you search what you see. Take a photo, upload an image, or scan a screenshot to identify objects, plants, animals, and insects, estimate value, find products, compare prices, translate text, and run a reverse image search. Just point, scan, and discover. 500K+ downloads and 5M+ items scanned.
► SEARCH WHAT YOU SEE
Use your camera as a search engine. Ask "what is this?" and get instant answers about everyday objects, artworks and landmarks, with a confidence score on every result.
► IDENTIFY PLANTS, ANIMALS & INSECTS
- What is this plant? Identify plants, flowers, trees and mushrooms, with care tips.
- What breed is this dog? Recognize dog and cat breeds, birds, fish, and wild animals.
- Is this bug harmful? The bug identifier shows if insects and spiders are harmless or dangerous.
► KNOW WHAT IT'S WORTH
Is this coin rare? What era is this antique from? How much is it worth? Lens App estimates the value of coins, banknotes, antiques, watches, and collectibles based on comparable listings online. Perfect for flea markets.
► SHOP BY IMAGE & FIND THE LOOK
See something you like? Find this dress, those sneakers or that chair from a photo. Shop by screenshot from Instagram, find similar clothes, bags, jewelry and home decor, and compare prices in your local currency.
► REVERSE IMAGE SEARCH
Search by image instead of words. Search images by picture to find the source of a photo, similar images and related information online, then search this photo with AI to learn what is in it.
► PHOTO TRANSLATOR
Translate signs, menus, documents and labels with your camera in real time, in about 40 languages. Perfect when traveling abroad.
► FOOD SCANNER & ASK AI
Snap a meal to see calories, macros and recipes. Every result includes an AI chat for follow-up questions.
HOW TO USE LENS AI
1. Point your camera at anything, or upload a photo or screenshot.
2. Object recognition analyzes shape, color and texture.
3. Get the name, facts, value or best price, usually in about 5 seconds.
4. Ask AI to learn more or save it to History.
WHY LENS AI
- All-in-one AI Lens app: a photo identifier, bug identifier, coin identifier, rock identifier, calorie counter, photo translator and product finder in one image search app.
- More than just names: answers with context, value, care tips and where to buy, not just links.
- Made for gardeners, pet owners, collectors, shoppers, travelers, parents and kids.
QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK
How do I identify something from a photo?
Take or upload a picture in Lens AI. AI image recognition identifies it and explains what it is.
How do I search by image on iPhone?
Use a photo, your camera or a screenshot in Lens AI for visual search and reverse image search.
Can I find a product from a screenshot?
Yes. Lens AI finds the same or similar products and compares prices across stores.
How much is my coin or antique worth?
Lens AI identifies coins, antiques and collectibles and estimates their value from comparable listings.
ACCURACY & PRIVACY
Best with clear, well-lit photos. For safety decisions, such as eating wild mushrooms, consult an expert. Photos are processed only for your scan and deleted right after analysis, never sold. Your History stays on your device and can be deleted anytime.
---
AI Lens App is available on iOS for iPhone and iPad. Lens App uses computer vision and multimodal AI to understand what appears inside a photo.
Privacy: https://allscanai.com/privacy/
Terms: https://allscanai.com/terms/
Site: LensApp.io

AnagrApp Cup: The Ultimate Word Puzzle Experience
Looking for a fun way to challenge your brain? AnagrApp Cup is the perfect word game to train your mind, improve vocabulary, and enjoy relaxing brain puzzles. Whether you love word search games, anagram puzzmes, or brain-training activities, this app has it all!
HOW TO PLAY
The rules are simple: uncover hidden words by tapping letters or swiping across them to connect. With no timers or pressure, this game is perfect for a stress-free brain workout.
KEY FEATURES
- Boost Your Mind: Improve memory, concentration, spelling, and problem-solving skills.
- Ad-Free Fun: Play without interruptions—no ads, just pure word puzzle enjoyment.
- Offline Gameplay: No Wi-Fi? No worries! Play anytime, anywhere.
- 2200+ Levels: Tackle puzzles from 3 to 13 letters with increasing difficulty.
- Multilingual Play: Choose from 10 languages—English, Spanish, French, Italian, German, and more. Progress in each language is saved separately.
- Easy to Replay: Revisit completed levels for more practice and fun.
- Simple and Clean: Designed for relaxation, with an uncluttered interface.
Perfect for Players Looking for a Relaxing and Enriching Experience
AnagrApp Cup is ideal for seniors and others who want to keep their minds sharp and engaged. It’s a fantastic way to strengthen memory, discover new words, and stay mentally active in a calm and enjoyable way. Play this visually pleasing anagram game specially designed for relaxation and mental agility.
DAILY BRAIN CHALLENGES
Enjoy puzzles every day of the week. From Monday to Sunday, there’s always a fresh word puzzle waiting for you.
Extra Features
- Hints When Needed: Use hints to reveal letters if you get stuck.
- Rich Word Library: Includes verbs, nouns, and more for endless fun.
Why You’ll Love It
- Combines word search, anagrams, and brain exercises into one engaging game.
- Helps improve vocabulary, spelling, and mental agility in a fun and relaxing way.
- Great for relaxing alone or playing with friends and family.
Play at Your Own Pace
With no time limits or pressure, AnagrApp Cup offers a soothing way to relax while keeping your brain sharp.
Download for Free
Train your brain and explore a captivating word game today. Discover how many words you can find!
AnagrApp Cup is free, but you have the option to buy in-app items such as hints. AnagrApp Cup also offers the following subscription options to get hints every week at the best price: $1.99* weekly and $3.99* weekly. *Prices displayed are USD$, actual charges might be converted to local currency depending on your country of residence.

bluejetty:00188145:ios.description:
Experience a life-transforming awakening of the peace, joy, and wisdom of the soul through the teachings of Paramahansa Yogananda, author of the spiritual classic Autobiography of a Yogi. 
The SRF/YSS app is for everyone—whether you are brand new to the teachings of Paramahansa Yogananda or have been immersing yourself in this great teacher’s wisdom for decades. It is also for anyone who wants to learn more about meditation, the science of Kriya Yoga, and practical ways to live a spiritually balanced life. 
Featuring:
- Guided Meditations on Peace, Living Fearlessly, God as Light, Expansion of Consciousness, and more — with customizable meditation times from 15 to 45 minutes
- Free access to live online meditations
- SRF/YSS News and Event Information
For those who are students of the SRF/YSS Lessons, the app includes the digital versions of your Lessons along with a rich variety of multimedia content to help you apply the SRF/YSS Kriya Yoga teachings in your daily life.
Including:
- Audio recordings of Paramahansa Yogananda
- Guided meditations and visualizations led by SRF/YSS monastics
- Classes on the SRF/YSS meditation techniques
- Step-by-step video instruction in the SRF/YSS Energization Exercises
If you are an SRF or YSS Lessons student, please use your verified account information to access the Lessons in the app.
About SRF/YSS
Self-Realization Fellowship and Yogoda Satsanga Society of India are an invitation to the spiritual seeker to journey together on a life-transforming discovery of the soul. This journey embraces the “how-to-live” teachings of Paramahansa Yogananda, which embody the highest techniques for realizing who we truly are and show how to bring lasting peace, joy, and love into our lives and into the world. The goal of SRF and YSS is to offer not just a course of philosophical study, but the actual transmission of sacred knowledge through the living words of one of the great spiritual masters of the modern era.
Yogoda Satsanga Society of India was founded in 1917 by Paramahansa Yogananda. Self-Realization Fellowship was founded by Paramahansa Yogananda in 1920, to spread the teachings of Kriya Yoga worldwide.

bluejetty:00183536:ios.summary:
Take control of your banking. Our app makes your day-to-day banking easy, quick and secure.
Join us quickly and easily
Why the Ulster app?
• Open a new account and complete your application seamlessly within the app, whenever and wherever
bluejetty:00183536:ios.description:
Take control of your banking. Our app makes your day-to-day banking easy, quick and secure.
Join us quickly and easily
Why the Ulster app?
• Open a new account and complete your application seamlessly within the app, whenever and wherever it suits you. 
• Verify your identity securely using your passport or driving licence, with simple guided steps throughout the journey.
• Set up your digital banking access quickly, including creating your login credentials and getting ready to manage your money.
• Enjoy a secure, intuitive experience designed to make joining Ulster Bank and managing your finances as straightforward as possible.
Manage your money easily and securely:
• Apply for current, savings, child, teen, Premier, and student accounts quickly. Eligibility criteria apply. 
• See all your bank accounts straight from your Home screen.
• Freeze and unfreeze your card at any time (Mastercard only).
• Use pots to set money aside from your main account for everyday needs and to stay in control of your spending.
• Set up fingerprint, voice or facial recognition for better security and to send high value payments in-app, amend payment limits and more. Fingerprint, voice or facial recognition are only available on selected devices.
Send, receive and access money quickly:
• Request money via a QR code or link.
• Send money faster with a personalised list of favourite payees.
• Split a bill up to £500 by sharing a payment request link with multiple people at once. (Eligible current accounts only. Payment requests can be sent to anyone with an eligible account with a participating UK bank and uses online or mobile banking. Paying bank criteria and limits may apply.)
• iPhone only: Get Cash in emergencies with a unique code without using your card. You can withdraw up to £130 every 24 hours at our branded ATMs. You must have at least £10 available in your account and an active debit card (locked or unlocked).
Stay on top of your spending and saving:
• Keep track of payments all in one place.
• Save your spare change with Round Ups if you have an eligible current account and instant access savings account. Round Ups can only be made on debit card and contactless payments in Sterling.
• Budget easily by managing your monthly spending and set categories.
• Turn on push notifications to get alerted when money reaches or leaves your account.
Get support for every life event:
• Spend abroad in Euros and US Dollars without fees or charges by applying for a Travel account. You must have enough money in your travel account. To apply for a Travel account, you need an eligible sole current account and to be over 18. Other terms and fees may apply.
• Get updates on your credit score and insight on how to improve it. Your credit score data is provided by TransUnion and is only available to customers over 18, with a UK address.
• Discover our additional products and services, including mortgages, home and life insurance and loans, in one place.
• Fast track your money goals with the help of our handy plans, tools and tips.
Important info
Please note, the app contains images when logging in that may cause a reaction in individuals who are photosensitive. You can switch these off for your device by visiting the settings menu and the accessibility menu, where you will be able to find motion and visual control settings within the menu (note this is not within our app, but in the settings of your device itself).
Our app is available to customers aged 11+ with a UK or international mobile number in specific countries. Be aware that some features and products have age restrictions and are only available if you’re over 16 or 18.
By downloading this app, you’re accepting our Terms and Conditions, which can be viewed at ulsterbank.co.uk/mobileterms.
Please save or print a copy along with the Privacy Policy for your record.

bluejetty:00014669:ios.description:
With RyderDrive, we are revolutionizing the way we record and communicate the massive amounts of data that are shared between our drivers, location managers, Ryder hubs, customers, and regulating agencies every day. By automating and digitizing this information, RyderDrive enables higher accuracy of data while driving efficiency in our operations, as well as improving the experience for our drivers.
The app enables all driver centric communication around dispatch, in-transit collaboration, delivery execution, and trip completion. In addition to driver communication, RyderDrive allows for document management critical to the driver for seamless communication to the operations.
With RyderDrive, drivers will be able to utilize the mobile application to build efficiencies around trip management and driver workflow with features that are crucial in complying with the Electronic Logging Device (ELD) Mandate. The RyderDrive features include;
- Hours of Service Recording
- Digital Trip Management
- Document capture
- Driver Payroll
- NewsFeed
- Trip Navigation
- Messaging
- Electronic Driver Vehicle Inspection Report

Introducing "Workout Planner - Gym Routine," the ultimate companion for your fitness journey whether you're hitting the gym or working out at home. With a blend of simplicity and effectiveness, this app helps you achieve your goals and make lasting progress.

• Comprehensive Exercise Library
Access over 500+ exercises with detailed instructions and high-resolution videos, ensuring you perform each movement correctly and safely. Whether you're aiming to build muscle, gain strength, or lose weight, find the perfect exercises to target specific muscle groups.

• Intuitive Tracking and Optimization
Track your progress effortlessly with intuitive workout tracking features. From sets and reps to weights lifted, every detail is captured to help you monitor your performance and make informed decisions. 

• Create custom Routine with AI
Create personalized workout routines tailored to your goals in just a few taps! Whether you’re focusing on strength, endurance, or flexibility, our AI-powered builder crafts the perfect plan for you. Stay motivated with routines designed just for you!

• Flexible Workout Options
Choose from a wide range of workout modifiers to customize each session according to your preferences and needs. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced lifter, create routines tailored to your skill level and training style.

Take charge of your fitness goals like never before with "Workout Planner - Gym Routine." Download now and embark on a journey to a stronger, healthier you.

bluejetty:00013839:ios.description:
BambooHR is online HR software for small and medium-sized businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets. We automate many of the most tedious HR functions and free you up to do meaningful work. The BambooHR app lets you take some of those most important functions with you, and makes your most common tasks in BambooHR simple and fast.
* In order to do anything with the BambooHR app you will need a current BambooHR account. Find out more on our website.
* The app fully supports single sign-on (SAML) to login
Your Company Directory, Everywhere You Go
Your company’s phone numbers, emails, photos, titles—your whole company directory goes wherever you do. 
* See colleague’s information and call, email, or message them with a tap
* Quickly add someone’s info to your phone’s contacts
Plan and Manage Time Off
Planning a trip? Request time off when you’re out and about. Leave requests can be submitted in the app, and if you’re an approver, you can approve them there as well.
* See who’s out of the office today and on any future date
* See current and calculate your future time off balances
* Submit, view, edit, and comment on your time off requests
* Approve and deny time off requests
* Push notifications keep you in the loop on the status of your requests
And don’t worry, TouchID and passcode protection will help keep your information secure.
Happy Bambooing!

bluejetty:00063407:ios.name: Fruit Ninja®
bluejetty:00063407:ios.summary:
Slice fruit, don’t slice bombs – that’s all you need to know to get started with addictive Fruit Ninja action! 
No matter how you like to play, the free version of the game is packed with features to satisfy your fruit-destroying appetite.
bluejetty:00063407:ios.description:
Slice fruit, don’t slice bombs – that’s all you need to know to get started with addictive Fruit Ninja action! 
No matter how you like to play, the free version of the game is packed with features to satisfy your fruit-destroying appetite.
Challenge yourself and see how long you can last in Classic mode, set a high score in Arcade mode or simply practise your fruit-slicing skills in Zen mode. A wide range of blades and dojos are at your disposal to help you cut your way to the top. Want more fun? Take a break and experience a new way to slice your favourite fruit with minigames, or test your mastery of the game and win prizes in the daily Challenge event. Go head-to-head and show off your skills as the ultimate ninja against your friends with leaderboards and local multiplayer.
Up for a real challenge? Play Event mode and do battle against other ninjas for the chance to win unique blades and dojos. 
That’s not all though - give yourself the edge by logging in every day and be rewarded with daily prizes, including rare blades and dojos that you can use in other game modes!
There has never been a better time to play Fruit Ninja, so unsheathe your sword and get ready for an addictive, action-packed gaming experience!
IMPORTANT NOTICE
This game contains optional in-app purchases. You can disable this feature in the settings menu of your device.
View our privacy policy at http://halfbrick.com/pp
View our terms of service at http://halfbrick.com/tos
Need help with the game? Email us at fruitninja@halfbrick.com

bluejetty:00062897:ios.name: iZurvive - DayZ Maps
bluejetty:00062897:ios.summary: iZurvive provides you with DayZ, Arma 3 and Arma Reforger maps including loot spawns, landmarks and city names. Join a group with your friends and coordinate your gameplay with shared markers and shapes on the map. Always updated with the m
bluejetty:00062897:ios.description:
iZurvive provides you with DayZ, Arma 3 and Arma Reforger maps including loot spawns, landmarks and city names. Join a group with your friends and coordinate your gameplay with shared markers and shapes on the map. Always updated with the maps and information of the latest patch.
MAPS - 
The app contains high-resolution maps for Chernarus, Livonia and Sakhal as well as community made maps like Namalsk, Deer Isle, Chiemsee, Rostow, Esseker, Takistan, Banov, Swans Island and Pripyat. Many more maps for Arma 3, Arma Reforger and the original DayZ Mod are also available. 
Most of the maps are available as satellite or topographic versions.
NAVIGATION - 
Navigate the map via landmarks, town signs and images of buildings. Entered a town but not sure where you are? Search for the city name in the map search.
Use the distance measurement to accurately zero your scope or to plan your next route including the travel time.
LOOT - 
Find the gear and food you need by filtering the map for certain loot spawns. Learn more about a specific loot spot with detailed information like images and categories of items which are able to spawn.
TEAMWORK -
Join a group with your teammates! You can place markers and mark areas on the map which will be instantly synchronized with everyone in your group. Locating and coordinating your team in the huge open world of DayZ and Arma 3 has never been easier.
WIKI -
All guns & weapons available in the game with detailed information about ammo & attachments and where you can find them.
COMMUNITIES - 
Looking for people to play with? Browse through an extensive list of diverse communities and join one that looks interesting to you.
What other DayZ players are saying about iZurvive:
“This is the best app ever 4 dayz always updated and innovative” - Run-tmt
“This app has been a life saver so many times in game. I just started playing a week ago and idk what I would do without iZurvive.” - Pandamonium502
“This app let me find the boys and finally we are together” - dinocooper
“This is a great app for dayz maps and more. It’s a go to anytime I am lost or need a route to plan out. Simply the best! Fully customizable to meet your needs and what you want on your screen.” - Kase da ace
For any questions, or if you feel that we should really have a certain feature in the next version, please contact us: support@izurvive.com
This app is not affiliated with Bohemia Interactive.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00185232:ios.name: Lords & Knights - Mobile Kings
bluejetty:00185232:ios.summary: Strategic alliances with other players, fierce campaigns and wars as well as massive fortresses await you in Lords & Knights! Trade, complete missions and discover technologies. Recruit armies of noble knights to protect your castle or conq
bluejetty:00185232:ios.description:
Strategic alliances with other players, fierce campaigns and wars as well as massive fortresses await you in Lords & Knights! Trade, complete missions and discover technologies. Recruit armies of noble knights to protect your castle or conquer other cities.
Conquer an empire and make your enemies quiver before you.
Lords & Knights is a free to play medieval strategy MMO. At first you take control of one castle and it’s knights. As time goes by, you can expand your realm all the way to an empire with the right strategy. Conquer the cities of your enemies and become the most powerful ruler of the medieval times.
RAISE A POWERFUL ARMY AND LEAD IT INTO WAR!
Recruit several medieval units like knights and foot soldiers. Lead them into battle against other lords with the right strategy and tactics, or send them on lucrative missions. Among these missions, you will find adventures such as driving off robbers, taking part in a joust or hold a castle festival in honor of your empire.
CONSTRUCTION AND DEVELOPMENT OF YOUR CASTLES INTO MASSIVE FORTRESSES
Improve your simple starting castle all the way to a powerful fortress. You can stock up on resources for the war in your keep, while you are coming up with tactics and strategies for the upcoming battles. Strengthen your armies by improving your armory and researching new technologies. Improve the defense of your realm by erecting fortifications or improve your resource production. Strategy and tactics are an important part of the creation of your defense and you decide on them as the king!
AN ALLIANCE SYSTEM THAT FACILITATES JOINT CONQUESTS
Found an alliance or join an existing one, in order to plan the strategy and construction of your medieval empire with hundreds of other players. You can forge non aggression treaties and great alliances with other alliances or march into war together. You can take on different roles within these alliances, for example that of the minister of war or of defense and exchange information with your friends other lords in the forum and the live alliance chat.
PEACEFUL REALM OR WARLIKE EMPIRE
Interact with other lords in order to plan attacks or set up your defense. You can support them with armies and resources. Defend each other throne! Should diplomacy fail, another solution would be a well planned war of conquest with numerous attacks on enemy cities. Send out your armies and plunder the resources of your enemy or assault his fortifications, conquer his castle and make it a part of your empire and expand your realm. Make sure that your most hated enemy won’t remain a king for long!
Show everyone that you have what it takes to be the king of an entire realm and conquer a throne!
Become a fan on Facebook: http://fb.com/lordsandknights
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lordsandknights/
The medieval strategy MMO Lords & Knights is free to play and needs an active internet connection.

bluejetty:00186497:ios.name: LexVid
bluejetty:00186497:ios.summary: Any LexVid member can use the LexVid app to stream or download CLE videos, and earn credit anywhere, anytime in every state where LexVid courses are accredited.Watch courses on your iPhone, iPod, or iPad. Download your courses ahead of time
bluejetty:00186497:ios.description:
Any LexVid member can use the LexVid app to stream or download CLE videos, and earn credit anywhere, anytime in every state where LexVid courses are accredited.Watch courses on your iPhone, iPod, or iPad. Download your courses ahead of time and earn CLE while on a plane or traveling without internet connection. Certificates are email, and credits are automatically reported once you're back online.
The features of the App were thoughtfully designed with you in mind:
• Traveling or commuting with no internet access? Download courses to your device for offline viewing
• Automatic uploading and syncing of offline activity when the app is back online
• Watch the course video and slides side-by-side or picture in picture
• Course progress is automatically synced across all of your computers and devices
• Earn credits in any state LexVid offers credits
Plus, the best features from the website are included too:
• Access the entire LexVid CLE library
• Track your CLE compliance including your specialty courses
• Watch courses anytime/anywhere - 24/7
• Receive instant certificates
• Earn CLE credits for multiple bar states from a single course
• Pause and resume courses at anytime
• Download and view course materials
• Participatory credit in California and interactive credit in Arizona
LexVid’s video-only CLE library covers 29 practice areas including hard-to-find Ethics, Elimination of Bias, and Competence Issues/Substance Abuse courses. Courses are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and 365 days a year. Take care of your CLE requirements on your schedule from the convenience of your home or office, and on the go.
Questions or comments?
support@lexvid.com

bluejetty:00073465:ios.description:
Microsoft Bing delivers fast, intelligently curated answers and makes it easier than ever to discover more. 
Introducing Copilot Search in Bing
Copilot Search in Bing brings AI to search where clear answers and key information are quickly curated at the top of your search results. Kickstart your next discovery with a new search to unlock the possibilities of where your curiosity can take you.
Unlock answers faster 
Copilot Search in Bing brings intelligence to search so you can spend less time searching and more time discovering. Depending on your query, you’ll get an easy-to-scan layout of information, a summary of the most critical points, or a clear answer. No more hunting across the web.
Explore deeper 
Need to dive deeper? The next answer or new angle is waiting for you with helpful web links and clickable follow-up topics. It brings the best of traditional and generative search together to help you find what you need – and discover more.
Discover confidently
Perfect for when you want to go heads-down to write a paper, learn something new, explore a passion project, or simply let your curiosity wonder. Choose from a variety of suggested queries to start your journey or simply start a new search to harness the power of AI to get curated results. 
Try Copilot Search in Bing today!
All the highlights
New homepage: Stay updated on topics you're following, and get quick access to Microsoft features
Copilot Search in Bing: Seamlessly find a topic to explore within your everyday search flow
Image Creator: Create images from words with AI
Visual search: Search right from your camera or by uploading a picture
Voice search: Tap the mic icon and use your voice to search
Microsoft Rewards: Earn more rewards is easy, simple, and fun. Just search with the Microsoft Bing app and you’ll earn faster than ever
Weather: See the forecast for today and the week ahead
Wallpaper: Pick from a collection of beautiful images featured on the Bing homepage
Functions mentioned above not available in all markets, actual features and display contents may vary.

bluejetty:00035823:ios.summary: The peaceful life with father is shattered by an unexpected tragedy. Father's death seems to hide a massive secret, leading you on a path of vengeance. However, when faced with the truth, you are in a dilemma. Will you stay true to your pri
bluejetty:00035823:ios.description:
The peaceful life with father is shattered by an unexpected tragedy. Father's death seems to hide a massive secret, leading you on a path of vengeance. However, when faced with the truth, you are in a dilemma. Will you stay true to your principles, or succumb to the demons within? In this 3D story puzzle game, you will find the answer!
Gameplay:
* Explore Panlong Village to uncover clues and essential items that reveal the truth behind your father's murder.
* The village is teeming with monsters. Defeating them grants you souls, which can be used to level up your character and allocate attribute points. If you're not strong enough to face the monsters, you can also choose to evade them to survive.
* Gather resources, herbs can be used to craft elixirs, and ores can be used to upgrade weapons.
* Choose from six different types of weapons: swords, spears, staffs, broadswords, dusters, and talismans. Draw the weapon that suits you best, upgrade it, and enhance your combat power.
* The game features numerous bosses. Defeating them will drop various equipment and magical artifacts. Equipping powerful gear will increase your attributes further.
* Learn spells from the five elements: gold, wood, water, fire, earth, and lightning, to enhance your skills.
* Strengthen your talents: acquire more talent attributes to become even stronger.
* Challenge the Demon-Sealing Tower, complete faction and daily quests to earn generous rewards.
Game Features:
* First-person perspective, experience every detail, feel the power of wielding your weapon, and the pressure of the surrounding environment for an immersive gameplay experience.
* Stunning 3D graphics provide a realistic visual experience.
* An engaging storyline that chronicles the character's journey of growth.
* Rich gameplay with high replayability.
* A variety of weapons to choose from, each with unique combat styles and effects. Switch freely and choose the weapon that suits you best.
* Spectacular spell effects and unique monsters for a deep combat experience.
* A larger open-world map with areas such as mines, caves, villages, and demon towers for you to explore.
* Horror music and eerie atmosphere, better with headphones
* Multiple difficulty levels to challenge your limits.
* Filled with Chinese cultural elements, offering a glimpse into the essence of Chinese culture.
Endless Nightmare: Reborn is a casual game that combines puzzle-solving, combat, adventure, and horror elements. Set in a village filled with mystery and strangeness, this game offers more content than its predecessor, such as master quests, daily quests, spells, weapons, equipment, talismans, and the Demon-Sealing Tower. The resources and rewards are also richer. If you enjoy trying out weapons beyond the traditional swords and spears, wish to experience the exquisitely beautiful 3D ancient Chinese scenery, witness spectacular spell effects, and face off against unique monsters, then you shouldn't miss this horror game. The diverse gameplay, stunning Chinese-style graphics, intense and thrilling battles, and suspense-filled puzzle elements will create a world full of mystery and challenges for you. Capture monsters in the world of Endless Nightmare!
Welcome to share your ideas with us!

bluejetty:00185307:ios.description:
Kernel is the movie and TV show tracker that counts down to every release and tells you where to watch it.
Add what you want to see to your watchlist, get a countdown and a reminder on release day, find out where it's streaming in your country, and rate it once you've seen it. Can't remember the title? Describe it and Kernel AI finds it.
RELEASE COUNTDOWNS
Add upcoming movies and shows and Kernel counts down the days on your Home Screen, Lock Screen and Apple Watch, then reminds you when they're out.
WHERE TO WATCH
See whether a movie or show is streaming, for rent or to buy on Netflix, Apple TV, Prime Video, Disney+, HBO Max and more, for the country you're in.
TOP 10 ON EVERY SERVICE
What's most popular right now on Netflix, Apple TV, Disney+, Prime Video and HBO Max.
KERNEL AI MOVIE FINDER
Forgot the name? Describe the plot, a scene or an actor and Kernel AI finds the movie or show.
RATE IT
Half-star ratings for movies, shows and every episode, plus the Kernel Rating from everyone else.
WATCHLIST AND PLAYLISTS
Seen, Upcoming and a playlist for every mood, synced with iCloud.
SHARE WITH FRIENDS
Send a movie, show or episode. The link opens straight in Kernel and shows a rich preview in Messages.
WIDGETS AND APPLE WATCH
Countdown, Up Next and Kernel AI widgets, a Control Center button, and an Apple Watch app with complications.
ON EVERY SCREEN
iPhone, Apple Watch, Apple TV and Apple Vision Pro, and made for iPhone Duo.
Kernel is a tracker and a guide. It doesn't play movies itself; it shows you where you can watch them.
Available in English and Spanish.
KERNEL PREMIUM
Kernel AI includes free searches every month. Kernel Premium unlocks unlimited Kernel AI searches and opens any title in its streaming app with one tap.
Kernel Premium is a weekly, monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it any time in your Apple Account settings.

bluejetty:00016138:ios.description:
Card Thief is a solitaire-style stealth card game that transforms your deck into a shadowy world of cunning heists and daring escapes.
Sneak through the darkness as a master thief. Extinguish torches, pickpocket guards, and steal precious treasure without getting caught. Every card you flip is a calculated risk. Every move could be your last.
From the makers of Card Crawl, the hit indie card dungeon crawler, Card Thief distills the tension of classic stealth games into a sleek, strategic card game you can play in minutes. Easy to learn, endlessly deep.
Plan. Steal. Escape. Repeat.
With a rich layer of tactical decision-making, risk/reward choices, and roguelike replayability, Card Thief is the perfect pick-up-and-play strategy card game for fans of stealth, puzzle games, and solo card games alike.
Features
- Solitaire-style stealth gameplay with no internet required
- 4 unique heists with distinct enemies, traps, and obstacles
- 12 unlockable and upgradable equipment cards with unique abilities
- Hire 10 thieves, each with special gameplay rules
- Mini deck-building mechanics for deep strategic customization
- Daily Heist mode with global leaderboards
- Roguelike replayability so every run plays differently
- Perfect session length of 2 to 3 minutes per game
- Offline play, great for travel

bluejetty:00060836:ios.description:
Agworld - Connecting The Industry. Agworld is the world’s leading collaborative farming solution that enables growers, crop consultants, farm staff, precision specialists and operation managers to truly work as one. Agworld’s planning and budgeting capabilities, data capture tools, farm maps, label and SDS library and communication tools improve your workflow and increase your production efficiency and profitability.
Agworld’s iPhone app is the most convenient way to access, capture, manage and share your farm data from anywhere. The online / offline app allows you to get things done while in the field, even without an internet connection. The app automatically syncs all your information to your secure account once you are back in range.
For consultants and advisors:
- Record your observations and recommendations quickly using an app that is designed to be used in the field.
- Get an overview of your grower’s information, activities, yield and sampling result layers for truly powerful in-field decision making.
- Built-in rate checking system and offline access to the latest product labels and SDS when you need it.
- Write your common recommendations once using templates and share them with your new staff or existing colleagues for fast and accurate rec-writing.
- End-to-end work order management workflow from Precision to Application
- Transfer variable rate controller files from your iPhone to your machines using Sandisk iXpand Lightning / USB drive.
- Map your client’s fields by driving around a boundary and get turn by turn GPS directions to the location of your jobs.
For growers:
- View your interactive farm maps, yield and sampling results created by your Agworld advisors with just a few taps.
- Discover field insights by comparing yield data, total cost to date, the number of jobs due and your planned/actual gross margin across all your fields, right on the maps page.
- Map your fields by driving around its boundary.
- Receive recommendations and work orders from your consultant in real time.
- See your to-do, done and draft jobs for a quick way to stay on top of your tasks.
- Use the handy library to look up product labels and SDS.
- Accurately calculate your tank mix using the built in calculator.
- Convert individual fields into actuals from multiple field recommendations.
- Filter multiple job stages such as recommendations and work orders, at the same time.

bluejetty:00171982:ios.description:
Strongbox Pro is available here for outright and upfront purchase instead of via an In-App Purchase upgrade. This version of Strongbox is identical to the much loved Strongbox application with all the Pro features and the same regular update schedule.
Strongbox is an application for keeping all your passwords safely stored and protected by one master password. Supporting the open source Password Safe and KeePass formats. 
*** Supports Family Sharing ***
*** Features ***
- Face ID/Touch ID Unlock for the ultimate in convenience, security and speed.
- PIN Code Unlock with a Duress PIN option for those tricky situations.
- Passkey support - The latest, most convenient and most secure authentication method (passkeys).
- YubiKey protection - secure your databases with a hardware token.
- Secure - protected by time tested military grade cryptography.
- Private - Isolated In-App attachments viewer for your sensitive documents, photos & videos.
- Audit your passwords - Automatically check your database for weak passwords including a 'Have I Been Pwned?' check.
- Cloud Support, so you can access your cloud safes using iCloud, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive, WebDAV or SFTP even when offline. Use the built in Files app for many other storage options or store them securely only on your local device. You choose your storage.
- Search your entire set of passwords and secrets instantly and powerfully, with deep search. Autocomplete new entries, and auto generate secure passwords. 
- Compatible - Import/Export by Files app, Email, CSV, iTunes File Sharing or use cloud storage.
- Standards compliant - using the time tested Password Safe and KeePass formats so you can import any existing password safe you have.
- Features galore 
 - Incredibly configurable password generation including Diceware (XKCD) & regular passwords.
 - Timed Auto Clear Clipboard.
 - Entry History.
 - KeePass Field References, Tags, Custom Icon & FavIcons (including automatic search & download).
 - Two Factor Authentication codes (TOTP) - QR Code, Steam & Manual.
---------------------------------------------------------------------
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Strongbox Privacy Policy may be found here: https://strongboxsafe.com/privacy-policy/
• Strongbox Terms of Use may be found here: https://strongboxsafe.com/terms/

bluejetty:00177314:ios.description:
A fun game designed to help children learn the alphabet and basic reading skills, as well as learn colors and shape names.
The purpose of the game is to introduce children to the letters of the alphabet and help them begin to read syllables. Each level is a new task in which children memorize the spelling and sound of letters, paint shapes and learn colors, developing their skills with each stage they complete.
~ Letters and sounds ~
Coloring letters, spelling words, and listening activities will help children develop writing skills and learn the alphabet. With fun and colorful tasks, your child will be able to quickly master the alphabet and learn to read.
~ Colors and shapes ~
Learning about colors and shapes is an important part of preschool education. Children will be able to color interesting pictures with a variety of animals, develop fine motor skills, and also learn the names of colors and geometric shapes.
~ Awards and promotions ~
For successfully completing tasks, children receive rewards - stars, stickers or virtual medals. This helps maintain interest and motivation in the game, making the learning process joyful and exciting.
~ Game Features ~
A playful approach to learning the alphabet and color names is a great way for kids to learn that combines fun and education in one. Play helps children learn letters and develop reading skills effectively and efficiently, preparing them for success in school.
This game is sure to pique children's interest and take them on a world of adventure while helping them learn important skills!
SUBSCRIPTION 
Enjoy the game and get bonuses:
1. Educational games with animals 
2. Learn to draw. 
3. Let's study the shapes and sizes.

bluejetty:00180178:ios.name: BedrockConnect for Minecraft
bluejetty:00180178:ios.summary:
BedrockConnect is your ultimate multiplayer companion for Minecraft Bedrock Edition. Finally connect your PlayStation, Xbox, or Nintendo Switch to any third-party server and enjoy custom texture packs!
PLAY ON ANY SERVER
For the first tim
bluejetty:00180178:ios.description:
BedrockConnect is your ultimate multiplayer companion for Minecraft Bedrock Edition. Finally connect your PlayStation, Xbox, or Nintendo Switch to any third-party server and enjoy custom texture packs!
PLAY ON ANY SERVER
For the first time ever, connect your console to thousands of community servers worldwide. Whether you're on PlayStation, Xbox, or Nintendo Switch - BedrockConnect makes it possible to join servers that were previously PC and mobile only.
No complicated setup. No technical knowledge required. Just connect and play with friends across all platforms.
CUSTOM TEXTURE PACKS ON CONSOLE
Always wanted to use texture packs on your console? BedrockConnect lets you download and apply custom texture packs on supported servers. Transform your game's look with community-created resource packs - something that was never possible on consoles before!
KEY FEATURES
• Connect PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch to any Bedrock server
• Server Browser with live player counts, ping, and version info
• Featured Servers - Discover the best community servers
• Custom Texture Packs on supported servers
• Automatic texture pack updates
• Cross-platform multiplayer made easy
• Simple one-minute setup
HOW TO CONNECT
1. Open BedrockConnect and tap the + button
2. Enter the server IP and port
3. Tap Start - the server appears in your friends list
4. Join from your console and play!
For texture packs:
1. Enable texture packs in settings
2. Select your resource pack
3. Join a supported server
4. The pack downloads automatically!
REQUIREMENTS
• Console and phone must be on the same WiFi network
• Disable VPN and ad blockers for best results
• Premium unlocks all features including ad-free experience
SUPPORT
Join our Discord community at https://discord.bedrockhub.io for help, tips, and to connect with thousands of other players.
Note: Only texture packs with textures, sounds, and particles are supported. Shaders, mods, addons, and skin packs are not compatible.
DISCLAIMER
BedrockConnect is an independent third-party application created by the community. It is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Mojang, Microsoft, Sony, or Nintendo in any way. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.
Terms of Service: https://bedrockconnect.app/tos
Privacy Policy: https://bedrockconnect.app/privacy

bluejetty:00089041:ios.description:
Anything can begin, and end, at a moment's notice...
You're a young adult yuuman (homo anthropomorphis), living in a futuristic America in the late 22nd century. Though you had a life, dreams, and aspirations once, it all got swept away once you were diagnosed with incurable late-stage brain cancer; now you're stuck in a hospital, living the last few weeks of your life in existential agony, incapable of processing what you did wrong to deserve this fate.
Everything changes when, one day, you're approached by a scientist from the world's largest mega-corporation, who offers you a chance to escape your dying body and have your mind transplanted onto an android synth vessel; the only catch being, nobody knows whether the process works or not, whether you'll survive the transition or ultimately perish.
With little holding you back, you eventually accept...
=====
NMF is a linear Furry Sci-Fi Visual Novel created by Sedge: explore a high-tech futuristic world as an android, meet all sorts of new people and reconnect with some old faces, find the truth behind your existence and your purpose in this new world.

bluejetty:00145438:ios.description:
The Church of Almighty God has released its first mobile app in an effort to help people from all walks of life who long for God's appearance study God's work of the last days. It contains a variety of free books, articles, hymns and videos. We invite people from all walks of life to install this app to investigate the true way.
With its rich content, The Church of Almighty God app will help guide you to follow the Lamb's footsteps and savor the sustenance of the living waters.
Home
Gospel: Sections include Selections of the Words of Almighty God, The Way to Know God, and a variety of gospel truths, helping you come to know God's work of the last days.
Revealing the Truth: This section exposes the lies and reveals the truth, helping you see through Satan's fabrications and fallacies.
Testimonies: Here you can find testimonies of God's chosen people being raptured up before God's throne and of being saved, testimonies of oppression and suffering and ultimately becoming an overcomer, and more, helping you better know God's love and salvation.
Faith and Life: True Christian testimonies from home, work, and educating their children as well as a variety of Q&As on faith will help you resolve confusion and issues you face in your faith and daily life.
Books
Download books of God's words and books of Christian experiences and testimonies with just a single tap to start enjoying this life sustenance.
With Offline Mode you can read God's words so that you can grow closer to God at any place and any time.
Customize a comfortable interface with personalized settings such as page flip animations, font size, and background color.
Videos
See the latest videos with a single tap.
Readings of God's words, gospel movies, choral works, hymn music videos, theatrical performances, and other rich content all await you, ready to guide you to learn about God's appearance and work, and bask in God's love and salvation.
Audios
With the online Audio Library you can listen to new songs of the kingdom at any time and any place.
With a variety of collections to choose from, you can easily find the hymns that you enjoy.
Create an offline audio library, download and manage multiple tracks at once for a better offline experience.
Save and share hymns you enjoy to listen to them and praise God anywhere, anytime.
Readings of God's words help you understand God's 6000-year management plan and His will to save mankind.
Devotion Plans
Recommendations has a variety of topics for you to choose from including how to welcome the Lord, the path to the kingdom of heaven, and the mystery of the way of eternal life.
With the plan searching function you can easily find what you're seeking for your devotionals.
Set reminders for devotionals to give you an alert when it's time to start your daily devotionals.
More
When you register for an account you can log in with a single click and easily browse your notes, bookmarks, and other personal content on any device.
Enable push notifications to get all the latest updates on hymns, videos, essays, and devotion plans.
In live chat we are always here to listen to your heart's voice and help you find answers.
Available in 28 different languages from around the world for your convenience.
Please get in touch with us if you'd like to learn more.

bluejetty:00151780:ios.description:
“Moo ma ga gai, 1-2-3-GO!”
You’ve seen the viral trend taking over social media — now the ultimate Say the Word on Beat challenge is refined and built for real gameplay.
Can you say the word on beat? It sounds easy… until the rhythm speeds up and one tiny hesitation sends the whole round crashing down. Timing, focus, and a steady voice are all it takes — until they’re not.
HOW IT WORKS:
• A word or image appears on screen
• A beat starts playing
• Say the word exactly on beat to score
• Miss the timing, stumble, or hesitate — and you’re out
THE ULTIMATE GROUP CHALLENGE
Perfect for parties, road trips, or hanging out with friends. Play solo or with up to 8 players and see who has the best rhythm — and who cracks under pressure.
FEATURES:
• Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty modes
• 50+ unique word, image, and rhyme patterns
• Catchy beats that pull you into the rhythm
• Precision accuracy scoring for friendly competition
• 1–8 player local multiplayer
WHY SAY ON BEAT!
We took the viral Say the Word on Beat challenge and turned it into a real game — with structure, scoring, and smooth, responsive gameplay. It’s fast, funny, and surprisingly intense.
If you love rhythm games, vocal challenges, or timing-based party games, this one will test your brain-to-mouth connection like nothing else.
Ready? 1-2-3-GO!

bluejetty:00127808:ios.name: MyRing - Contraceptive Ring
bluejetty:00127808:ios.summary:
Welcome to MyRing — the cleanest way to keep your contraceptive ring on track. A focused home screen, smart reminders and a full cycle diary in one place, so you never have to wonder where you are in your cycle.
▶ Always know if you're pro
bluejetty:00127808:ios.description:
Welcome to MyRing — the cleanest way to keep your contraceptive ring on track. A focused home screen, smart reminders and a full cycle diary in one place, so you never have to wonder where you are in your cycle.
▶ Always know if you're protected
At a glance the home screen tells you whether you're safely covered or whether additional protection is needed. When the ring is inserted late or worn too long, MyRing flags it clearly and shows what to do next — including when emergency contraception or a pregnancy test are recommended.
▶ Reminders that fit your life
Set the exact times you want to be reminded about inserting and removing the ring. Pick your own message, let MyRing keep nudging until you confirm, and get a 24-hour heads-up the day before each action if you like. Confirm an action right from your wrist with the Apple Watch app — no need to open the iPhone.
▶ Your cycle, clearly mapped
The calendar shows past and upcoming ring days at a glance, with mood, period, notes and appointments overlaid on the matching day. Tap any cycle to fine-tune it: adjust the removal date, the wear time or the pause without losing your history.
▶ Even in the pause week
MyRing keeps your diary, period intensity and well-being notes running during the ring-free week — your record stays continuous all month.
▶ Features
• Reliable reminders for inserting and removing your ring
• Real-time protection status with safety guidance
• Apple Watch app — confirm actions from your wrist
• Calendar overlay with mood, period, notes and appointments
• Diary across the whole cycle including the pause week
• Customisable reminder time, message and optional 24-h preview
• Editable cycle history — change wear time, pause or dates after the fact
• Optional pause-after-N-cycles for extended-use schedules
• Personal colour coding for insertion and removal events
• 24+ mood and symptom tags, four period intensities
• Quick appointment tracking with reminders
• Skip the ring break when needed
• Encrypted cloud backup of your cycle and diary
• Works offline — reminders fire without an internet connection
• No ads on Pro
Download MyRing and never lose track of your contraceptive ring again. Your peace of mind is the whole point.
MyRing offers Premium as a monthly or yearly subscription. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, is forfeited when you purchase the subscription.
Terms of use: https://langsoftware.de/apps/myring/myring-terms-of-use/
Privacy policy: https://langsoftware.de/apps/myring/myring-privacy-policy/
