bluejetty:00163620:ios.name: First Table
bluejetty:00163620:ios.summary:
Enjoy exceptional dining with 50% off food. First Table rewards you for booking the first table of the night at incredible restaurants near you. Discover new favourites and save every time you dine.
With First Table, food lovers get 50% of
bluejetty:00163620:ios.description:
Enjoy exceptional dining with 50% off food. First Table rewards you for booking the first table of the night at incredible restaurants near you. Discover new favourites and save every time you dine.
With First Table, food lovers get 50% off their food bill when they book the first table of the evening, the perfect way to explore new restaurants and enjoy your favourites, all at a fraction of the price.
Discover over 4,500 incredible restaurants across the UK, Australia, Ireland and New Zealand. Whether you're after a midweek meal or a memorable night out, First Table helps you dine smarter.
How it works:
• Browse top-rated restaurants in your area
• Book the first table of the night, lock in with a booking fee
• Enjoy 50% off the food bill for up to 6 diners
Why diners love First Table:
• Save money while eating out more
• Explore new cuisines and venues
• Support local restaurants
• Easy, seamless booking experience
Discover new restaurants in your own backyard, and get an extra perk for dining off-peak.
How does First Table work?
Participating restaurants list their first tables for breakfast, lunch or dinner on First Table, showing up to fourteen days of availability on our platform.
Diners are then rewarded with 50% off the food bill for dining at an off-peak time. 
To secure 50% off the food bill, select your city and search through the available restaurants near you. Then select your date and time and lock in your First Table for a booking fee.
What’s in it for the restaurant?
Restaurants choose to join at their own discretion, to help fill empty tables and to create a buzz early into their service. That means what while you’re tucking into a sunny brunch or an elevated dinner for half the price, you're also helping restaurants start service strong.
Discover new restaurants!
Browse nearby restaurants to discover a hidden gem in your own backyard or lock in top-rated restaurants you’ve always wanted to try. Craving a particular meal? Restaurants are also searchable by restaurant name or cuisine.
What’s the catch?
There isn’t one - that’s the best part! First Table is a win-win for restaurants and diners alike. Restaurants get early customers through the door and diners get rewarded for dining at times that restaurants need them most.
By dining on First Table, you'll not only have a great excuse to connect with mates, dates and fellow foodies, but you'll also be supporting hospitality venues by dining at the times that they need you the most.
Have friends you’d love to dine with? You can even earn credit by sharing First Table with other foodies! Just grab your promo code from your profile, and you’ll both get your next restaurant booking fee half price.

bluejetty:00131692:ios.name: Spartan Forge: Hunt
bluejetty:00131692:ios.summary:
Plan smarter. Scout farther. Hunt better with Spartan Forge Hunt+.
Spartan Forge combines advanced mapping, high-resolution UAV imagery, customizable LiDAR, AI-powered deer movement predictions, weather, property data, and field planning t
bluejetty:00131692:ios.description:
Plan smarter. Scout farther. Hunt better with Spartan Forge Hunt+.
Spartan Forge combines advanced mapping, high-resolution UAV imagery, customizable LiDAR, AI-powered deer movement predictions, weather, property data, and field planning tools in one hunting platform — built for hunters, by hunters.
See more of the ground before you step foot on it. Explore UAV and satellite imagery, LiDAR, terrain features, crop data, property boundaries, hunt units, and customizable map layers. Save presets and download maps for offline use.
Turn scouting into a visual plan with BattleMap. Freehand draw on your map, add text, mark routes, visualize thermals, plan stalks, lay out deer drives, and build strategies around the terrain you hunt.
Scout smarter with historical weather, wind data, sun exposure, terrain information, and Spartan Forge’s Deer Prediction model.
KEY FEATURES
• HIGH-RESOLUTION UAV & HISTORICAL IMAGERY
Explore 5–15 cm UAV imagery with historical coverage dating back to 2016, plus historical satellite imagery through Sat-1. See trees, habitat changes, access routes, timber cuts, and other details traditional satellite maps may miss.
• CUSTOMIZABLE LIDAR
See terrain beneath the canopy with high-resolution LiDAR. Identify benches, drainages, game trails, old logging roads, subtle terrain changes, rock features, and more. Customize LiDAR settings to emphasize what matters most.
• BATTLEMAP
Draw freehand on the map, add text, create arrows, and customize line size, color, and style. Map access routes, thermals, deer drives, stalks, decoy spreads, stand approaches, and more. Save and access BattleMaps on mobile and web.
• DEER PREDICTION
Use Spartan Forge’s deer movement prediction model, built using GPS-collared deer data and environmental conditions from across the U.S., to better understand potential deer movement and activity.
• HISTORICAL WIND & WEATHER
Research historical wind and weather conditions, view forecasts, and use weather information directly from your map.
• ADVANCED MAP CUSTOMIZATION
Combine imagery, LiDAR, property information, terrain layers, crop data, weather, sun exposure, and other overlays. Save presets for fast switching in the field.
• OFFLINE MAPS
Download supported satellite, topo, hybrid, and other maps before your hunt so critical information remains available beyond cell service.
• PRIVATE & PUBLIC LAND DATA
View property boundaries and ownership information, identify public hunting ground, mark access, and stay informed when saved parcels change ownership.
• PIN SHARING & BLUE FORCE TRACKER
Share individual pins with hunting partners or use Blue Force Tracker to automatically share pins within a defined area.
• EAGLEEYE (Web Only)
View terrain and imagery from side-angle perspectives to better understand ridges, valleys, and access routes.
• CYBERSCOUT AI (Web Only)
Ask CyberScout hunting-related questions and get AI-powered guidance for scouting, planning, gear, and more.
• MOBILE + DESKTOP SYNC
Plan from your desktop, then take your information into the field. Maps, pins, BattleMaps, and other content stay synced across supported devices.
MEMBERSHIP OPTIONS
► FREE
Get started with default maps, weather, basic property ownership, pins, and essential planning tools.
► PAID MEMBERSHIP — ONE PRICE, ALL STATES
Choose a monthly or yearly membership and unlock Spartan Forge Hunt+ across every state, including advanced mapping, property boundaries, Deer Prediction, CyberScout, UAV and historical imagery, LiDAR, BattleMap, Blue Force Tracker, offline maps, and more.
One platform. More information. Better decisions in the field.
Terms of Use:
https://spartanforge.ai/pages/terms-of-service
Questions or feedback?
Contact support@spartanforge.tech

bluejetty:00069133:ios.description:
◆The「Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG」Official Support App has finally arrived!!
You can easily use the camera to register your Decks, calculate Life Points and even proceed to simulate your starting 5-card hand! This App has tons of features which are beneficial to any Duelist!
◆Standout Features◆
【Identify various Cards through your Camera!】
You can easily read Yu-Gi-Oh! Cards through your Camera.
Image Recognition Technology allows you to scan and read up to 20 Yu-Gi-Oh! Cards at a time!
▼Using Card Recognition can help you to: 
- Easily register your Deck lists into the App
- Quickly check-up on the Card Q&A for certain cards. (Only available in Japanese)
【Installed with Duel Supporting Features which can be used at Official Yu-Gi-Oh! Tournaments!】
「Yu-Gi-Oh! Neuron」is a Support App which can be used at Official Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Tournaments.
Displays your Card game ID barcode
Linkable with your current Card Game ID
Register your Decks within the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Card Database
Installed with many useful features like calculating Life Points, tossing coins, rolling Dices, placing/removing Counters etc. 
【Introducing Different Features】
●Deck Registration 
- Easily register your Deck through your Camera
- Able to read up to maximum 20 cards 
- Smooth maneuverability to edit your Decks
- Manage your Decks by linking it to the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Card Database
- Able to search public deck lists worldwide
- Able to check the latest Forbidden & Limited List
- Able to simulate your opening 5-card hand 
- And many more features to support your Deck managing experience 
●Supporting your Duels
- Calculating Life Points
- Log, Save and Archive your Duels
- Flipping coins, rolling dices and placing/removing Counters 
- Playable BGM feature
●Card Search 
- Easily search Cards with your Camera
- Search Cards accurately through Specifying Card Name, Card Text, Link Markers etc. 
- Displays Card Text in 8 different languages
●Supports Tournament Participation
- Displays your Card game ID barcode 
- Linkable with your current Card Game ID
- Register your Decks within the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Card Database
●Notice/Product Details
- Able to check Notices from KONAMI
- Able to check Yu-Gi-Oh! Product Details 
●Store Search
-Search for Official Tournament Store around your area
-Locate OTS on the map
-Check details of the OTS
-Check the featured events in the OTS stores
-Set your HOME/Favorite OTS store
-Get directions to the OTS stores (by linking with another Map App)
●Search for Sanctioned Events
-Event Search
-Check Event Details
-Pre-Register for Events
-Add Events to your Watchlist
●Manage Registered Events
-Display today’s registered event
-Display future registered event
●Duel Record
-Display result of your past event Dueling record.
●Ranking
-Display Event Point Rankings per nation
●Others
-Display list of Pre-Registered Events
-Receive prizes from your HOME OTS store
■System Requirements
Supported OS version: iOS 13.0 and above.
Supported devices: Compatible with iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch.
Please note that even if your device fulfils the system specification required to run the application, it may still not run properly due to external factors, such as available memory, conflicts with other applications, or an intrinsic limitation of the device itself. 
【About Yu-Gi-Oh!】
“Yu-Gi-Oh!” is a popular manga created by Kazuki Takahashi that was serialized in SHUEISHA Inc.’s “WEEKLY SHONEN JUMP” since 1996. From 1999, Konami Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd. Provides a Trading Card Game (TCG) and console games, based on “Yu-Gi-Oh!” created from the original manga. Currently, the Card Game has expanded to over 75 different countries and locations, especially in Japan, USA and Europe, printed in 9 different languages, and is enjoyed by fans around the world.
©2020 Studio Dice／SHUEISHA, TV TOKYO, KONAMI
©Konami Digital Entertainment

Foodi: Food & Grocery Delivery in Bangladesh 
Looking for fast food delivery, fresh groceries, or daily lifestyle essentials online? Foodi is Bangladesh’s ultimate quick-commerce app bringing your favorite restaurant meals, groceries from Mart, and everyday needs from Shop - directly to your doorstep in minutes!
Whether you’re craving authentic local dishes at home or need instant grocery delivery at the office, Foodi is the best online food and bazaar delivery service app proudly made in Bangladesh.
Craving Delicious Food? We Deliver in a Flash!
Foodi brings top-rated local restaurants and popular international fast-food chains right to your door. Satisfy any craving with just a few taps:
Bangladeshi Classics: Search and order mouth-watering Kacchi Biryani, Khichuri, Chui Gosht, Kala Bhuna, and traditional Rice bowls.
Western Favorites: Satisfy fast-food cravings with cheesy pizzas, juicy burgers, pasta, fried chicken, and premium desserts.
Top Deals: Super Sunday, Flash Deals, Flash Hours, restaurant flat discounts and more! Expect the best deals and pricing in the country.
Early morning, Late Night & Express: Get fast delivery food right when hunger strikes, in selected districts of Bangladesh including: Dhaka, Kushtia, Noakhali, Brahmanbaria, Kishoreganj, Siddhirganj, Narsingdi, Feni, Faridpur, Dinajpur, Moulvibazar, Jessore, Barisal, Rangpur, Sirajganj, Bogra, Tangail, Cumilla, Mymensingh, Cox’s Bazar, Rajshahi, Khulna, Chattogram, Narayanganj, Sylhet, and Gazipur. We are expanding rapidly!
Skip the Hassles of Physical Bazar: Grocery & Essentials Delivery Within Minutes:
Why waste your weekend going to the crowded supermarket or local bazaar? Order everything you need online with incredible discount offers:
> Fresh Grocery & Daily Needs: Fresh fruits, vegetables, dairy, cooking oil, snacks, and drinks delivered within minutes (as less as 15 minutes) from the Mart section.
> Monthly/Daily Bazaar Deals: Get special discounts and promo codes on daily essentials.
> Shops: Leading grocery chains, flower, beauty, pharma and lifestyle shops available for hyperlocal delivery within minutes from the Shop section.
How Foodi Works:
1. Set Your Location: Enter your home or office address.
2. Browse or Search: Find your favorite restaurant, search for specific food names (like biryani or burger), or explore Mart or Shop.
3. Place Your Order: Select your items, apply promo codes in the savings corner, and check out.
4. Instant Delivery: Our swift and highly-rated delivery riders bring your order hot and fresh to your doorstep.
5. Customer Care: Yes, we have an actual call-centre with real physical customer care agents to serve you - unlike others. Please try in-app live chatting or dial 16295 for support. 
Why Choose Foodi?
Foodi is a proud q-commerce venture of US-Bangla Group - a trusted leader in aviation, real estate, technology, e-commerce, and logistics in Bangladesh.
> 10,500+ Restaurants/Shops and 200,000+ items/SKUs available at your fingertips.
> Wide Coverage: Online food ordering available across 27+ districts Bangladesh with thousands of registered delivery riders.
> Multi-Category Convenience: Food, grocery, bazaar items, lifestyle products and OTC meds - all in one place.
> Download the Foodi App today to get your first order delivered with exclusive discount offers!

bluejetty:00131648:ios.description:
Join millions of Christians around the world in prayer, reflection, and scripture reading each day.
The Upper Room app offers access to two beloved devotional experiences—The Upper Room daily devotional and The Upper Room Disciplines, our year-long lectionary-based devotional. Each subscription can be enjoyed on its own or together in one convenient app.
Grow closer to God through daily meditations, scripture readings, prayers, and thoughtful reflections written by believers from around the world. Every day, readers of The Upper Room share in the same story, scripture, and prayer—uniting a global community of faith. And with Disciplines, you can engage the Revised Common Lectionary through weekly themes and daily readings from trusted Christian writers and leaders.
With your digital subscriptions, you’ll enjoy:
• The Upper Room daily devotional – Daily meditations, prayers, audio recordings, and author insights.
• The Upper Room Disciplines – Weekly and daily readings based on the Revised Common Lectionary, plus audio lectio recordings of each week’s Gospel.
• Access your devotionals anytime via app, website, or daily email delivery.
• Explore author bios, bonus content, and audio reflections to deepen your time with God.
Whether you subscribe to one or both devotionals, The Upper Room app helps you stay grounded in prayer and connected to a worldwide community seeking daily life with God.

bluejetty:00156529:ios.name: ArmyFit: Elite Fitness Tools
bluejetty:00156529:ios.summary:
Train with a purpose. Beat your last score.
Built by Soldiers, for Soldiers, ArmyFit empowers over 500,000 Soldiers with tools to train, track progress, and grade tests. From your next 2-mile run to your unit's next fitness test, keep your
bluejetty:00156529:ios.description:
Train with a purpose. Beat your last score.
Built by Soldiers, for Soldiers, ArmyFit empowers over 500,000 Soldiers with tools to train, track progress, and grade tests. From your next 2-mile run to your unit's next fitness test, keep your scores, workouts, and records in one place.
KNOW YOUR SCORE
Calculate AFT, ACFT, and APFT scores, track CFT results, and check event standards. Support for Permanent Profiles and alternate cardio events helps you work with the test that applies to you. Save Practice and Record tests, then compare your results over time.
TRAIN FOR A FASTER 2-MILE
Supercharge the Body Weight Fitness - Run plan with PT Guru. Set your goal by time or points, confirm your current running base, and get training targets built around your starting point. Review upcoming targets as you progress through the plan.
FOLLOW A PLAN. FINISH THE WORK.
Choose bodyweight plans for different fitness levels, including Run and MDL plans that target specific events while maintaining full-body fitness. Move through Prepare, Exercise, and Recovery, check off your work, and see your progress by day and week. Restart a day or week when needed without resetting the rest of your plan.
SUPERCHARGE YOUR ANSWERS WITH PT GURU
Ask training questions, plan your next session, or find where you can gain points. With your permission, PT Guru can use your saved profile and test results to give more relevant answers. You control data access and can turn it off anytime. AI guidance can be wrong; verify test standards before use.
TAKE YOUR WORKOUT TO APPLE WATCH
ArmyFit Pro brings timers, laps, workout checkoffs, and Preparation and Recovery Drill references to your wrist. Open a workout or timer on your paired iPhone, then keep working with the phone locked. Watch changes sync when the same phone session reconnects.
SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Use the dashboard, interactive charts, and Event Trends to see which events are improving and which need work. Keep your test history, timed events, and body-composition records organized and synced to your account. Save test results offline and sync when you reconnect.
GRADE YOUR UNIT
Run group grading sessions, manage tester profiles, and export supported test results to DA 705 PDFs. Keep the grading workflow moving from the first event through the final result.
TIME EVERY REP AND SPLIT
Use the stopwatch and event timers for the Sprint-Drag-Carry, 2-mile run, Plank, Hand-Release Push-Up, and more. Track splits, see score feedback, and save timed results to Records. Keep your music playing while you train.
TRACK BODY COMPOSITION
Calculate Waist-to-Height Ratio, height and weight, and body-fat percentage. Save measurements and follow your trends alongside your fitness-test results.
GET THE DETAILS RIGHT
Find event videos, written instructions, lane setup guidance, and an easy-to-read score chart. Use the MDL plate calculator to see how to load the bar, including alternate plate combinations.
ArmyFit is owned and developed by fellow Soldiers who value your privacy. Some features require ArmyFit Pro or an in-app purchase.
View our privacy policy: https://acftapp.com/privacy-policy
View our End User License Agreement (EULA): http://www.apple.com/legal/itunes/appstore/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00127352:ios.description:
The most accurate & simple step tracker auto tracks your daily steps, burned calories, walking distance, duration, pace, health data, etc., and display them in intuitive graphs for easy checking. 
Power Saving Pedometer
Step counter counts your daily steps with the built-in sensor, which greatly saves battery. It records steps accurately even when the screen is locked, whether your phone is in your hand, your pocket, your bag, or your armband. 
Real-time Map Tracker
In GPS tracking mode, step counter tracks your fitness activity in detail (distance, pace, time, calories), and records your routes on the map with GPS in real-time. But if you don’t choose GPS tracking, it will count steps with built-in sensor to save battery.
100% Private
No locked features. No login required. You can freely use all features without login.
Easy to Use Step Counter
It auto records your steps. You will get your daily steps report on time. 
Report Graph
Your walking data will be displayed in clear graphs. You can easily check your daily, weekly and monthly walking statistics. 
Targets and Achievements
Set daily steps goal. Continuously achieve your goal will keep you motivated. You can also set targets for your fitness activity (distance, calories, duration, etc.). 
Fashion & Simple Design
Its clean, simple, and fashion design brings excellent user experience.
Apple Watch & Apple Health
You can synchronize and import your activity data via Apple Health. You can track your activity with your iPhone and your Apple Watch.
Colorful Themes
It provides dark mode, with more themes coming soon. Select your favorite theme for the step tracker and enjoy the step counting. 
Important Notes
* To ensure accurate step counting, make sure the information you entered on the settings page is correct.
* You can adjust the sensitivity level of the step tracker for more accurate step counting.
* Some devices may stop counting when the screen is locked due to their power saving processing. 
* Devices with older version can’t count steps with locked screen.

bluejetty:00073836:ios.name: AGS Beers Criteria®
bluejetty:00073836:ios.summary: Based on the 2023 Updated AGS Beers Criteria ® for Potentially Inappropriate Medication Use in Older Adults, The AGS Beers Criteria ® mobile app helps clinicians implement prescribing recommendations based on a compendium of medications pot
bluejetty:00073836:ios.description:
Based on the 2023 Updated AGS Beers Criteria ® for Potentially Inappropriate Medication Use in Older Adults, The AGS Beers Criteria ® mobile app helps clinicians implement prescribing recommendations based on a compendium of medications potentially to avoid or consider with caution because they often present an unfavorable balance of benefits and harms for older adults.
Key Features:
• New in 2025!  Alternative Treatments to Selected Medications in the 2023 AGS Beers Criteria® including both nonpharmacologic and pharmacologic alternatives across medications.
• Quick search by generic drug name, organ system, disease or syndrome of concern.

bluejetty:00077701:ios.description:
Dive into the Aquatic Wonderland: A Comprehensive Exploration of Fish Games
In the vast ocean of gaming, fish games offer endless fun and diversity for players of all ages. From thrilling battles to relaxing underwater escapades, these games cater to everyone’s preferences. Let’s explore what makes them so captivating:
Big Fish Eat Small Fish: A Classic Theme
Central to many fish games is the idea of big fish eating small fish, as seen in Hungry Shark Games and Fish Evolution.
Players guide a growing shark, consuming smaller creatures to evolve into the largest fish in the sea.
These eating and growing games deliver excitement, strategy, and the satisfaction of progression.
Real Shark Games: Action and Adventure
For thrill-seekers, real shark games like Hungry Shark and Shark Attack offer fast-paced, action-packed adventures.
Play as an apex predator, hunting prey and dodging dangers in immersive underwater worlds.
Educational and Toddler-Friendly Fun
Titles like Let Me Eat help toddlers learn basic concepts like counting and colors.
Beloved characters like Baby Shark add fun and engagement, making these games perfect for young players.
Creative Fishdom and Aquarium Games
Games like Fun Fishdom and Aquarium Land let players design and manage their aquatic sanctuaries.
They combine creativity and strategic challenges, making them enjoyable for players of all ages.
Fast-Paced and Relaxing Gameplay
High-energy games like Fish Rush and Fish Runner test reflexes with obstacle-filled waters.
Calming titles like Tasty Blue and Super Starfish provide a peaceful escape into serene underwater worlds.
Fishing Joy and Universal Appeal
Fishing Joy and Fish and Trip recreate the relaxing charm of fishing, appealing to players of all ages.
Dive Into Fun Today
Fish games deliver thrills, creativity, and tranquility—there’s something for everyone! From angry fish battles to creating aquariums, the underwater adventures await.

Chat, connect and share your faith journey with like-minded believers.

Wherever you are, as long as you have internet access, joining Faithia is easy. Simply download the app, create your account, and complete the quick verification process. Once verified, you can share your profile with your community, and your followers can start connecting with you on the Faithia platform. Download the Faithia App today and embark on a meaningful spiritual journey. Explore features that bring you closer to your faith, including live sermons, devotionals, prayer groups, and more. Faithia is free to download and use. While all core features are free, some leaders may offer exclusive content or coaching for a fee, and optional gifting is available to support faith leaders, though it is optional.

bluejetty:00153119:ios.summary:

Got too much zucchini in the summer, and an excess of cabbage in wi
bluejetty:00153119:ios.description:
Do you love cookbooks? Us, too. That's why we created CookShelf, the app that helps you make the most of your cookbook collection, and cook from the books you already own.
Got too much zucchini in the summer, and an excess of cabbage in winter? Or are you just trying to find that one Bolognese recipe you love and make every year, but can *never* remember which book it’s in? Quickly find recipes across your cookbooks that use what you already have—no more forgotten vegetables wilting in your crisper drawer. Simply search by ingredient, dish type, or whatever you're craving, and CookShelf shows exactly which cookbook has what you need and what page it's on.
CookShelf is built for home cooks who love real cookbooks and real creators. Set a goal for how many cookbook recipes you'll cook this year, track your progress, and look back at everything you've made. Plus, get inspired by what our community is cooking from the books you own. We bridge the gap between physical cookbooks and digital convenience—because the best recipes are already on your shelf.
◆ Instantly search across your cookbooks and thousands of online recipes
◆ Find recipes based on what's in your fridge
◆ See ingredients lists before opening your books
◆ See what people are cooking: browse real cooks from the books already on your shelf—what people made, the notes they left, the little tweaks that made it better
◆ Follow your friends: find the people whose cooking you trust and follow along
◆ Track your cooking: bookmark recipes, mark what you've cooked, add photos and notes, and look back at your cooks timeline
◆ Set a cooking goal and watch your progress grow throughout the year
◆ Reduce food waste: use up CSA box ingredients before they spoil
◆ Finally cook from those cookbooks you love but rarely open
◆ 16,000+ cookbooks indexed
Join thousands of home cooks who are rediscovering the treasures in their cookbook collections every day.
HOW DOES IT WORK?
CookShelf includes both a free version and a Premium (paid) subscription. 
The free version lets you add up to 5 cookbooks and use all of CookShelf's features for those books—search, bookmarking, cooking goals, and tracking.
Premium unlocks your full collection:
◆ Add unlimited cookbooks
◆ Search across your entire library and over 15,000 indexed titles
You can start a free trial to access Premium. Unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends, you'll be automatically charged the price shown on the payment screen for your chosen plan. Your CookShelf Premium subscription renews automatically each month or year until you cancel. Canceling disables the automatic renewal, but you'll keep full access through the end of your current period. Deleting the app does not cancel your subscription.
Terms of Use: https://www.cookshelf.app/terms
Privacy: https://www.cookshelf.app/privacy

Thief Puzzle: Pass a Level - The Ultimate Brain Teaser Adventure!
Get ready to test your intelligence with Thief Puzzle, an exciting blend of puzzle games, brain games, and trivia games. This thrilling brain test will challenge your wits, logic, and problem-solving skills as you navigate through mind-bending sorting games and tricky cool math games. Can you outsmart the guards and steal the treasures without getting caught?
Train Your Brain Like Never Before
Immerse yourself in one of the best brain games for free! This game offers a variety of mind games that boost your intelligence and sharpen your thinking abilities. Whether you're into iq games, math games for adults, or word puzzles, Thief Puzzle has something to keep your mind engaged. If you enjoy elevated brain training or impulse brain training, you'll love solving these intriguing logic games.
Solve Tricky Levels & Become the Ultimate Thief
Each level presents a unique challenge that requires you to think outside the box. Your mission? Steal precious items while avoiding traps and guards. With hundreds of levels to complete, the difficulty increases as you progress, making this one of the most addictive free brain games for adults. Whether you're playing offline puzzle games or competing in quiz games, every stage is designed to test your strategic thinking.
Fun, Engaging & Educational
This isn’t just another board game—it’s a complete mental workout! Answer question games and quizzes, put your problem-solving skills to the test with brain teaser games, and improve your quick thinking with riddle games. Love math games? You'll also get to solve math problems in creative and unexpected ways! If you're a fan of trivia, puzzle escape games, or free puzzle games for adults, this game is perfect for you.
Game Features:
> Easy & Addictive Gameplay – Simple swipe controls make it accessible for all ages.
> Challenging Puzzles – Enjoy a variety of puzzles for adults with increasing difficulty.
> Brain Training Games – Exercise your brain with fun free games designed to improve logic and strategy.
> Exciting Missions – Steal gold, diamonds, and jewels while avoiding traps.
> Mind-Bending Challenges – Experience brain out moments with unique enigma puzzles.
> Offline Play Available – Enjoy free puzzles anytime, anywhere.
> Most Popular Games Elements – A mix of thief puzzle, math app, and trivia all in one!
Are you ready to become a master thief and put your intelligence to the test? Solve every puzzle, outsmart the system, and become the ultimate thief in Thief Puzzle: Pass a Level! Download now and start your brain training games adventure today!

bluejetty:00087628:ios.description:
Ready for a casual yet thrilling space exploration? “Slope Match Tiles” takes you into a universe filled with unknowns and challenges. Here, you’ll need to use your wisdom to solve puzzles and explore the secrets of each domain.
The Serentia galaxy is facing an unprecedented crisis. Are you ready to become the hero to save the galaxy? Join Princess Yuna, explore wormholes, face challenges, and search for the lost “Star Heart” gem.

--Challenge Navigate through various obstacle courses, find the optimal path, and complete all levels. Play anytime, anywhere to enhance your skills, reach the finish line, earn rewards, and unlock the next challenge.

This is a completely free game that you can pause at any time, allowing you to enjoy endless fun wherever you are. Why not start your interstellar journey now?

Stock Market Tracker & Stop Loss Alerts puts the power back in your hands, delivering real-time notifications and insights so you’re always ahead of the game. Take control of your financial future with easy-to-use tools that help you stay informed and make smarter, faster decisions.
WHY CHOOSE STOCK MARKET TRACKER?
With our app, you’ll never have to second-guess your portfolio's performance or fear missing crucial changes. Here’s how we keep you in the know and in control:
• Track Multiple Portfolios Effortlessly: Manage all your investments in one place with easy-to-read portfolio overviews.
• Monitor Individual Stock Purchases: Know the exact return on every stock, so you can see how each investment is performing at a glance.
• Set Fixed or Trailing Stop-Loss Alerts: Avoid unnecessary losses by setting stop-loss limits that alert you when your stocks hit critical levels. Choose between real-time push notifications or email alerts — whichever keeps you best informed.
• Custom % Movement Alerts: Keep tabs on specific stocks with customizable up or down percentage alerts, so you can make timely buy or sell decisions with confidence.
• Stay Informed with Real-Time News: Get all the latest stock news, market closing updates, and more — all in one app, so you don’t have to scour multiple sources to stay informed.
• Secure Cloud-Based Backup: Create a free account to ensure your data is always safe — even if you switch devices, your portfolios and settings will follow you.

Whether you're a seasoned trader, a casual investor, or simply someone looking for an easy way to track your portfolio without the hassle, Stock Market Tracker & Stop Loss Alerts is designed with you in mind. Our intuitive features make it simple for anyone to stay on top of their investments, minimize risks, and make smart decisions — all automatically.
KEY FEATURES AT A GLANCE:
• Real-time alerts for both stop-loss and market movement thresholds
• Simple, user-friendly portfolio tracking interface
• News integration for immediate access to stock and market updates
• Backup your data with free cloud storage — sync across devices anytime
• Comprehensive alert customization with both push and email notifications
DON'T MISS ANOTHER MARKET MOVEMENT — TAKE CONTROL TODAY!
Download Stock Market Tracker & Stop Loss Alerts now and join thousands of savvy investors who trust us to keep their portfolios on track. Start tracking stocks the smart way — free from stress, worry, and missed opportunities.
REAL SUPPORT WHEN YOU NEED IT
Unlike other apps, we pride ourselves on offering top-notch customer support. Have a question or need assistance? Our dedicated team is here for you. Just reach out to us at support@danecoltd.com — we’re committed to helping you succeed!

bluejetty:00077459:ios.summary: OpticalVPN allows you to protect your privacy, change your IP address and safely use applications and the Internet. Your passwords, personal data and online activity will be securely protected. Encrypt your traffic with speedy, unlimited VP
bluejetty:00077459:ios.description:
OpticalVPN allows you to protect your privacy, change your IP address and safely use applications and the Internet. Your passwords, personal data and online activity will be securely protected. Encrypt your traffic with speedy, unlimited VPN for iPhone and iPad.
Unique features of OpticalVPN:
- One-touch VPN connection
- Automatic reconnection when the connection is lost
- Protects your privacy in public Wi-Fi hotspots
- Unlimited bandwidth
- No-log policy
- Secure AES-256 bit encryption
What is a VPN?
Virtual private network (VPN) is a technology that establishes a secure tunnel connection between your device and our server over of a public Internet connection and encrypts all transmitted data. All your traffic is securely encrypted and transmitted directly to our server, so no one can receive or change the data, and the address of one of our VPN servers will be used instead of your public IP address.
Privacy protection
Your IP address will be changed to the IP address of our VPN server to protect your identity and location. Hide your IP address to prevent data trackers, spyware, and hackers from tracking your online activity.
Super-fast servers located around the world
OpticalVPN is used by a large number of servers around the world. We have high-speed servers located in the USA, UK, Canada, Germany, Australia, India and other countries.
Data encryption
Encrypt your internet traffic using our VPN servers. We use the most up-to-date encryption methods for your security.
Subscription plans
OpticalVPN offers 1-month and 12-month subscriptions.
Subscription Details:
- The subscription renews automatically unless the auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal after purchase by going to the user's Account Settings.
- If the subscription has a free trial, payment will be charged 24 hours before the end of the subscription, unless the subscription has been canceled. The free trial is limited to one user.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
- Any unused portion of free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
- Removing the app doesn't automatically cancel the subscription.
If you have any questions or want to share feedback about us?
Contact our support service: support@opticalvpn.com
Terms of service
https://opticalvpn.com/terms-of-service.html
Privacy policy
https://opticalvpn.com/privacy-policy.html

Discover your inner builder in the open world of Portia!
A top hit 3D simulation RPG on PC has now arrived on mobile! Inherit your Pa's workshop, craft and build your way to compete for top builder in town! As you explore and discover hidden relics, restore the glory of human civilization on this post-apocalyptic land. As you grow into a seasoned builder, bond with NPCs and townsfolk to build a circle of friends and romance!
【The Civilization of Portia Includes:】
- A fully operable 3D workshop
Enjoy the fun of building and growing your workshop in this 3D open-world by gathering resources and assembling them into meaningful pieces. Automate your workshop and expand your farm and homeland, and take on more skills and techniques that will benefit the town. Don't forget that you also get to develop animal husbandry, riding a horse or even alpaca is a dream not far away!
- Socialize and build a family
More than 50 interactable NPCs live in Portia. As soon as you land, you'll meet a few of them and as you progress, you can develop further friendships or even romantic relationships with them. There are quite a lot of activities available for socializing, including taking a hot air balloon ride! When everything falls into place, you can tie the knot, have children and experience the joys of parenthood.
- Engage in challenging battles and adventures in old civilization
Hone your fighting skills to defeat monsters in post-apocalyptic ruins as you unearth the truth of the former civilization buried beneath.
- 100% Original PC gameplay and experience
Whether you're a new explorer or a fellow Portian already, you can now bring the entirety of Portia with you on-the-go! Your phone is now your mobile workshop!
【Join Our Community：】
★Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MyTimeatPortiaMobile/
★Discord: https://discord.gg/2tzdsn9Z9u
——————————————
【Dear builders! Note that data/saves will be deleted from you phone once the game is uninstalled. Please upload the saves to the cloud before you reset you phone/system or change another device. Thank you!】

bluejetty:00062219:ios.name: Viking Games: for Kids
bluejetty:00062219:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00062219:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
AXEMAN
Help Redbeard defend his precious flowers from hordes of invading Vikings, making use of his sharp axe and unparalleled throwing skills, spells from the Gods and awesome power-ups!
SKIDOS Axeman is easy to learn and play, featuring innovative line-drawing gameplay, beautifully animated graphics, challenging levels and extremely creative enemies (tip: set your axe on fire to finish-off those Vikings hiding behind trees)
It is time to sharpen your axe and join Redbeard in his epic axeventure!
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00120828:ios.name: Algodoo
bluejetty:00120828:ios.summary: Bring your ideas to life with realistic physics in Algodoo. This creative and educational app lets you design two-dimensional scenes where objects move according to the laws of physics. See cause and effect in action and refine your builds
bluejetty:00120828:ios.description:
Bring your ideas to life with realistic physics in Algodoo. This creative and educational app lets you design two-dimensional scenes where objects move according to the laws of physics. See cause and effect in action and refine your builds to perfection.
Algodoo is a virtual 2D construction set to enjoy the creative thrill of building fun scenes and machines. You’ll never run out of parts. You can go deeper and analyse the motion and learn about mechanical devices. Once you master the tools and principles, you can build sandbox games or mesmerising, complex simulations. 
• Use basic 2D geometrical shapes or the free-hand drawing tool to create objects. 
• Combine components like axles, springs, motors, ropes, and lasers to create intricate machines.
• Choose from various materials—steel, wood, rubber, water, and helium—and customise at will. 
• Press “Simulate” to bring your scene to life, moving under the forces of gravity, aerodynamics, buoyancy, and more.
• Use trial and error to explore ideas and perfect your inventions.
• Express your imagination with vibrant colors, shapes, and textures.
Looking to build animations, contraptions, marble races, moving structures, chain reactions, or virtual science experiments? With Algodoo, the possibilities for invention, creativity, and exploration are endless.
With the Quick Tour and tutorial videos, you can easily learn Algodoo’s basic tools and principles. It's not just for fun— the scientific foundation of Algodoo makes it a great teaching and learning aid for exploring physics concepts, operating principles of machines, and even construction. 
Discover the creativity of others and get inspired for your next build by visiting the Algobox library. Access thousands of scenes created by the Algodoo community and share your own creations by signing up for an Algobox account.
Algodoo offers endless fun for users of all ages. Download the app now and start building, and search for #Algodoo on YouTube or social media to explore videos showcasing imaginative creations from our global community.

bluejetty:00076291:ios.summary:
Welcome to the enigmatic realm of Screw Puzzle: Nuts and Bolts Game, where mind-bending conundrums await your prowess! Are you ready to become a Screw Master? 
If you like playing screw puzzle game, Screw Puzzle: Nuts and Bolts is designed
bluejetty:00076291:ios.description:
Welcome to the enigmatic realm of Screw Puzzle: Nuts and Bolts Game, where mind-bending conundrums await your prowess! Are you ready to become a Screw Master? 
If you like playing screw puzzle game, Screw Puzzle: Nuts and Bolts is designed for you! Dive into a convoluted labyrinth of twisted iron sheets and plates, adorned with forsaken bolt fragments and rings, presenting an epic and intricate puzzle odyssey. You will find a hundred levels of fun screw puzzle game. There will be different nuts and bolts for each level, try it yourself! 
How to play Screw Puzzle: Nuts and Bolts Game: 
- As a seasoned artisan, deftly unlock screws and disentangle each contorted piece of iron from the intricate tapestry of impediments. 
- Embark on a journey through meticulously sculpted levels, encountering a mesh of interwoven metal plates, rings, and ropes at every twist and turn. 
- Untangle the knots of rope and liberate the iron components to immerse yourself in the intricate yet immensely rewarding universe of Nuts & Bolts. 
- Certain stages unveil metal masterpieces crafted from the very plates themselves, while in others, you'll wield a handsaw to carve these plates, exposing more apertures to secure your bolts. 
- Move each bolt wisely so that all the parts can screw quickly 
Main Feature of Screw Puzzle Nuts and Bolts: 
- Satisfy ASMR sound while playing screw puzzle - No time limit, enjoy the game at your pace 
- Different levels with unique maps in Nuts and bolts game with easy mode and hard mode 
- Try hard to become a screw master after winning hundreds of screw nut puzzle 
Do you possess the foresight and cerebral acumen to untangle these mazes within the township? Prepare to challenge your intellect and etch your name into the annals of bridge construction legend. Become a screw master now!

bluejetty:00153566:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00153566:ios.description:
Plays commentary automatically as you drive so you don't miss any of the best places to visit, plus stories, tips and directions.
There are 150 audio points that play automatically along the scenic drive, featuring the best things to see and do, complete with stories, tips and driving directions. 
As you drive, your professional tour guide shares advice on how to prioritize your time at recommended “not to be missed” viewpoints, suggested side-trips and places of interest. Tours are filled with stories to provide an entertaining and deeper understanding of the region.
Tours work offline using free GPS signal and location services, so no data roaming, network, or Wi-Fi is required while touring.
Visit www.gypsyguide.com for route maps, sample commentary and tips and advice.
WHAT TO EXPECT:
This incredibly scenic drive will no doubt be a highlight of your tour in the Canadian Rockies. It has been voted the World’s Most Beautiful Mountain Drive. You can drive the Icefields Parkway in either direction.
Along the way, we’ll point out the must-do stops of the drive, as well as places that you may want to explore if you have lots of time. Be amazed by the incredible mountains, brightly coloured lakes and glaciers that line the western side of the road.
WHAT YOU’LL SEE:
• Athabasca Falls 
• Sunwapta Falls
• Stutfield Glacier
• Columbia Icefields and Ice Explorer 
• Peyto Lake 
• Bow Lake and Crowfoot Glacier 
• And many more scenic lookouts and photo opportunities
This tour starts at the Highway 1 exit onto 93N (Icefields Parkway) outside of Lake Louise. Join 93N from Jasper by driving south from the town. Its is popular to do this tour as a day trip by driving from Banff or Lake Louise to the Columbia Icefields Centre and back.
CANADIAN ROCKIES GyPSy Guide Tours
This tour is a part of a set of tour apps by GyPSy Guide to explore the Canadian Rockies National Parks. Other tours in the series include:
* Banff, Lake Louise and Yoho National Park
* Banff Townsite and area
* Jasper National Park
For BEST VALUE, you may prefer to download the Canadian Rockies GyPSy Guide which includes all of these too.
NOTES
Download the app on Wi-Fi from your network at home or use any free Wi-Fi network. Because the app is filled with audio commentary and maps, its larger than "normal" apps. Many phone/data networks may block the download because of size - so it's important to download over a Wi-Fi network. 
CHARGING:
++ Continued use of GPS/Location Services in the background increases battery usage. We strongly recommend taking a cigarette style (DC outlet) car charge to keep your phone charged, and avoid charging through the USB port. 
AUDIO:
Listen directly from your phone or connect to the car stereo via Bluetooth. Avoid using a direct connection to the USB port of a rental vehicle as this can cause audio issues. The audio can play through your car’s Apple CarPlay and Android Auto display, please note that the map will display only on your phone.
IPADS:
** iPad models must include a GPS chip. Please note only the iPad Wi-Fi + Cellular models of iPad contain a GPS chip. Wi-Fi-only iPad models have limited location service capabilities and are unable to play commentary automatically.
DOWNLOADING:
The apps are larger in size in order to work offline. You must download the app ahead of time over Wi-Fi (recommended) or cellular data. Once downloaded, you can tour offline without cell service. 
ABOUT US:
GyPSy Guide™ produces award-winning narrated audio tours along scenic drives and road trips around the world. 
Our tours are enjoyed by travelers who prefer to set their own pace and itinerary on vacation, but enjoy a fun, informative and educational guided experience while driving themselves. Our goal is to provide a great introduction to the region and inspire you to learn more and return. 
None of our apps include paid advertising or placements for benefit.

bluejetty:00183252:ios.description:
“The Ultimate App for Wine Enthusiasts” – iPhoneLife Magazine
Take your wine knowledge and enjoyment to the next level with our comprehensive app. It is one of the most popular wine apps in the USA, UK and Canada and is probably the best investment you can make in wine.
Simple and easy to use, the app provides you with insights that would otherwise take years to acquire. For example, understanding wine styles is a revelation and will enable you to approach wines with confidence, like a professional. After using the app for a short while, every wine store you walk into will become an Aladdin’s Cave of hidden treasures.
The unique cellar management function allows you to record and track your wines in a highly visual and meaningful way. Style icons are assigned to each wine and essential details can be seen at a glance. You can save as many photos as you like for each wine and add as much, or as little, information as you want, including notes and ratings. Editing is easy, and search and sort functions allow you to view your wines in multiple ways.
In addition, you can explore a range of dedicated sections in the app on wine styles, grape varieties, food pairing and a unique taste profiling tool to reveal the wines you love based on the foods you like, which is both fun and informative. 
Key benefits include:
• Record all your wines by adding them to the app (add as many wines as you like, there is no limit). View them in a highly visual and meaningful format and profile your cellar in multiple ways. 
• Sync your wines between iPhone and iPad – you can add the app to your other Apple devices free of charge.
• Gain a revealing insight into wine styles through clear and easy to understand definitions.
• Unlimited access to over 100 grape varieties and blends, showing key attributes, detailed descriptions, regional information and food pairing advice for each.
• Dedicated Food Pairing section with expert advice and pairing recommendations for hundreds of meal types.
• Discover your personal taste profile, and those of your friends and family, in the unique My Taste guide.
• Access an extensive Glossary of wine terms, specifically written for the app.
• Frequently Asked Questions section answers all the important questions you may have.
Please note that Pocket Wine does NOT try to sell you wines or review individual wines. The app is dedicated to maximizing your enjoyment and understanding of wine, while providing a professional platform to record your wine experiences and manage your cellar.

bluejetty:00091261:ios.description:
THE PACK
Gin Rummy is played with a 52 card deck, the wild cards (jokers) are not used. It is best to use two decks, so that while one player deals the cards, the opponent can shuffle the other deck.
RANK OF CARDS
The order of the cards, from highest to lowest, is: king (K), queen (Q), jack (J), ten, nine, eight, seven, six, five, four, three, deuce and ace.
As for the value of the cards, the figure cards are worth 10 points and the other cards are worth the value indicated by their pips.
OBJECT OF THE GAME
Each player uses their hand to form combinations of three or more cards, to get more than the 100 points required to win the game before their opponent does so when played over several hands.
THE DEAL
The deck is spread out on the table and each player takes a card. The player who draws the highest card chooses where to sit and deals out ten cards to each player, one by one, leaving the deck with the remaining cards in the center of the table. The top card of the stock deck is placed face up next to it to start the discard pile. In the following games, the player who wins the previous game becomes the dealer.

Timepage is a revolutionary smart calendar with a gorgeous design. It makes every day more productive by combining your events, maps, contacts and weather.
Design:

• An intuitive month heatmap that instantly shows when you are busy and free.
• Over 60 beautiful hand crafted theme colors for the app, home screen widgets and icon 
Devices:

Plan Your Day:
• See beautifully animated temperature and rainfall forecasts for the day so you know what to wear and how to get around.
• Never be late again! Timepage automatically gives you travel time estimates to walk, cycle, drive or catch public transport to your events.
• Timepage will give you helpful hints like “2 hours free after this event then Gym at 6pm”.
• Widgets for weather and events, so that essential info is always a swipe away.

• Works with any calendar already on your iPhone like iCloud, Google, Outlook, Exchange, Facebook, Yahoo and CalDAV.

bluejetty:00068520:ios.name: Equipmentfacts Live Auctions
bluejetty:00068520:ios.summary: Discover Equipmentfacts, the leading platform for participating in live auctions for equipment and trucks. Whether you're looking for construction machinery, farm equipment, trucks, trailers, or any other kind of heavy equipment, Equipmentf
bluejetty:00068520:ios.description:
Discover Equipmentfacts, the leading platform for participating in live auctions for equipment and trucks. Whether you're looking for construction machinery, farm equipment, trucks, trailers, or any other kind of heavy equipment, Equipmentfacts connects you with auctioneers and sellers across North America and makes auctioning and bidding on equipment in live auctions fast, easy, and secure.
EXPERIENCE LIVE AUCTIONS FROM ANYWHERE
Equipmentfacts offers simulcast auction broadcasts, allowing you to participate in real-time live auctions from your device. You can watch and listen to live sales, view photos and descriptions of items on the block, and place bids as if you were attending the auction in person.
EXPLORE THOUSANDS OF EQUIPMENT LISTINGS WITH PERSONALIZED SEARCH 
Browse a wide inventory of auction listings for various types of equipment and vehicles across the construction, farming, livestock, trucking, and other equipment-heavy industries. Find the perfect machinery to meet your operational needs in the simulcasted live auctions, and once you’ve won the bid, explore financing and delivery options offered by AuctionTime’s trusted financing and shipping partners, CurrencyFinance and FR8Star.
Use advanced search tools to filter auction listings by category, manufacturer, location, and more. Save time with personalized filters to find exactly what you need. Stay updated with new listings and personalized alerts while browsing category pages updated daily with fresh inventory.
Once you've narrowed your search, view detailed specifications, photos, and videos of your desired items. Equipmentfacts provides powerful yet intuitive search capabilities and detailed filtering options.
EASILY TRACK EQUIPMENT YOU ARE INTERESTED IN BIDDING ON
Create a private watch list to save your favorite listings and set up email and text alerts for important auction events. Not only you can bid in real-time on Equipmentfacts, but you can also pre-bid and set max bid amounts to ensure that you won’t get over the set budget.
AUCTION MANAGEMENT MADE SIMPLE
For auctioneers, Equipmentfacts offers comprehensive auction and bidder management solutions. Reach a global audience of qualified buyers actively searching for equipment auctions. Utilize powerful software to input inventory, create sale catalogs, and manage sales efficiently. 
Click the "My Inventory" button in your Equipmentfacts app and get transferred to the Sandhills Inventory Management app, your trusted, easy, and cost-effective way to track and manage inventory. Add listings, set prices, upload photos and videos, edit descriptions, and update your listings on the go-right from your iOS device.
CHOOSE EQUIPMENTFACTS FOR ALL YOUR AUCTION NEEDS
Whether you're a buyer looking for your next piece of equipment or an auctioneer seeking to expand your reach, Equipmentfacts provides the tools and exposure you need. Connect with a vast network of industry professionals and access a wide range of equipment and trucks.
As part of Sandhills Global, AuctionTime links you to a network that includes TractorHouse, Truck Paper, Machinery Trader, Controller, RVUniverse, MotorSportsUniverse, Equipmentfacts, and other trusted platforms. 
GET THE EQUIPMENTFACTS APP NOW
Join thousands of auctioneers, sellers, and bidders who trust Equipmentfacts to manage their auction operations. Download the app today to participate in live auctions, place bids, and connect with the vast equipment market!

bluejetty:00042546:ios.description:
Meet singles. Say Hi. No match required.
iCupid is a dating app for meeting new people nearby or around the world. Browse full-screen profiles and send a Say Hi when someone catches your eye—without waiting for a mutual match. Whether you’re hoping to find love or exploring a new connection, take the first step with a conversation.
Immersive Vibe Check (No More Boring Profiles):
• TikTok-Style Scroll: Ditch the old-school cards. Swipe up or down to scroll through premium, full-screen photo feeds effortlessly.
• Explore the Gallery: Swipe horizontally to unlock the user's full photo gallery. See their true lifestyle at a single glance.
• 100% Focus on Them: One profile at a time. No distractions—just pure focus on the person and their real energy.
Zero Match, Pure Action (Skip the "Hey" Phase):
• Direct Messaging (DM): Spotted your crush? Don't wait for a match. Hit "Say Hi" to slide into their inbox instantly and cut through the noise.
• AI-Powered Icebreakers: Not sure what to say? Get an AI-generated opening suggestion to help you write your first message.
• Voice Prompts & Say Hi: Texting is dead. Listen to their voice bio or send an Audio Say Hi to feel the chemistry instantly.
Local Focus, Global Access:
Expand Your Horizons: Whether you’re looking to unlock local singles in your town or vibe with fascinating global citizens across the world, iCupid bridges the gap. Endless profiles, unlimited possibilities.
Download iCupid today and start your journey toward meaningful connections.
iCupid Pro Subscription
Upgrade to iCupid Pro to unlock the full potential of iCupid, including Unlimited Rewinds (swipe down to go back) and enhanced visibility.
• Payment: Your iTunes account will be charged upon confirmation of purchase.
• Auto-Renewal: Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Management: You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal anytime in your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
• Pricing: Current subscriptions start at $9.99 USD/month. Options are available for 1, 6, and 12-month packages. Prices are clearly displayed in the app, may vary by country, and are subject to change without notice.
• Cancellations: No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active period.
If you choose not to go iCupid Pro, you can continue using iCupid for free with all standard features.
Disclaimer: All photos are of models and used for illustrative purposes only.
++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
By using iCupid, you agree to our Terms: https://www.icupid.cc/terms.html

Whether you need a weekend car rental, an airport pickup, or a monthly EV subscription, Eon gives you flexible options with clear pricing and real support.
Why Drivers Choose Eon:
• Top EV Fleet: Drive the Tesla Model 3, Model Y, Model X, Cybertruck, Rivian, and Lucid.
• Contactless Access: Instant booking and keyless unlock from your phone.
• We Come to You: Airport, hotel, and home delivery available in many cities.
• Flexible Terms: Daily, weekly, and monthly rentals to fit your schedule.

NOTE: This is NOT the official US Army Jumpmaster School app. Please download the official app too. It contains some basic administrative information not found in this app. This app is specifically designed as a study aid for Jumpmaster School. It's a tough school. Every study aid will help.

bluejetty:00129279:ios.name: Uniden Solo
bluejetty:00129279:ios.summary: The App Cam Solo is a full HD, weatherproof smart camera. Completely wire-free, the app cam is battery powered with advanced power-saving technology featuring up to 180 days standby time. With quick and easy installation, the camera can be
bluejetty:00129279:ios.description:
The App Cam Solo is a full HD, weatherproof smart camera. Completely wire-free, the app cam is battery powered with advanced power-saving technology featuring up to 180 days standby time. With quick and easy installation, the camera can be placed anywhere inside or outside of the home.
Offering a 110-degree viewing angle, which provides a greater field of vision, the Guardian App Cam Solo can be fitted to any flat surface with an easy-to-install magnetic base. Also included is an optional screw base for those more easy-to-reach areas, such as the front door. Cameras can be twisted to an angle to suit any situation and easily moved around the home without the need to re-wire or place near a power source, providing complete flexibility when setting up viewing angles.
The App Cam Solo connects directly to the local Wi-Fi network and features motion detection recording directly to an SD card. Users can access the App Cam Solo with a Smartphone or tablet via the free to download Uniden Solo app, which also provides users remote access to the cameras to check-in from anywhere in the world. With optional app push notifications when motion or sound is detected, users can be reassured the home is safe while at work or on holiday.
Users can connect as many cameras as they wish in areas such as, the driveway, garage, front and back entrances and upstairs. The camera can even be used to check on pets or babies while in other areas of the house.
The camera features PIR motion sensor, which detects movement and will send notifications to the user via the app. Users have the ability to two-way talk in real time through the camera, for easy communication with visitors including couriers, while also acting as a deterrent to unwanted guests.
The flexible, innovative Uniden App Cam Solo camera provides peace of mind at home or while away.
The Uniden Solo app is compatible with Uniden range of Guardian App Cam Solo Range

Billease makes your online shopping affordable and convenient by spreading your payments into simple installment plans. Just find what you want at any of our online merchant stores, choose Pay with Billease, and enjoy flexible monthly payments. Earn rewards.
💙Billease is the best shopping finance experience in the Philippines
MUCH BETTER THAN CASH LOAN OR CONSUMER LOAN
 Paying with Billease is more convenient than SSS loans, consumer loans, or cash credit. Buy what you want today directly on Lazada or at any of our merchants and select to pay with Billease. That splits your purchase into convenient installments. We’ll notify you when payments are due. No collateral or down payment required. Borrow for shopping online. Credit approval is fast, with most getting instant decisions. You don’t have to deal with cash, just shop and enjoy.
BETTER THAN CASH CREDIT OR CREDIT CARD
 Billease is built for the digital age. Transactions are secure through integration in our partner checkout process. No credit card numbers to worry about. Always track your transactions in the app.
MORE THAN 10,000 MERCHANTS
 Lazada, Kimstore, Mandaue Foam, Anson’s, Philippine Airlines, Agoda, Datablitz, and many more. Enjoy 0% interest at Anker, Cole Haan, Jockey, KitchenAid, Tempur. Load your phone and settle next due date with no fees. GCash, Maya, coins.ph and GrabPay top-ups are also available.
EXCLUSIVE DEALS & FLEXIBLE INSTALLMENTS
Shop gadgets, electronics, lifestyle items with special discounts in Deals. Get free shipping and limited offers. For bigger purchases or extra breathing room, convert any QRPh or Tap-to-Pay transaction into installments before your due date. Buy in the app, pay later.
PAY ANYWHERE WITH QRPh & NFC
 Use your Billease credit line at over 600,000 merchants nationwide through QRPh-enabled stores. Just scan the QR to pay, enjoy now, and convert your purchase into flexible installments before your due date.
EASY BILL PAYMENT
Pay 100s of billers including Globe, Smart, Meralco, Maynilad, Manila Water, Easytrip RFID, and even government contributions like SSS and Pag-Ibig.
ENJOY LOWEST INTEREST RATES FOR ONLINE PURCHASES
 Enjoy the benefits without paying upfront. We charge the lowest interest rate at only 3.49% monthly. Watch out for 0% APR promos with selected merchants and mobile load.
CONVENIENT REPAYMENT OPTIONS
Pay your installments via QRPh, InstaPay or PESONet, direct bank deposits, coins.ph, or at over 22,000 7-Eleven, Cebuana, and MLhuillier outlets.
NO FUNNY BUSINESS
What you see is what you pay, no hidden fees. The app lets you configure installments and see the exact amount upfront. We generate a Disclosure Statement in compliance with the Truth in Lending Act.
INFORMATION ABOUT THE COST OF YOUR INSTALLMENT PLAN
- Monthly interest rate ranges from 0% to 3.49%
- Annual Percentage Rate (APR) ranges from 0% to 41.88%
- Service charges range from 0% to 10%
- Loan amounts range from PhP 500 to 50,000
- Installment terms are flexible from 2 to 24 months
REPRESENTATIVE EXAMPLE OF THE TOTAL COST OF A LOAN
- 3-month Lazada Installment plan for PhP 12,000:
We will disburse PhP 12,000 to your Lazada Wallet (no upfront deductions).
- You will repay in 3 monthly installments of PhP 4,539 (PhP 4,000 Principal, PhP 419 Interest, PhP 120 Service Charge each).
- Total repayment = PhP 13,617 (PhP 12,000 Principal + PhP 1,257 Interest + PhP 360 Service Charge).

IPTV Xtream – Smart IPTV Player for Your Playlists
IPTV Xtream is a fast, flexible IPTV smart player for playing and organizing content from your own authorized sources. Connect through Xtream Codes API, import M3U playlists, or open direct MP4 links to create a personalized library of live channels, movies, series, and compatible media.
Whether you need an IPTV player, Xtream IPTV solution, IPTV Pro experience, or an alternative to IPTV Smarters Pro, IPTV Smarters Lite, GSE Smart IPTV, DMAC IPTV, 247 IPTV, and other Smarters IPTV players, IPTV Xtream provides convenient playback and playlist-management tools in one intuitive app.
CREATE. ORGANIZE. STREAM.
MULTIPLE PLAYLIST SUPPORT
Manage multiple playlists for different users, profiles, providers, or content categories. Quickly switch between saved libraries and keep your IPTV content organized.
XTREAM CODES, M3U AND MP4
Connect using compatible Xtream Codes API details, import M3U playlists, or add direct MP4 links. IPTV Xtream supports authorized live IPTV streams, VOD libraries, and personal media.
ADVANCED IPTV PLAYER
Enjoy smooth playback with support for popular formats, including M3U, MP4, MOV, and WebVTT subtitles. The integrated player delivers the convenient experience expected from a modern IPTV stream player.
PICTURE-IN-PICTURE
Continue watching compatible videos in a floating window while using other apps.
BACKGROUND PLAYBACK
Keep supported audio playing when the app is minimized or your device is locked.
AIRPLAY SUPPORT
Send compatible content to an AirPlay-enabled television or device and enjoy your playlists on a larger screen.
YOUR PERSONALIZED MEDIA HUB
Create custom channel lists, organize VOD libraries, add multiple users, and manage your content in one place. IPTV Xtream puts your playlists and viewing preferences in your hands.
USE IPTV XTREAM TO:
• Play authorized M3U playlists
• Connect to compatible Xtream Codes API services
• Open supported MP4 media links
• Organize live channels and VOD libraries
• Manage multiple users and playlists
• Watch with Picture-in-Picture
• Use background playback and AirPlay
PREMIUM FEATURES
Upgrade to IPTV Xtream Premium to unlock:
• Picture-in-Picture and lock-screen playback
• AirPlay support

bluejetty:00123217:ios.summary:
All US and international markets information you need covered in one innovative app.
Get access to free live quotes and price alerts from markets around the world, as well as historical data, breaking global stories from our newsroom, compa
bluejetty:00123217:ios.description:
All US and international markets information you need covered in one innovative app.
Get access to free live quotes and price alerts from markets around the world, as well as historical data, breaking global stories from our newsroom, company profiles, full screen real-time charts, stock screener, currency converter and much more. Full personalization possible with custom watchlists, portfolios and price-based push alerts.
App designed for private users, professional use not allowed without authorization.
REAL-TIME DATA & LIVE SEARCH
- Live quotes with push prices - no manual reloading of the data is necessary!
- Powerful live search featuring our huge data universe - look up your individual symbols 
- Current news updates for global events 
- Covers markets around the world (stocks, futures, indices, commodities, currencies…)
PRE-DEFINED MARKET OVERVIEWS & EXTENSIVE DETAIL PAGES
- Overviews of most popular symbols for Markets, Commodities, Indices, Currencies, Interest Rates, Hot Stocks
- Extensive detail view for each symbol based on symbol type (stock, commodity, currency etc.) 
- Arbitrage lists: View a symbol on different markets
- Company profiles & company news for stocks
- Related futures/options for a symbol
PORTFOLIO
- Multiple personal portfolios to keep track of your gains and losses
- Define the starting capital, portfolio currency, fees, deposits and redemptions 
- Add / remove symbols with simulated buy/sell transactions (incl. fees & comments)
- Show profit/loss per position and for complete portfolio
- Share your portfolio with our other mobile apps (e.g. for iPad) 
PERSONAL WATCHLISTS
- Customisable price lists for monitoring your assets
- Real-time prices with many display options (Last & Change%, Performance View, QuoteBoard, Chart View and more)
REAL-TIME PUSH ALERTS
- Automatically triggered price-based notifications
- Daily e-mail notifications about a customised list of securities 
- Alerts sent automatically by Apple Push 
- E-mail alerts and text messages
ADVANCED REAL-TIME CHARTING & TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
- Track price movements on our interactive full screen charts 
- Candlesticks, OHLC Bars, Mountain or Line charts (incl. Volume)
- Timeframes: Daily, Weekly, Monthly or Intraday (1 / 5 / 10 / 15 / 30 / 60 Minutes)
- Linear, percentage or logarithmic scaling available
- Additional features like zooming, crosshair, chart templates, benchmark comparison 
- Supports the most popular indicators for technical analysis, like Moving Average, ADX, Average True Range, Bollinger Bands, CCI, Directional Movement Plus/Minus, DM System, Envelopes, Highest High, Lowest Low, Ichimoku, MACD, Momentum, Money Flow Index, OBV, Price Change, Parabolic SAR, ROC, TRIX, Volatility, RSI,...
STOCK SCREENER 
- Easy picking of the most promising securities out of thousands 
- Covering the world's major stock exchanges 
- Performance filters (Change %, Performance 1 Week, 1 Month, 3 Months, 6 Months,1 Year, 3 Years, 5 Years, 10 Years)
- Fundamental filters like market cap, EBIT, EBITDA, net income & turnover
CURRENCY CONVERTER
- Easy-to-use calculator using current rates from major world currencies (also includes Bitcoin)
- Online and offline
MARKET COVERAGE
- Major Stock markets & Indices, like Nasdaq, Dow Jones, S&P 500, S&P 100, FTSE 100, DAX, EuroStoxx 50, Nikkei 225 etc.
- Commodities markets, incl. precious metals (gold, silver, platinum, palladium, copper), energy, agricultural and livestock products
- Futures / Options markets, for example CME, CBOT etc.
- Major Currency pairs, such as EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY etc. as well as Bitcoin rates (BTC/USD) 
- Interest Rates, Bonds, ETFs
- Free real-time data (where available) 
- Additional real-time data packages from your baha Terminal accounts

bluejetty:00061496:ios.description:
DaySmart Spa, formerly Orchid, is a powerful scheduling and business management app specifically designed for any size spa, makeup clinic, or wellness studio. This booking app is designed for any size business whether you manage employees, independent contractors, or a business all your own. DaySmart Spa efficiently manages appointments, customer profiles, inventory, card payments, advanced reports, loyalty programs, and automated email and text marketing campaigns. Sign up for a 2-week risk-free trial and cancel any time.
PLEASE NOTE: Although the app is free, your DaySmart Spa software subscription has a low in-app monthly fee. Try for 2 weeks FREE. The app does not work without a subscription.
APPOINTMENTS MADE EASY
Streamlined appointment software makes it easy to schedule appointments. Customize your booking style and allow for appointment and room set-up, adjust individual schedules, add time blocks, and service limitations. Activate online booking and allow customers to request appointments 24/7. All while appointment reminders are sent automatically to free up your time.
ONLINE BOOKING THAT WORKS
Set up a fully customized online booking website in minutes and begin taking appointments online 24/7. Your online booking website integrates seamlessly with your Facebook and Instagram pages too! No need to worry, you will be alerted when an appointment is made. You can then accept or reject the appointment requests from within the app and clients receive email notifications automatically! 
CREDIT CARD POINT OF SALE
Our customers love the integrated point of sale POS system. Accept credit cards using a convenient mobile credit card reader, or type in credit card information to process credit or debit card transactions. Receipts are emailed automatically when you are done. With the integrated solution you can also sell customized gift cards right from your website, store cards on file for contactless payments, accept prepayments, charge no-show fees, and manage memberships. 
EASILY MANAGE CLIENT INFO
Stay up to date on client contact information and set permissions regarding who can access it. Within the client profile, you can easily keep track of service notes, formulations, and view client history including past product/service purchases and upcoming appointments. Texting features allow you to send a quick text or email right from their profile. You can even manage digital intake forms and waivers. DaySmart Spa™ makes it easy to keep up-to-date and in contact with all your clients.
PRODUCT SALES AND INVENTORY
Manage product inventory and check out purchases right from your phone or tablet. Inventory levels are maintained automatically as products are sold, so you will always know how many retail products you have on hand and quickly determine what to reorder.
OVER 25 BUSINESS REPORTS
Stay on top of your sales and view information immediately. Check your total sales, percentage booked, product inventory levels, and more right from your device with over 25 comprehensive reports to make it easy to run your business from anywhere.
• Manage tips and employee sales totals
• Commission and hourly payroll calculation
• Modify appointments, schedules, services, permissions, categories, and settings
• Powerful dashboard to set goals and track progress
• Pop-up notes for better communication
• Add Text Marketing for targeted campaigns or to fill in last-minute openings 
• Add Reputation Management to collect reviews and post on social sites
• Manage walk-ins when connecting to the DaySmart Salon Kiosk App
• Mobile Mapping for travel service providers
SUPPORT QUESTIONS
If you experience any issues, please contact our customer support specialists via e-mail at support@daysmart.com or by phone (800) 604-2040.
