bluejetty:00100520:ios.name: Pookie: Couples Widgets, Games
bluejetty:00100520:ios.summary: Pookie is an app for couples, built so the two of you have somewhere that belongs only to you. You raise a pet together, send each other notes and doodles that land straight on the home screen, play games across two phones, and build up a r
bluejetty:00100520:ios.description:
Pookie is an app for couples, built so the two of you have somewhere that belongs only to you. You raise a pet together, send each other notes and doodles that land straight on the home screen, play games across two phones, and build up a record of your relationship that nobody else gets to see. Whether you live together or a few time zones apart, it gives you a reason to check in on each other every day.
RAISE A PET TOGETHER
You start with an egg, hatch it and name it between you, choosing from twelve pets that include dogs, cats, pandas, penguins, capybaras and a dragon. Keeping it fed, watered and played with is a shared job, and the small care games you do it through change every time so it never turns into a chore.
GROW A PLANT
Alongside the pet there is a plant that begins as a seedling and only thrives if you both remember it. Pick a monstera, cactus, aloe, sunflower, lily or bush, and put it in whichever pot suits the two of you.
PLAY TOGETHER FROM ANYWHERE
Fourteen games made for two, from Draw Something and Ludo through to Snakes & Ladders, Pool, Battleships, Connect 4 and Wavelength, all played at your own pace across two phones rather than crowded around one. There is a fresh daily challenge every morning as well, and the two of you keep score.
NOTES, DOODLES AND MOODS
Write your partner a note or draw them something silly, and it turns up on their home screen without them having to open anything. You can share how you are feeling whenever the mood takes you, and they can answer it, so the small stuff that usually goes unsaid has somewhere to go.
WIDGETS THAT KEEP THEM CLOSE
Ten home screen widgets, covering their latest doodle, their mood, your pet and plant, how many days you have been together, their local time, the distance between you, your streak, what is coming up and your horoscope for the day.
A PLACE FOR EVERYTHING ELSE
There is a photo vault behind a passcode that only you two can open, and a journal where you can write entries, attach photos and pin where you were, until the map fills up with everywhere you have been together.
QUESTIONS AND CHECK-INS
More than 10,000 questions, from easy openers to the ones you have been putting off, plus daily and monthly check-ins that you each answer on your own before comparing what the other one said.
LEVELS, STREAKS AND HEARTS
Everything you do together earns XP, so caring for the pet, sending a note or answering a question all move you up. Leveling up pays out hearts, which you spend on new pets, plants, pots, beds and backgrounds.
FREE
Your pet and plant, messages and doodles with fourteen days of history, the photo vault, moods and replies, important dates, the journal, widgets, the daily challenge, check-ins, levels, streaks and daily rewards.
PREMIUM
One subscription covers both of you, so your partner gets everything free. It adds all 10,000+ questions, online games, the shared whiteboard, your daily couples horoscope, exclusive pets and plants, every widget and double XP on everything you do.
Hearts come from leveling up and daily rewards, and you can buy them separately if you would rather unlock things sooner.
Whatever happens inside Pookie stays between you and your partner. There are no ads and nothing is sold on.
https://pookie-app.com/privacy
https://pookie-app.com/terms

bluejetty:00023365:ios.summary:

Does that RING a bell? We bring the triumph of the creepy video cassette from the
bluejetty:00023365:ios.description:
Imagine there’s a video full of nightmarish and shocking pictures. As soon as you’ve seen it, your phone rings and a voice whispers "You have 7 days left …”
Does that RING a bell? We bring the triumph of the creepy video cassette from the 90s to the present! When evil enters your smartphone, your life will turn into a horror trip!
THE INTERACTIVE HORROR STORY OF “The Sign”
Your classmate and good friend Gabriela has been acting strangely for a week and has been keeping to herself more and more.
Just when you were about to contact her parents, she gets in touch and shares her mysterious story: Exactly 7 days ago, she saw a creepy video and then received a call saying that she was going to die TODAY ...
While you and the other students from your course don't believe the story, the video suddenly starts on your mobile phone - and the real horror begins!
You let evil into your life and the lives of your loved ones. Soon the question arises: is there really a curse on the video?
Follow the clues hidden in pictures, chat messages, documents and in the video.
Solve the dark secret and save the lives of your family and friends.
What secret does the mysterious video hide?
Who is the mysterious ghost woman?
And who is not who he claims to be?
Now it's up to you!
YOU DECIDE ON CHAT MESSAGES, YOU INFLUENCE THE STORY
Your decisions affect the course and end of the interactive horror thriller story.
YOU alone decide how the story and your relationship with the different characters develop.
It's up to you to collect clues, solve puzzles and ultimately stop evil!
But be careful, because you can't trust everyone ...
CHARACTERS AND RELATIONSHIPS.
In “The Sign”, you can decide for yourself how you want to interact with the people in your life. By selecting your gender and sharing your name, you can enjoy a customized gaming experience. 
The messages you choose will affect the relationships with all the characters and the development of the story.
THE INTERACTIVE GAME OF “THE SIGN”
“The Sign” is like a thrilling ride in the ghost train, full of mysterious clues, puzzles and creepy effects. It’s up to you to fight for the life of your friends and family! You will receive and send chat messages that directly affect the course of this interactive horror game.
The scary story is accompanied by pictures, voice messages, video calls, mini-games, videos and newspaper reports created especially for the game.
“The Sign” is released in episodes, so while you’re playing we’re already working on the next part of the story.
Therefore, we're especially looking forward to your feedback and suggestions, which you can send to the following e-mail: support@the-sign.de.
This episode and all upcoming ones of the Horror Chat Thriller are completely free to play!
Optional in-app purchases can speed up the course of the story and the game.

bluejetty:00060817:ios.description:
uShip makes car shipping, house moves, and transporting large, heavy, or any larger-than-parcel item easier and more affordable. Whether you're relocating, shipping a vehicle, or moving furniture, uShip connects you with trusted carriers who can get the job done.
Key Features:
Find, List, and Book Shipments: Easily search for new shipments, post your own, and track active ones.
Car Shipping & Moving Truck Solutions: Get competitive quotes from carriers specializing in car transport and delivery services.
Create & Save Searches: Set shipment alerts for items you want to move.
Bid, Watch, and Book: Compare carrier bids and choose the best fit.
Instant Notifications: Get real-time updates on shipments and bids.
Q&A with Carriers: Ask and answer questions before booking.
Secure Payments: Release payments only when the job is complete.
Leave Feedback & View Profiles: Make informed choices by checking carrier ratings.
Popular Use Cases:
Car Shipping: Bought a car on eBay or from a dealership across the country? Easily arrange secure vehicle transport.
Moving Truck Alternative: Relocating your home or office? Find cost-effective solutions for heavy items.
Marketplace Purchases: Need to ship furniture or other large items from Facebook Marketplace, OfferUp, or Craigslist? uShip has you covered.
Business Freight: Manage commercial shipments and delivery logistics with ease, including LTL and full truckloads.
Household Moves: From couches to pianos, uShip helps you move what matters.Whether you’re moving cross-country, shipping a newly purchased vehicle, or transporting marketplace finds, uShip is the all-in-one solution for stress-free transport.
Note: Looking to be or already a Carrier on uShip? Use this app to access uShip's load board. Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life.
Privacy Policy: http://www.uship.com/privacy.aspx 
Have questions or feedback? Contact us at support@uship.com

Fairy Princess is a new wonderland theme play house game presented by Papo World. This pretend play game gives you a unique interactive experience! No rules, more fun! 
Purple Pink the Bunny lives with friends in a wonderful world of magic
bluejetty:00172393:ios.description:
Fairy Princess is a new wonderland theme play house game presented by Papo World. This pretend play game gives you a unique interactive experience! No rules, more fun! 
Purple Pink the Bunny lives with friends in a wonderful world of magic where fairies, mermaids, dwarfs, trolls, dragons and other magical creatures exist. She has many miraculous magnifiers. With these magnifiers, you could discover props like gemstones, magic wands, fairy eggs, keys to treasure boxes, and lots of very handy tools to tame your magical beasts. 
Travel with Purple Pink to these mystical scenes like the Snow Mountain, the Dragon Island, the Hunter’s Shop, the Fairytale Castle, the Magic Alley and 10 more places to go! Explore in tons of marvelous magical scenes and meet various fantastic creatures! Find beautiful fairies in places like the fairy wonderland and play with them! You could even hatch fairy eggs and get little spirits! Dig precious crystals in the Crystal Mine Cave and polish them into beautiful artwork. Look for special cottons and make gorgeous fairy dresses out of them! Cook delicious food in the Dragon Island and serve your special guests. Have a music party with the mermaids in the Mermaid Beach. 
At the same time, you will be joined with lots of cool new characters! So start your journey of adventure and exploration in Papo Town: Fairy Princess, and create your own fantasy story! 
【Features】
 Exploration, Creativity and Imagination
 Hundreds of interactive items and props!
 More than 100 cool new characters
 Lots of beautiful dresses and accessories. 
 Looking for surprises and discover hidden tricks!
 No rules, more fun!
 Multi-touch supported. Play with your friends!
 No Wi-Fi needed. It can be played anywhere!
This version of Papo Town Fairy Princess is free to download. Unlock more rooms through in-app purchase. Once complete the purchase, it will be permanently unlocked and bound with your account. 
If there are any questions during the purchase and playing, feel free to contact us via contact@papoworld.com
【contact us】
Mailbox: contact@papoworld.com
website: www.papoworld.com
Face book: https://www.facebook.com/PapoWorld/
【Privacy Policy】
We respect and value the health and privacy of children, you can find out more at http://m.3girlgames.com/app-privacy.html.

bluejetty:00031869:ios.name: Wave Connect
bluejetty:00031869:ios.summary:
Wave Connect is the digital business card, lead capture, and contact management app built for modern professionals, teams, and enterprises.
Create a professional digital business card in minutes, share it instantly with a QR code, NFC card
bluejetty:00031869:ios.description:
Wave Connect is the digital business card, lead capture, and contact management app built for modern professionals, teams, and enterprises.
Create a professional digital business card in minutes, share it instantly with a QR code, NFC card, Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, iPhone widget, email, SMS, social media, or link, and capture every new connection in one organized place.
Wave Connect helps you remember who you meet, follow up on time, scan paper business cards, capture event leads, sync contacts to your CRM, and manage digital business cards across your team.
CREATE A DIGITAL BUSINESS CARD
Build a modern virtual business card that works on any device. Add your contact details, profile photo, company, job title, bio, social links, website, calendar booking link, files, videos, and more. Update your information anytime without reprinting paper cards.
SHARE ANYWHERE
Share your digital business card using:
• Custom QR code
• NFC business card
• Apple/Google Wallet
• Email signature
• SMS and messaging apps
• Social media
• Direct profile link
Recipients do not need the Wave app or a Wave account to view your card or save your contact details.
SCAN BUSINESS CARDS & EVENT BADGES
Use Wave’s AI-powered scanner to capture paper business cards, QR codes, barcodes, and event badges. Convert physical cards and conference badges into digital contacts, enrich missing details, add notes, and keep every lead organized.
CAPTURE LEADS AT EVENTS
Turn conferences, trade shows, meetings, and networking events into measurable pipeline. Capture leads offline, qualify contacts with notes and tags, export to CSV, and sync event leads to your CRM without manual data entry or rental equipment.
MANAGE CONTACTS & FOLLOW UPS
Wave Connect helps you remember every connection. Add personal notes, tag contacts by event or context, set reminders, and organize your professional network so no opportunity gets lost after a meeting.
SYNC WITH YOUR CRM
Send new contacts and leads to your sales workflow with CRM integrations and exports. Wave Connect supports popular tools including Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, Outlook, Microsoft Dynamics, Zapier, and CSV export, helping you reduce manual data entry and follow up faster.
ANALYTICS THAT SHOW WHAT WORKS
Track profile views, card shares, link clicks, contacts captured, lead activity, team adoption, event performance, and networking ROI. See which cards, events, and team members are creating the most engagement.
BUILT FOR INDIVIDUALS, TEAMS & ENTERPRISE
Wave Connect is free for individuals and powerful for teams. Businesses can create, manage, and update employee digital business cards from one dashboard, standardize branding, lock fields, deploy email signatures, bulk import users, and manage leads across the organization.
Enterprise teams can use advanced controls including SSO, SCIM provisioning, admin roles, brand templates, custom domains, CRM integrations, SOC 2 Type II compliance, and GDPR-ready workflows.
EMAIL SIGNATURES
Create branded email signatures using the same contact information from your digital business card. Deploy professional signatures to Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, and other email clients.
WHY CHOOSE WAVE CONNECT?
• Free digital business card for individuals
• Unlimited sharing
• Unlimited contacts
• QR code, NFC, Apple Wallet, and Google Wallet sharing
• AI business card scanner
• AI event badge scanner
• Offline lead capture
• Contact notes, tags, and reminders
• CRM sync and CSV export
• Advanced analytics
• Team templates and admin controls
• Branded email signatures
• Secure platform for teams and enterprises
Stop losing contacts, missing follow-ups, and reprinting outdated paper business cards. With Wave Connect, you can create a digital business card, share your profile instantly, capture leads anywhere, and build stronger professional relationships.

bluejetty:00024599:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00024599:ios.description:
Baby Puzzle Games for Toddlers is an educational jigsaw app boasting 100+ easy-to-use puzzles for toddlers aged 2, 3, 4 and 5 years old. 
Puzzle baby games improve cognitive and motor skills, which are crucial in the development of 2, 3, 4 and 5 year old kids. Puzzles also help kids learn basic concepts, improve physical skills and learn problem-solving. With Baby Puzzle Games for Toddlers, kids can learn the names of various animals, fish, food, dinosaurs and much more! But best of all, puzzles are just fun! 
Baby Puzzle Games for Toddlers is all about kids and our app designs are guided by 3 key principals. 
1. Kids are curious and so we need to provide them with valuable content that encourages them to learn new knowledge and develop skills
2. Kids require safety. Each app demands the highest safety standards and therefore designing our apps as a safe and friendly space is one of our top priorities
3. Kids love to play. We see our apps as a playroom for millions of kids worldwide and therefore try hard to make each puzzle as entertaining as it is educational.
With Baby Puzzle Games for Toddlers, kids can discover 100+ different objects across 9 puzzle categories – from Dinosaurs, food, farm, domestic and wild animals, fish & sea life, to toys, flowers, plants and bugs. 
Why Baby Puzzle Games for Toddlers? 
► Sort, match Shapes and complete Jigsaw puzzles
► Developed and tested by child development and baby game experts
► Designed for safety and convenience with no toddler supervision required
► Parental Gate - code protected sections so that your child doesn’t accidentally change settings or make unwanted purchases
► All settings and outbound links are protected and only accessible for adults
► Available offline and playable without an internet connection
► Timely hints so your child doesn't feel frustrated or lost in the app
► 100 % Ad free with no annoying interruptions
Who says learning can't be fun? 
Please support us by writing reviews if you like the app or let us know about any issue or suggestions too.

bluejetty:00023464:ios.description:
The all new KFC Bahrain App is the fastest way to order your favorite KFC fried chicken online. Ordering food online within a few clicks has never been so easy. Pick up the food or get it delivered at your doorstep, in just a few taps from the latest KFC online food ordering app!
At KFC, we believe in real cooks, freshly-prepared good food and unrelenting quality control. Our aim is to take convenience to a whole new level and want you to have your favorite chicken available, right from the convenience of your home.
*Get started and order in minimum steps: 
1. Download the app,
2. Choose a preferred mode of language,
3. Check your favorite items categorized as part of the menu,
4. Add items to the cart,
5. Log in to use Saved Addresses or continue as Guest,
6. Choose a mode of ordering as pickup or delivery,
7. Select location and provide a delivery address/pickup address,
8. Proceed to checkout and make payment,
9. Track your order and get it delivered as lightning fast delivery,
10. Enjoy the food delivered at your doorstep. 
Why you should use KFC App:
*Pickup or Takeaway: 
When driving, pickup your delicious food from any nearest store by ordering from the application. 
*Car Hop:
100% Contactless and hassle-free experience. For our customers we bring Car Hop service for contactless delivery in your car parked in our premises.
*Late night delivery: 
Late night hunger pangs. Look no further and simply order food online from full KFC menu & we’ll rush to you with delicious chicken items even at 3 AM. This is available at select locations only.
*Social Login:
Why spend time in the login process when it can be done via social mode. Use your Google or Facebook or Apple account to login with ease.
kentucky fried chicken
*Hassle-free payments:
With multiple payment options (including Cash on Delivery, Online payments like Credit/Debit Cards etc.) at your fingertips, it’s now easier than ever to pay for your order. 
*Full KFC Menu: Order from the range of options - KFC bucket meals, Wraps, Zinger box meals, Dinner combos, Filler sandwiches, Combos for one or for sharing etc. with a variety of options from Sides & Desserts.
*Special Offers:
Coupons, Offers & deals customized only for you so that you can order more and get rewarded at times you order. 
*Have any feedback or queries?
KFC’s customer care is happy to help! Voice Support –177 111 11, or drop a mail to apps@americana-food.com . For more details, log into https://bahrain.kfc.me/#/privacy

bluejetty:00133533:ios.description:
Love Home is an essential app for couples that offers love days counter, relationship tracker, partner interaction and anniversary reminder features. You can also connect with your best friends or partner and decorate an adorable home together. Love Home is LGBTQ+ friendly.
** Special Features For Couples **
Adorable Home For Couples
You can place furniture, scenes, and characters to decorate and design, as well as create a sweet home with your lover.
Cute Pets
The pet co-parenting function, so you can keep adorable pets with your lover!
Love Days Counter
Enter the date when your love begins, the app will count the been together days for you.
Countdown Or Count Up Your Events
Countdown upcoming anniversaries (birthday, wedding, vacation) or Count up from a special day (love day, been together) in the past.
Anniversary Tracker
Create your own anniversary together and never forget every special day.
Love Alarm
You can set a reminder for your anniversary and choose how often it repeats (daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly). So that you can easily see at a glance how many days are left until the next anniversary.
Do Task Get More Coins
You can record the moments of your relationship everyday to be rewarded with coins, which can be used to decorate your love home.
Mood Status
Whenever you miss your partner, you can tap the bubbles and choose emojis to express your mood and feelings at any time.
Post-it Notes
You can use the fridge magnets to record daily notes or message reminders, and share them with your lover at any time to express your love.
Share Photo
You can upload a sweet photo of you and your couple or your best friend, and show it in the adorable home to create a cozy and homey atmosphere!
If you have better suggestions, please contact us, thank you!
Feedback E-Mail: memorywidget@126.com
Privacy Policy: https://couplewidget.com/lovehome/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://couplewidget.com/lovehome/terms.html
Official Site: https://couplewidget.com/lovehome

bluejetty:00149955:ios.description:
Real actors book real work. WeAudition connects you with live, professional scene partners. Because only human actors understand the craft, the nuances, and the connection you need to perform at your best.
Join the world’s leading international community of on-demand self-tape readers.
No waiting for someone to come online — WeAudition provides INSTANT scene partners 24/7. It’s like Uber for self-tape readers.
You don’t have to read for others unless you want to. Readers set their own fee, or volunteer to read with you for free.
Why actors use WeAudition:
 - Book more acting work
 - Create stronger self-tapes
 - Rehearse & run lines with real actors
 - Get advice and coaching instantly
 - Earn income helping others
 - Grow your network & accelerate your success
_______________________________________________________
Self-tape coming up?
 - Connect instantly to a coach or reader via secure video chat
 - Share script sides safely (without them being shared with an AI model) 
 - Rehearse the scene and get valuable feedback
 - Record your self-tape with a real scene partner
No auditions today?
 - Earn money as a reader, helping actors around the world
 - Rehearse, run lines, and keep your skills sharp
 - Share your expertise while building connections
 _______________________________________________________
Features
 - Instantly available, professional Readers — reviewed & ready 24/7
 - Some Readers are free, others set their own fee
 - Be a Reader yourself and make money doing what you love
 - Video chat directly in the app with your scene partner
 - Securely share your script sides
 - Record self-tapes with your video and your reader’s voice
 - Use ScriptScroll to automatically keep track of your place in the script
Actors book work with WeAudition.
Members tell us again and again that they’ve landed massive life changing roles using this service.
“WeAudition has been an amazing platform for me to prepare for auditions, rehearsals, and performances. I’ve met incredible actors, coaches, and casting directors who’ve given me feedback, advice, and opportunities that pushed my career forward.”
— Carrie Bernans, Actor (Black Panther, Luke Cage, Avengers)
“I used a WeAudition Reader for my auditions that landed me a roles in a massive Sony Pictures blockbuster feature film and a huge TV series for Disney+”
— Richard Cambridge, Actor (Gran Turismo, Suspect: The Shooting of Jean Charles de Menezes)
Rate & Review: Share feedback on your readers.
Fees & Tips: Pay or tip your reader securely, like you would a coach or studio.
Safe & Secure: Script sides are protected and removed after your session.
WeAudition is a revolutionary app used by over 60,000 professional actors worldwide.
Improve your craft. Save time. Book the role. Anywhere, anytime.
WeAudition requires a monthly subscription service under the standard Apple Terms of Use (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00200040:ios.description:
Parchment is a private daily journal that brings your writing, plans, calendar, and reminders together in one quiet place. It uses Apple's Reminders and the system calendar to bring your task and events together.
Open today and start writing immediately. Your calendar events and due or overdue reminders can appear above your journal entry, giving you the context of the day without switching apps. Capture notes, reflect on what happened, plan what comes next, or use Parchment as a simple daybook for work and life.
On iPad, Parchment also supports handwriting and drawing with Apple Pencil, so typed notes and handwritten thoughts can live together on the same day.
Parchment is built for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, with iCloud sync available through your private iCloud account. There is no Parchment account to create, no advertising, and no third-party analytics SDKs.
Features include:
- Daily journal entries organized by date
- Calendar events shown alongside your writing
- Due and overdue reminders in your daily view
- Reminder completion from inside the app
- Apple Pencil handwriting and drawing on iPad
- iCloud sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac
- Widgets for a quick look at your agenda
- Shortcuts, Siri, and App Intents support
- Spotlight indexing for finding past entries
- Export tools for keeping a copy of your writing
- Custom appearance, fonts, and themes
Parchment is for people who want a journal that understands the shape of their day. It gives you one place to write what happened, see what is coming up, and keep a private record over time.

bluejetty:00159694:ios.description:
FLATIFY – THE ULTIMATE HOUSEHOLD & CHORE APP TO KEEP YOUR SHARED HOME ORGANIZED. No sign-up required & set up in seconds. From chore schedules to shopping lists, expense tracking, and a shared calendar – Flatify has everything you need in one app.
Over 50,000 satisfied users. Whether you live in a student flat, with your partner, or as a family – Flatify makes household organization easy and stress-free. Try it now for free!
ALL FEATURES AT A GLANCE
• Chore schedule & tasks – Automatic reminders and points for completed chores
• Expense tracking – Keep track of shared costs and split them fairly
• Shopping lists – Add missing items and split costs automatically
• Shared calendar – Stay organized with visible events and birthdays
• Chat & polls – Quickly decide who cooks or does the shopping
• Admin function – Customize features, perfect for trips and vacations
Struggling to remember who’s taking out the trash? Wondering who last bought toilet paper? Tired of the same person always covering the bills? Say goodbye to shared living chaos – Flatify brings order to your home!
FAIR CHORE SCHEDULE & TASK MANAGEMENT
• Create custom chore schedules – daily, weekly, monthly, or as needed.
• Assign tasks to roommates.
• Earn points for completed tasks – see who’s really doing the most.
• Set checklists for tasks so everyone knows exactly what to do.
• Automatically remind roommates of unfinished tasks.
SPLIT EXPENSES & BILLS WITH EASE
• Track all household expenses and split them automatically.
• Always see who owes what to whom.
• Whether it’s groceries, rent, or streaming subscriptions – Flatify keeps it fair.
• Manage contracts within the app to keep track of recurring payments.
SHOPPING LISTS – NEVER FORGET ANYTHING AGAIN
• Everyone can add missing household items to a shared list.
• Check off purchased items and instantly split costs.
• Create multiple shopping lists with the Pro version – perfect for vacations or parties.
SHARED CALENDAR – STAY ORGANIZED
• Add birthdays, house meetings, and important events directly to Flatify.
• Automatic reminders ensure nothing is forgotten.
CHAT & POLLS – QUICKLY REACH A DECISION
• Use the shared chat to discuss household matters.
• Create polls to decide on meals, plans, or any other group decision.
ADMIN FUNCTION – CUSTOMIZE YOUR HOUSEHOLD APP
• Hide certain features – ideal for vacations or temporary stays.
• Control who can make changes.
Flatify makes shared living easier and keeps everything organized. Try it now!

www.instagram.com/flatifyapp
For questions or bug reports, contact us at support@flatify-app.com.

bluejetty:00017137:ios.summary:
Enjoy Your Photos and Videos Like Never Before!
With SlideFlow, turn your favorite moments into beautiful, animated slideshows — on your iPhone, iPad, Mac, or TV. Create and play slideshows in seconds, customize them if you wish, and share
bluejetty:00017137:ios.description:
Enjoy Your Photos and Videos Like Never Before!
With SlideFlow, turn your favorite moments into beautiful, animated slideshows — on your iPhone, iPad, Mac, or TV. Create and play slideshows in seconds, customize them if you wish, and share them as videos with family and friends.
Instant Slideshow Playback
No rendering, no waiting: SlideFlow generates slideshows on the fly, so playback starts almost immediately.
A Different Slideshow Every Time
Turn on shuffle to vary the order, transitions, filters, and music every time you press play — and again with every loop. Leave a slideshow running on your TV at a family gathering, and it keeps changing. SlideFlow can apply a different filter on every playback, so you enjoy your photos and videos in a new way every time — without creating multiple versions in different styles.
Customize Your Slideshow
• Add music from a wide selection of built-in tracks across various genres, or add your own. Your tracks join your personal music library, synced via iCloud and ready for any slideshow. Music fades smoothly and steps aside while videos play their own sound.
• Choose from 33 transitions — dissolves, wipes, slides, whip pans, glitches, and more — plus an ending transition for a graceful finish.
• Bring photos to life with smart animations: zoom in on faces or subjects, or start close and zoom out to reveal the full scene.
• Apply stylish filters such as Monochrome, Sepia, Chrome, and Noir.
• Add text or image overlays for titles, captions, logos, and more.
• Mix photos and videos freely in the same slideshow.
• Shuffle, loop, and fine-tune settings for the whole slideshow or individual photos and videos. Set your favorite defaults once, and every new slideshow uses them.
Watch on Your TV
Cast slideshows or individual photos and videos to your TV. Connect your iPhone, iPad, or Mac to the same Wi-Fi or Ethernet network — nothing to install on the TV. Works with many DLNA-compatible TVs.
Export and Share as Video
Export your slideshows in horizontal, vertical, or square format for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and more. Choose 720p, 1080p, or 4K resolution, with H.264 or HEVC encoding to balance quality and file size.
Create Slideshows Automatically
Pick a date range, and SlideFlow groups your photos and videos into Moments — temporary slideshows named after their dates and places, made for exploring your memories. Save the ones worth keeping with a single tap.
You can also create saved slideshows directly from a date range, a Photos album, or a smart album, with filters such as favorites only, photos only, and skip screenshots.
Photos, Files, and Folders
Build slideshows from your Photos library, individual image and video files, or whole folders. Drop in a folder containing photos, videos, and music, and get a finished slideshow.
Choose whether files are copied into SlideFlow or referenced in place to save space — ideal for large collections stored on external drives.
Sync Across Devices
With iCloud sync enabled, your slideshows are synced across your iPhones, iPads, and Macs. Photos and videos from your Photos library must be synced with iCloud Photos.
Free to Download
Try SlideFlow for as long as you like. In unlimited free trial mode, generated slideshows include app promotions. Full access is available through subscriptions or a one-time lifetime purchase. Your purchase unlocks all features on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, and can be shared with your family through Apple Family Sharing.
Terms of Use: https://veprit.com/eula.html
Privacy Policy: https://veprit.com/VeprIT-PrivacyPolicy.pdf

bluejetty:00178155:ios.name: Outdooractive. Hike and Ride
bluejetty:00178155:ios.summary:
Confidently explore the great outdoors with Outdooractive - Hike and Ride: The most reliable outdoor navigation app, as trusted by thousands of trail wardens, mountain guides and outdoor industry professionals worldwide.
The Outdooractive
bluejetty:00178155:ios.description:
Confidently explore the great outdoors with Outdooractive - Hike and Ride: The most reliable outdoor navigation app, as trusted by thousands of trail wardens, mountain guides and outdoor industry professionals worldwide.
The Outdooractive - Hike and Ride app helps you find officially approved routes near you and around the world, with suggestions for dozens of sports including: hiking paths, trekking trails, mountain biking routes, trail running paths, ski touring routes and more. 
Or plan your own routes using the deepest catalog of official maps to take adventures into your own hands with our map route planner. 
Find routes you can rely on: Browse thousands of officially-approved routes near you and across the world, including routes for hiking, road cycling, bike touring, ski touring, gravel riding, trail running, horseback riding, mountaineering and more. 
Plan your own routes with tools trusted by professionals: Easily plot your own outdoor routes in the route planner in just a few taps, and see all need to know distance, elevation and terrain info.
Save everything offline: Save individual plans or entire areas offline for reliable navigation when you don't have a phone signal. 
Browse the deepest collection of different map types to track or plan your adventures with confidence: Simply switch between different layers to get a clearer picture of the terrain you're planning to visit, and get the most reliable understanding of conditions on the ground. Outdooractive's map catalog currently includes:
Official topo maps in 25 countries, including:
Ordnance Survey (Landranger & Explorer) in the United Kingdom, New Zealand Land Information in NZ, USGS in the USA, BKG in Germany, BEV in Austria, Swisstopo in Switzerland, IGN in France, PDOK in the Netherlands, Kartverket in Norway, Lantmäteriet in Sweden, Finland National Land Survey in Finland, Harvey Maps in the UK, the official Alpine Club maps for climbing in the Alps
As well as the specially-designed Outdooractive map across France, Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
Share your live location with family and friends: Give yourself and your loved ones complete peace of mind when you're out in the great outdoors thanks to BuddyBeacon.
Join a global community of outdoor tourists and adventurers: Share your activities with the community, join challenges to stay motivated, and get inspired by officially-approved content from our thousands of industry partners.
Recorded tracks can be saved as workouts in Apple Health. Your heart rate and biometric data from Apple Health can be used to calculate calories spent during the track recording. No Health data is used for marketing or advertising purposes
FAQs:
Can Outdooractive find walking trails near me? 
Outdooractive helps you find walking, hiking, cycling and many more types of trails both in your area, and around the world. You're able to filter and view multiple types of activities in an area of your choosing, created and shared by outdoor experts. 
How can I find hiking trails near me?:
Using Outdooractive, you're able to find hiking trails in your local area by opening our app and browsing the map. You'll be able to see hiking trails with a range of distances, difficulties and distance from your location.

Verified by millions of users worldwide, Migii JLPT confidently helps you increase your JLPT test score by at least 30 points.
To attain your desired score on the JLPT N5-N1 test, it's essential to consistently challenge yourself with various practice exams to assess your skills and enhance your areas of weakness. And if you're searching for a valuable app to help you increase at least 30 points in your upcoming JLPT test, look no further than Migii JLPT - the ultimate choice you shouldn't miss.
Migii JLPT offers everything you need to get well-prepared for the real JLPT test:
1. Challenge yourself with JLPT mock tests and skill tests:
- Continuously updated tests for all levels, ranging from JLPT N5 to N1, simulate the time limit and format of the real JLPT.
- Sharpen your skills with JLPT mini-tests and skill tests.
- Easily download and print the tests to practice whenever and wherever you want.
- Access answer keys and detailed explanations to learn from your mistakes

- Compete with others and earn your place on the leaderboard.
- Win valuable prizes when reaching the top 20.
3. Concentrate on improving your weak areas in each section
- Experience each section following the format of the actual JLPT test.
- JLPT N5 to JLPT N1 reading with detailed explantations.
- Easily search for word meanings while practicing JLPT N5-N1 reading.
- Access audio with transcripts and translations for JLPT listening practice.
4. Strengthen your foundation with the theory section:
- Comprehensive lists of vocabulary, grammar, and kanji from N5 to N1
- Effective review tools like flashcards and practice exercises
5. Conquer your JLPT goals with Migii's personalized roadmap
- Customized roadmaps based on your unique strengths and weaknesses
- Daily lessons to keep you on track
6. Additional valuable features of Migii JLPT.
- Immediate JLPT certificate issuance
- Tailored language improvement suggestions
- Seamlessly integrated Mazii Japanese dictionary (voice, camera, handwriting)
- Daily learning reminders and progress tracking
Remember, investing in knowledge yields the best interest. Migii JLPT is honored to accompany you on your journey to conquer the JLPT exam.
Thank you very much for choosing Migii JLPT. If you have any questions or need support, please feel free to contact us via email at migii@eupgroup.net. We highly value all your comments and contributions.

bluejetty:00173603:ios.description:
Children's educational game for kids - Learn colors. Our educational kids game will help kids learn colors easily. Learning colors for kids. Let's play our educational kids game! Professionals from our educational game will teach kids all the colors.
An educational fable game City of Masters is a colorful world of lovely gnomes and their magical crafts.
The City of Masters is a home to fabulous gnome artisans whose crafts are tightly connected with colors and paints. Choose any Workshop-House for your child's education along a beautiful alley and start this development game!
Come in, get acquainted with the gnome-masters. Learn how to professionally mix paints, identify the colors of objects and animals, solve cool color riddles and ride the dwarf-bike up to the rainbow!
The game fosters kids imagination, fine motor skills and attentiveness. The Flower Fairy will always come to help if any difficulties arise, so kids will easily cope with the tasks. 
Choose any of 8 characters to play with and enjoy learning colors!
Gnomes-professors and their crafts:
Professor Beamble will show you different colors and objects. Choose objects of the color indicated by the Professor. Be alert - defining an object with its contour only is very interesting!
Twin brothers Tilly and Willy make color riddles. Determine objects and their color. You can choose which of the brothers to play with but it's better to play with both :)
Colored chemistry experiments with lovely Dory! Add a complement paint to the paint in a test tube to mix the colors and get a new one.
Charismatic and cheerful fisherman Finn is waiting for players by the river. We catch fish of a certain color which is indicated on the bucket. Cast your bait at the right moment! Patience and a keen eye are your friends now!
Meet Arti, the artist who painted a great bunch of paintings. To be honest, he only drew the outline. And children will color the pictures! Let your creativity out and choose any colors!
A zookeeper fun gnome Bob will show children an unusual trick with colors and zoo inhabitants. Paint animals and birds with the appropriate color and turn them to life!
Neat Betty is loading her washing machine. Choose clothes of the right color and put them inside the machine — Betty will be very pleased!
Little Chad rides a bike to add some color to the rainbow! Press the colored button to light the same flashlight on Chad's bike and collect phials with paint. At the end of the path you’ll fill the rainbow with them. Also do flips and bounce on the trampoline!
We are happy to hear from you! Feel free to drop us a line with your feedback and suggestions.
Send us an email: support@gokidsmobile.com 
We are on Fb: https://www.facebook.com/GoKidsMobile/ 
We are on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gokidsapps/ 
The game supports 20 languages with professional voice acting.

Advanced camera system from the first person perspective, allowing you to move around freely and look without any delay!

Your goal is the basement of the neighbor’s house. The key to unraveling all the terrible secrets is somewhere there!
A stunning soundtrack, the sinister melodies - all of it perfectly convey the atmosphere of a mystical thriller!
Will you be able to get to the bottom of the truth, or will you become another victim of an ominous neighbor?

bluejetty:00016056:ios.summary:
Bingo Machine replaces the traditional bingo number caller with a simple, all-in-one, iPhone and iPad application. Call American 75-ball and English 90-ball bingo games. 
With a bingo card in hand, Bingo Machine handles everything else — n
bluejetty:00016056:ios.description:
Bingo Machine replaces the traditional bingo number caller with a simple, all-in-one, iPhone and iPad application. Call American 75-ball and English 90-ball bingo games. 
With a bingo card in hand, Bingo Machine handles everything else — no need for a traditional bingo caller tumbler or expensive electronic equipment.
As each ball is selected, Bingo Machine keeps a running history of balls so you can see all the called numbers as the game progresses.
The app includes human and synthesized speech voices. Bingo Machine can read out each ball with recorded human male and female voices, or a high-quality synthetic voice for your language. Even if Bingo Machine is muted, it shows you bingo catchphrases on the screen so you know what to say as the announcer for each bingo number.
Use the Timer feature to call balls automatically, on a repeating interval. Set a time interval and Bingo Machine calls balls until the game is over.
Bingo Machine adapts to the game type. For English-style games, call up to 90 balls. For American games, call up to 75 balls with each ball accompanied by its corresponding B-I-N-G-O symbol.
For group settings, connect Bingo Machine to an external display or projector to show the game on the big screen. This is perfect for charity events, schools and other large room events. You can connect using a compatible TV-Out cable for your iPhone or iPad, or connect wirelessly to an Apple TV using AirPlay Screen Mirroring.
Bingo Machine can also be used as a teaching tool for learning numbers in foreign languages. Switch between English, Chinese, French, German and Spanish language options. The synthesized voice can even speak each language so you can hear how the number is meant to be pronounced.
Bingo Machine features rich design and finesse. The app is optimized for both the iPhone in your hand, and the larger canvas of the iPad display. It includes a beautiful theme for the new iOS 13 Dark Mode appearance, and is proud to support vision-impaired accessibility needs with comprehensive VoiceOver support.
Bingo caller software is typically clunky and complex. Bingo Machine is the opposite. Feature packed and simple to use.

bluejetty:00021333:ios.description:
This is the app you are looking for if you are a dieter or who want to control your diabetes or weight! 
You can set your carb budget and track your daily nutrition intake of the food, carbs, fiber, fat etc, and also track quantity of water intake, readings of your glucose, HbA1c, blood pressure, heart rate, weight, exercise, medications and insulin, you can share the readings with your doctors in form of CSV, HTML or PDF by email. 
Key Features: 
Food: 
⁃ Create your carb budget and track it. 
⁃ Track your food logs includes daily nutrition intake, such as carbs, fiber, calories etc. 
⁃ Huge default food database from restaurant, common foods and supermarket. 
⁃ Add your custom food or your recipes. 
⁃ Add food to Favorites. 
⁃ Search food database. 
⁃ Report your carbs intake. 
Weight: 
⁃ Track your weight logs. 
⁃ Add note to each reading. 
⁃ Calculate BMI of each reading automatically. 
⁃ Show weight change compared with last weight. 
⁃ Report weight and BMI logs by chart. 
Water: 
⁃ Log your daily quantity of water intake. 
⁃ Show your target, actual and average glasses of water intake by chart. 
⁃ Show number of glasses of water intake in Water’s icon. 
⁃ Report your water intake. 
Others: 
⁃ Calendar overview of your data. 
⁃ Password protection.
⁃ Supports Touch ID passcode. 
⁃ Supports WiFi Backup & Restore.
⁃ Supports Dropbox backup & restore. 
⁃ Manage your personal info and set color ranges for your glucose and blood pressure. 
⁃ Email your readings to your doctors in form of CSV, HTML or PDF. 
⁃ Badges to show your consumed/remaining net carbs and water intake. 
⁃ Supports AirPrint.
⁃ Supports transferring data to Health app.
⁃ Supports universal version.
In App Purchase:
Exercises: 
⁃ Log the date, duration, exercise name, intensity of exercises and add note to it. 
⁃ Hundreds of default common exercises for you to chose. 
⁃ Customize and save your own exercises. 
⁃ Save your favorites exercise. 
⁃ Search exercise by name. 
⁃ Show your actual exercise time and average exercise duration by chart. 
Glucose: 
⁃ Log your glucose and HbA1c logs. 
⁃ Add note to each reading. 
⁃ Analyze glucose level by chart. 
⁃ Show the statistics info of four glucose segments. 
⁃ Calculate average glucose level of different periods. 
Blood Pressure: 
⁃ Log your blood Pressure and heart rate. 
⁃ Add note to each reading. 
⁃ Calculate your MAP of each reading. 
⁃ Analyze BP and heart rate level by chart. 
⁃ Show Max, Min and Avg number of BP, Heart rate and MAP. 
⁃ Show percentage and number of BP in different levels. 
Lipid Panel: 
⁃ Log your Cholesterol, Triglycerides, HDL and LDL. 
⁃ Add note to reading. 
Medications: 
⁃ Log your medication intake. 
⁃ Log medication intake time, dosage, and add note to it. 
⁃ Manage your medications’ route, unit, side effects, icon and other info. 
Reminders: 
⁃ Create unlimited reminders to alert you measure your blood pressure or glucose, drinking water, visiting doctor, doing exercise or anything else you would like. 
⁃ Create reminder text of each reminder. 
⁃ Set time, repeat frequency, and icon for the reminders. 
⁃ Ten default reminder sounds and you can set your own. 
⁃ Set if reminder is ON or OFF. 
Apple Health：
Daily Carb is able to write nutrition/weight/glucose/blood pressure data only according to your permissions and preferences.
If allowing Daily Carb to write data, you could transfer these data to Health App easily. 
If you have any questions or suggestion, please mail to maxwellsoftware@gmail.com.

- Creating personal collections

- Saves photos in high resolution to keep your memories sharp.
- Add notes and comments to your important moments with the memo feature.
- Enjoy looking back on your memories with the built-in slideshow.
- Share photos and videos through AirDrop, social media, email, messages, and other supported apps.
- With Dropbox support, you can transfer your data wirelessly.

bluejetty:00045096:ios.summary:

The KUNC Public Radio App allows you to listen to KUNC live, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule all at once! You can explore On Demand content, search for stories, bookmark a story for l
bluejetty:00045096:ios.description:
KUNC Public Radio App: 
The KUNC Public Radio App allows you to listen to KUNC live, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule all at once! You can explore On Demand content, search for stories, bookmark a story for later, and wake up to KUNC with the alarm clock!
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from KUNC even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite station starts playing – no clicks to start listening.
• Integrated program schedules for every station. You can display up to three of your favorites at a time or flick once to see the schedules for all of your favorite stations.
• One click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another stream with a single click.
• Listen to KUNC in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
On Demand
• Access public radio programs from multiple content providers (NPR, PRI, APM and KUNC) easily and quickly.
• DVR-like controls. Pause, rewind and fast forward your program with ease. 
• When listening to national programs, individual story segments (when available) are listed so you can review and choose one or listen to the entire program.
• Easy to access past programs.
• The KUNC Public Radio App displays the web page associated with the program or story segment you are listening to On Demand so you can explore for more information.
Radio Bookmarks
• Save what you were listening to (Live or On Demand) so you can replay, follow-up, or share it later by simply clicking “Bookmark”.
• Compatible with the popular Radio Bookmark device (www.radiobookmark.com).
Search
• The unique “Search Public Radio” feature finds stories or programs across hundreds of stations and web pages and makes it easy to play instantly.
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The KUNC Public Radio App is brought to you by the people at KUNC and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, and where you want it.
Please support KUNC Public Radio by becoming a member today!
http://www.kunc.org
http://www.publicmediaapps.com

bluejetty:00118796:ios.description:
Con nuestra App BBVA puedes realizar todas tus operaciones bancarias mucho más fácil, con total comodidad, seguridad y sin necesidad de ir a la oficina.
Recuerda que puedes:
- Ingresar con una contraseña única y maximizar la seguridad gracias a la identificación biométrica que te permite acceder con tu huella o face ID.
- Ver el detalle, los movimientos y realizar transacciones desde tus productos, con tan solo presionar sobre ellos.
- Ver los extractos de todos tus productos y generar certificados para tus cuentas de ahorro y corriente.
- Prender y apagar tus tarjetas débito y crédito desde el detalle del producto.
- Pagar servicios públicos escaneando con la cámara de tu celular el código de barras de tu factura o ingresando el número de referencia de pago. Recuerda que también aceptamos pagos de facturas que tengan doble referencia de pago.
- Pagar tus impuestos y recargar tu celular.
- Marcar como favorito los pagos de servicios públicos, recargas y transferencias a otros bancos para que la próxima vez que vayas a realizarlo, no tengas que tener la factura o los datos a la mano.
- Pagar las tarjetas de crédito BBVA de tus familiares o amigos, las tuyas y hasta tarjetas de otros bancos
- Pagar tus préstamos BBVA .
- Realizar transferencias a cuentas BBVA, y de otros bancos. También puedes guardar la información de la cuenta y hacer ahí mismo la transferencia. 
- Realizar avances desde tarjeta de crédito con abono inmediato a tu cuenta de ahorros o cuenta corriente.
- Retirar dinero en cajeros automáticos sin la tarjeta generando el token desde el detalle de la cuenta de la cual desees retirar los fondos. Este token tiene una duración de 3 horas.
- Visualizar el CVV de tus tarjetas débito y crédito para que realices compras online.
- Validar si tienes un crédito preaprobado de tarjeta de crédito, cupo rotativo y/o préstamo.
- Recibir y enviar dinero al exterior.
- Puedes solicitar recursos adicionales sobre tu crédito de consumo actual a través de un retanqueo de crédito, contratar un CDT, un adelanto de nómina y fondos de inversión de manera digital sin necesidad de ir a la oficina.
- Crear o cancelar tu fondo de inversión en cualquier momento.
- Conocer las promociones que tenemos para ti y usar tus puntos BBVA.
- Actualizar tu correo electrónico para que siempre estemos en contacto.
- Ahora el Perfil Transaccional es el Token Digital.
- No más ir a un Cajero Automático a activar el “Perfil Transaccional”, porque activar el Token Digital también se podrá hacer desde la App.
- Mayor seguridad a través del Token Digital y biometría para firmar operaciones.
- Información más detallada de los productos. En todos los flujos informamos sobre cobros, comisiones y tarifas.
- En toda la aplicación encontrarás mensajes de ayuda para entender más fácil aquellos conceptos que a veces resultan confusos.
- Además de informar el estado de los productos, indicamos cómo y dónde te pueden ayudar, si debes llamar al call center o ir a una oficina, si vas a una oficina te indicamos a cuál y cómo llegar.
- Si solicitas los extractos desde la App ya no necesitas contraseña para abrirlos.
- Sin hacer login en la App, podrás acceder a algunas opciones desde el Menú Lateral.
¡Recuerda!
Ante cualquier novedad podrán contactarnos a nuestras líneas telefónicas 4010000 en Bogotá, 4938300 Medellín, 3503500 Barranquilla, 8892020 Cali , 6304000 Bucaramanga y otras ciudades al 018000912227, donde estaremos a su disposición para dar soporte ante cualquier inquietud.

What Is WeGo?
Wego is a new model of demand response vanpool transport service that combines private sector technology with public sector vehicles and drivers. WeGo works by using smartphones and technology-enabled vehicles to quickly and easily connect passengers with drivers in just 15 minutes. 
How Does WeGo Work?
WeGo is an on-demand travel concept that takes multiple passengers heading in the same direction and books them into a shared vehicle. Just download the WeGo app today, book your seat and travel where you want, when you want. It’s as easy as click, pay, go!
When and Where Does WeGo operate?
For more information on service zones and hours, please visit www.wegogainesvillehall.com
How Do I Pay?
WeGo is free to download, and it doesn’t cost anything to sign up! Once you’ve created an account, you can pay for rides directly in the app using your credit card, debit card, or ride credit purchased with cash.
How Long Will I Wait?
It depends on the trip! You will always get the most accurate ETA when you book in the app.
Why Use WeGo?
WeGo takes you where you want to go, when you want to be there.
For More Information
Call 770-503-3330 or visit
www.wegogainesvillehall.com

bluejetty:00115826:ios.description:
Transform your body with home workouts that fit your life
Nordletics is an all-in-one home workout and weight loss app built to make getting in shape simple, realistic, and motivating. Get a personalized plan that blends light at-home exercise with balanced meal support – helping you burn fat, boost energy, and feel confident in your own skin.
1. PLAN TAILORED TO YOUR BODY AND GOALS
Whether you want to slim down, tone up, or simply feel fitter, Nordletics creates a plan that matches your fitness level, schedule, and preferences. 
Enjoy guided home workouts and simple nutrition guidance designed for steady, sustainable results – not crash routines or extreme diets. Nordletics helps you:
Target full-body fat loss with structured workout blocks
Build strength and mobility with progressive bodyweight moves
Support better sleep, mood, and overall well-being as you get fitter 
2. BUILD HABITS THAT LAST
Nordletics is built around small daily actions that are easy to repeat:
Consistent workout reminders to keep you accountable
Lifestyle and movement challenges to make staying active feel natural
Gentle guidance to help you overcome “all-or-nothing” thinking and stick with your plan.
You’re not chasing a quick fix – you’re building a routine you can actually live with.
3. HOME WORKOUTS YOU CAN ACTUALLY STICK TO
Reach your goals from home – no gym and no equipment required. 
Short workout sessions you can fit into any day
Beginner-friendly routines plus progressions as you get stronger
Focused workouts to sculpt your body and burn belly fat over time 
With 200+ home workouts and exercises, you always have something new to try while following a clear plan. 
4. SIMPLE NUTRITION SUPPORT
Alongside your workouts, Nordletics provides a straightforward meal approach to support your results:
Personalized meal ideas that match your goals and preferences 
Balanced recipes to keep energy stable throughout the day
Guidance to avoid strict dieting or starvation and still make progress
With over 2000 healthy recipes, you can eat in a way that supports your workouts without feeling deprived. 
5. SMART TRACKING FOR REAL PROGRESS
Watch your transformation unfold with built-in trackers:
Steps and activity
Water intake
Weight and body progress
Fasting (if it’s part of your routine) 
Nordletics helps you see trends over time so you stay motivated, adjust when needed, and celebrate every win – not just the number on the scale.
WHY PEOPLE LOVE NORDLETICS
Natural, home-based weight loss without the gym
Short, no-equipment workouts that fit busy schedules
Improved energy, confidence, and sleep quality 
Personalized workout and meal plans built around your life
Healthy challenges and streaks that keep you consistent
Coach guidance and consultations to help you stay on track and overcome dips in motivation
Your data, your control
Your personal data is encrypted and protected.
You can delete your account and all associated data at any time directly from within the app.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Nordletics offers flexible auto-renewing plans.
PAYMENT & RENEWAL
You can download and use the app for free. Continued access to all features requires a subscription. Payment is charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your account settings. Prices apply to U.S. customers; international pricing may vary by currency. For support or questions, contact us at hello@nordletics.com

bluejetty:00087247:ios.description:
Temp Number offers short-term usage virtual second phone numbers from different countries to receive SMS messages at fair and affordable prices. 
Get verification SMS messages for any online service without exposing your personal phone number and protect your privacy. 
What can I do?
- Get disposable 2nd virtual SMS number instantly 
- Receive SMS online 
- Easy accounts verification
- Protect your real number
- Fair and transparent pricing 
Is it free? 
No. The app is available to download for free, but you will have to add funds to your balance inside the app to order numbers. You will see easy and transparent pricing depending on countries and services before each order. 
How to use the app?
Step 1: Enter the country and name of the service you need. If there is no service in the list, choose the “other” option. 
Step 2: After selecting country and service, you will see the price per activation and can get the number ( in case you have no funds, you should add credits to your balance) 
Step 3: Copy the number and paste it on the service, website, or app you have selected. 
Step 4: As soon as the service sends you the SMS, it will be available inside the app. You will usually have up to 20 minutes to get the SMS. No message received until the number expires? - No payment will be made. 
Please note : 
- All numbers are temporary (disposable) numbers and are self-destructed, usually within 20 minutes. So please do not use it if you’ll need it for a long time.
- We primarily use trusty and reliable providers with real SIM cards and not virtual VoIP numbers with lower quality. 
- The price is per successful activation only and may vary depending on the service and country chosen.

bluejetty:00159143:ios.name: PI Banking
bluejetty:00159143:ios.summary: Software Development Division of Pubali Bank has developed a Mobile Application named PI (π) for banking services for our customers. PI Banking refers to Mobile Financial Service of Pubali Bank Limited that enables bank customers to access
bluejetty:00159143:ios.description:
Software Development Division of Pubali Bank has developed a Mobile Application named PI (π) for banking services for our customers. PI Banking refers to Mobile Financial Service of Pubali Bank Limited that enables bank customers to access accounts and general Information on bank products and services through Mobile devices. The main intention behind the commencement of electronic banking services is to provide the customers with an alternative that is more responsive and with less expensive options.
The reasons for selecting the name of Mobile Apps as PI (π) are as follows:
a) It is short and can be remembered easily.
b) Earlier smallest unit of currency was PI (BD)
c) PI also implies money receivables.
d) PI in mathematics is 22/7 = 3.1428571429… implies Possibility Infinite.
e) PI Banking also stands for Pubali Internet Banking.
In order to get the said services, customers will activate PI App by following steps:
a) The interested customer will download and install the PI (π) Apps from App Store (iOS).
b) The customers will submit information of Account Number, Name, Date of Birth, e-Mail, Mobile Number, Father’s Name and Mother’s Name through Apps.
c) Concerned branch will verify the said information received through Pubali Integrated Baning System with the Physical Account Opening Form and approve when found matched. Branch will communicate with the customer and ensure genuineness. 
d) After verification from the branch end, ICT Operation Division will verify the information by communicating with customer for PI Banking user activation and activate accordingly.
e) Upon activation, the customer will login at the first instance using his/her User ID and Password and giving some secret information provided by her/him earlier at the time of submission to ascertain the genuineness.
f) The customer will change her/his Password after the first login and thereafter may change the password frequently at her/his discretion.
The services provided to our customers through Mobile App are furnished below:
A) Non-transactional features:
- My account (Balance of the Accounts)
- Last 5 (five) transactions (this is configurable i.e. customers may increase the number of transactions)
- Viewing account statements.
- Payment status of issued cheques
- Cheque book requisition
- Stop payment of cheque
- Submitting Positive Pay Instruction
B) Transactional features:
- Fund Transfer
- Between the Pubali Bank’s accounts
- Between the Pubali Bank and other Bank’s through NPSB, BEFTN and RTGS
- Mobile recharge (Postpaid or Prepaid)
- Bills Payment
- Card Management as Card Bill Payment, Card Statement
- Fund Transfer (Any Bank)
- Card to Card
- Card to Account
- Card to MFS
- Credit Card Bill Payment
- E-Commerce Enable or Disable (On Process)
- Fund Management (On Process)
- Creating FDR/ any deposit account 
- Encashment
- FDR or Recurring Deposit A/C fund transfer to source A/C (SB, CC, CD,SND)
Security of the transmitted data through Internet:
To establish security of transmitted data by the customers in our system through internet and to ensure protection against unauthorized disclosure, alteration and fraudulent activities, we are receiving the service of “Sectigo” under license agreement. Thus the transmitted data is being protected through encryption enabled by a Server's Digital Certificate using the software “Sectigo”. This is widely used for security solution of web-server. It incorporates both authentication and encryption. Moreover, the server for the aforesaid banking system has been protected by the well reputed CISCO Firewall, Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) and Intrusion Detection System (IDS) to guard against intruders in the system.

bluejetty:00052885:android.name: Find job offers - Trovit Jobs
bluejetty:00052885:android.summary: Trovit Jobs finds job vacancies in thousands of different websites and shows them to you in one place. That way, you can be sure that you will find your dream job, no matter how hidden it is. Easy, convenient and fast. That’s our promise.
bluejetty:00052885:android.description:
Trovit Jobs finds job vacancies in thousands of different websites and shows them to you in one place. That way, you can be sure that you will find your dream job, no matter how hidden it is. Easy, convenient and fast. That’s our promise. 
♣FILTERS TO FIND THE PERFECT JOB
Trovit allows you to filter your search results to find the jobs that interest you. You can select your sector, city, publication date, type of contract, working hours, necessary experience, salary and a long list of other criteria.
♥SAVE THE BEST JOB OFFERS IN YOUR BOOKMARKS
Don’t you hate it when you find a vacancy, but somehow you don’t remember where or when was posted? Bookmark any listings you like in the Favourites section. Even if you accidentally delete the app, you will be able to recover your favourite jobs. 
♦PERSONALIZED ALERTS, TAILORED SPECIFICALLY FOR YOU
When you close the app, Trovit Jobs keeps working for you. Just create an alert (or several) and we will send you a notification when there’s a new ad that matches your search criteria. We follow thousands of job board websites minute by minute so you don’t have to. You can create as many alerts as you want to, with your ideal position, your favourite companies or the perfect combination of lots of factors. 
♠HOW TO FIND YOUR DREAM JOB IN TROVIT JOBS
If you are looking to find a new job, searching on Trovit couldn’t be easier. 
1. Type your search criteria and select which kind of vacancy are you looking for.
2. If you want, you can apply filters to that search. You will find the filters in the upper right hand-corner of the screen.
3. Take a good look at all the selected jobs. Don’t forget to save the ones you like the most in Favourites!
4. Create personalized alerts for every search you’re interested in. You’ll be able to activate or deactivate the notifications for each search, at the bottom of each search results page or in the settings section. 
5. We will send you alerts when there’s a new ad that matches all the conditions that you selected. 
You can check as many listings as you want, absolutely free. It doesn’t matter if you are looking to work from home, online jobs, security jobs... you will find it at Trovit. 
►WHY TROVIT?
You have two options when looking for job offers: you can either try visiting all the websites and services on a daily basis, typing the same search queries over and over, hoping to find the perfect job before anyone else. Or, you can set up search filters in Trovit Jobs, create an alert, and sit back to watch the magic happen. Trovit Jobs is your starting point for an intelligent and extensive search. 
Look for job offers listed in 19 different languages and in 46 different countries. Trovit Jobs includes among its sources hundreds of United States based companies and headhunters. Find your dream job in New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Houston, Philadelphia, Phoenix, San Antonio, San Diego, Dallas, San Jose, Austin, Jacksonville, San Francisco, Indianapolis, Columbus, Detroit, Washington DC, Seattle, Denver, Memphis, Boston, Nashville, El Paso, Milwaukee, Albuquerque, Tucson, Fresno, Louisville, Sacramento, Long Beach, Kansas City, Mesa, Atlanta, Virgina Beach, Portland, Omaha, Colorado Springs, Miami, Oakland, Minneapolis, tulsa, Cleveland or a long list of other towns and cities. 
OTHER TROVIT SERVICES
Remember that, besides Trovit Jobs, you can also use Trovit Homes and Trovit Cars. In Trovit Homes you will find all the listings of homes for sale and to rent in one single search engine. Trovit Cars will help you find your perfect car, searching through several car listing websites and services with one single search. 
If you have any doubts, problems or suggestions, please do write us an email at android@trovit.com and we will do our best to fix whatever’s bothering you. If you enjoy Trovit Jobs, please leave us a review on Google Play: it helps us grow and maintain a quality free service!

bluejetty:00030687:ios.name: FIH Hockey Manager
bluejetty:00030687:ios.summary:
BECOME THE WORLD'S TOP HOCKEY MANAGER!
The official FIH™ Hockey Manager game is here! In FIH Hockey Manager you take the role of a hockey team manager & owner, working to take your field hockey team to the top flight in the global league.
bluejetty:00030687:ios.description:
BECOME THE WORLD'S TOP HOCKEY MANAGER!
The official FIH™ Hockey Manager game is here! In FIH Hockey Manager you take the role of a hockey team manager & owner, working to take your field hockey team to the top flight in the global league.
FIH™ Hockey Manager is the result of a collaboration between the International Hockey Federation (FIH) and Gold Town Games. A first of its kind - the game is the world's first full feature Field Hockey Mobile Game!
BUILD AND TRAIN YOUR TEAM
Put together your dream team by adjusting your lineup, scout for new top talent and train your team daily to keep up performance and fitness. Buy and trade players on allowance with your club economy.
FACE YOUR FRIENDS ONLINE!
In FIH Hockey Manager, you play online; either together with your friends, or against them! Take them to town in the weekend league, or team up and beat the world's top field hockey manager groups and watch your opponents lose!
REACH THE DREAM LEAGUE OF HOCKEY
Prove that you can make it! The FIH top league is called the Allstar Division. A true dream league consisting of star hockey managers and champions, where only a handful of the best coaches will ever set their foot.
UNIQUE INTERACTIVE GAMES SIMULATOR
In FIH Hockey Manager, you can view and impact live games as they play out in real time. Watch how your players improve and perform on the field; or change tactics, team formations, and play special match cards to counter your opponents on the fly!
FEATURES
BUILD YOUR DREAM HOCKEY SQUAD
Build your team by scouting and developing youth hockey players as well as trading for seasoned stars! If they don't give you top performances, send them to the transfer list!
DAILY LIVE GAMES
Manage all aspects of the game! In FIH, you are in control of the live tactics of your team in real time PvP mode!
COMPETITIVE SOCIAL LEAGUE
The hardest battles are fought during social weekends! Choose to either join an existing Group or create your own hockey powerhouse with your friends!
IN-GAME CHAT
Psyche your opponents in-game, with taunting messages!
MANAGE THE TALENT
Train and analyze your players! You never know who might be a late bloomer...
BUILD YOUR HOCKEY FRANCHISE
Expand your stadium's facilities to ensure a steady stream of income for your hockey management empire.
GET REWARDED
The Season Pass gives you increasingly good rewards throughout the season! The larger the wins on the hockey field, the mightier the rewards! All managers also receive daily sponsorship packs, as well as many more types of rewards.
OUR COMMUNITY SUPPORT
We are always ready to listen to your input, and we want to include you as much as possible. No matter what your feedback is, you never know, your idea might make it into the game! 
For more information, please visit:
http://www.goldtowngames.com/en/FIH/
FOLLOW US ON SOCIAL MEDIA:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/FIH-Hockey-Manager-107464828618928
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fihhockeymanager/
We love feedback so please feel free to write to us at support[at]goldtowngames.com
_______
One last thing!
Here are links to our End User License Agreement and Privacy Policy:
https://www.goldtowngames.com/en/gold-town-games-end-user-licence-agreement/
https://www.goldtowngames.com/en/gold-town-games-privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00079971:ios.description:

 • Extensive currency database: Access a wide range of currencies from around the world.

 • Widget
 • Change App Icon
 • Search currencies by country name, currency name or ISO code.
 • Automatic currency ranking based on usage.

bluejetty:00084942:ios.description:
LoFi Cam: A Retro Camera App that recreates the distinctive feel of CCD digital cameras.
⊙ Explore Retro Digital Cameras
Inspired by CCD digital cameras and classic film aesthetics, LoFi Cam presents a distinctive color style. Our unique effects and interfaces are crafted to enhance your photo and video experiences.
- T10: With its high contrast color tuning and retro operating system, the T10 brings the essence of classic CCD cameras to your daily photography and landscape shots.
- FUJI: Capturing the essence of Fujifilm's Classic Chrome, this setting offers rich colors and strong contrasts, perfect for a variety of scenes.
- L80: A nod to the Y2K smartphone era, the L80 stands out for portrait and street photography with its characteristic high noise and exposure.
- F700: Drawing inspiration from Fuji NC filters, it simulates the nostalgic film style, ideal for portraits and outdoor scenes.
- SS22: A fresh and natural look with low contrast, ideal for both portraits and landscapes, embracing the essence of spring and summer.
- GR D: Inspired by the Ricoh GR DIGITAL series, this B&W camera features high contrast and noise, adjustable for everyday street photography.
Moreover, numerous cameras await discovery, offering unique captures with every shutter click.
⊙ Creative Collage Templates
Unleash your creativity with our ever-expanding selection of easy-to-use templates.
⊙ Just the right amount of special features for unlimited creativity
Harness the full potential of your creativity with our suite of special features, including exposure adjustments, vignette effects, temperature control, noise, and blur, complemented by flash options, a countdown timer, and smooth zoom capabilities.
⊙ Easy-to-use importing and editing
Beyond capturing new moments, LoFi Cam allows you to import and refine past photos, videos, and Live Photos, enhancing your memories.
⊙ Customizable save effects
Personalize your memories with a variety of save styles for photos, videos, and Live Photos, complete with customizable date and time stamps.
⊙ Occasional new camera updates
Anticipate the unveiling of new cameras and features, as we're continuously expanding our collection.
Enjoy the fun of LoFi Cam.
---
Unlimited Access Subscription
- You can subscribe for unlimited access to all features and content offered for purchase within LoFi Cam.
- Subscriptions are billed annually on the subscription plan.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription will automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. You can managed or turn off auto-renewal in your Apple ID Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of the free trial period will be forfeited after purchases a subscription.Free trial opportunities are available only once per user for the first subscription.
- Terms of use: www.pixelpunk.cn/terms-of-use-lofi-cam-en
- Privacy policy: www.pixelpunk.cn/privacy-policy-lofi-cam-en
