bluejetty:00089416:ios.description:
Baby Notebook—the modern baby book every parent needs—reminders for milestones, upload photos in the moment, and order a beautiful hardbound baby book at the end of baby's first year.
We‘re here to help you *actually* complete a memory book for baby’s first year and beyond. 
CONVENIENT
No more sifting through photos, printing, cutting, and pasting, it's all done right on your phone.
REMINDERS
Never miss a beat with Baby Notebook’s weekly notifications reminding you to upload a photo or answer a writing prompt. Schedule your notifications in the app to receive your prompts on a day and time that works best for you.
CUSTOMIZABLE
Edit titles in your book to tell your baby’s unique story. Designed with inclusivity in mind, the Baby Notebook app empowers all parents—single parents, LGBTQIA parents, and parents of multiples—to complete a meaningful baby book for their little one.
FLEXIBLE
Hide pages, replace page layouts, and rearrange pages in your book to ensure you can actually complete your baby book (no pages left blank).
MODERN BABY BOOK
All the design work is done for you—no formatting required. It is modern, clean, and timeless. 
ADDITIONAL PAGES
You can add more pages to your book (at an additional cost). This feature allows you to add more photo pages, special occasions, quote pages, and a second baby to your book (for twin Mamas)!
YOUR BABY’S FIRST YEAR ONLY HAPPENS ONCE
You'll find our prices comparable to any quality photo book, but you won't have to do the formatting, prompt writing, and remembering — we've got you, mama. Just think, you'll have this gorgeous book at the end of your baby's first year with all these beautiful photos, and you didn't have to do much to get it done. THAT'S PRICELESS! Make your baby's first year last a lifetime—your future self will thank you.
Hear it from a mom who has received her baby book—“This book is beautiful. I am blown away by the quality of this book! It was so easy to add pictures and write notes. I’m so grateful for this baby book, and have already started the toddler book! This is priceless!”
Continue documenting baby’s life with our yearly books:
TODDLER BOOK
As your baby turns one, continue documenting their journey with Baby Notebook’s Toddler Book. Capture every milestone and precious moment from 12-24 months.
THE MAGIC YEARS BOOK
Watch your baby grow into a little person with our Magic Years Book. Document quotes, conversations, photos, and artwork created by your child from 24-36 months.
THE FAMILY YEARBOOK
As your family grows, so do your memories. With Baby Notebook's Family Yearbook, capture every special (or ordinary) moment throughout the year. Build your book in real-time, ensuring you never miss a beat.
DOWNLOAD FOR FREE
Get started today with Baby Notebook for FREE and access the first 3 chapters of your book.
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
Upgrade to our Premium subscription, which includes a 7-day FREE trial for first-time subscribers, then $49.99 per year (paid annually). Enjoy the BEST VALUE with our Premium plan, and receive 40% off your book(s), that’s $99 + shipping. 
PLUS SUBSCRIPTION
Opt for our monthly Plus subscription plan for $6.99 per month and pay the full price of $165 for the book.
PAID SUBSCRIBER BENEFITS
- Full access to books: Baby, Toddler, Magic Years & Family Yearbook
- Weekly prompts & reminders
- Create books for multiple children
- Personalized notification settings
- Hide pages, edit titles & choose prompts
- Replace page layouts & rearrange pages
- Advanced photo editor & filters
- Shuffle photos 
- Add pages (at an additional cost)
- 12” x 12” books available for purchase, 100+ pages per book
Download the Baby Notebook app now and start preserving your baby’s memories today!
For support inquiries, email us at hello@babynotebook.app.
You can find our privacy policy and terms of service, here https://babynotebookapp.com/privacy and https://babynotebookapp.com/terms
Learn more about Baby Notebook at www.babynotebookapp.com

Let's go underwater and discover the Aqua Chaos: King Fish Aquarium Land game.
HOW TO PLAY:
==================
Feed fish. Collect coins. Discover skillful pets. Fight deadly monsters.
GAME MODES:
==================
- Adventure: introducing a food chain with 10 fish types. You will unlock cool pets through out this mode. A force of monsters will also try to stop you.
- Rush: make money as much as you can within a limited time.
- Match 3: more fun with 200 levels of the classic Match 3 game, with beautifully cute ocean tiles.
- Rush Match 3: like its name, you rush while matching these cute ocean tiles in a limited time.
- Onet: also called One Connect, where you will connect 2 same tiles with no more than 3 lines.
- Zen: raise Goldie fish types, and decorate your dreamed underwater world with the rarest fish not found anywhere else (Sunflower Goldie, Spider Goldie, Rainbow Piranha, Venom Terrijaw...).
FEATURES:
==================
- There are more than 20 upgradable pets with different skills.
- There are more than 50 rare fish to decorate Zen scenes.
- There are 7 types of gun, the 7th gun's bullet can chase a monster.
- There are many game modes and mini games (Adventure, Rush, Match 3, Onet or One Connect, Zen...).
- Vivid graphics and beautiful effects.
TIPS:
==================
- Minigame like Match 3, Onet... can help you earn a lot of diamonds. Diamonds are used for buying cool stuff in Zen shop.
- Only drop food when a fish is really hungry, so you can save some money.
- Tap on the monster will redirect its direction.

bluejetty:00120703:ios.name: Urna Eletrônica Simulador 2026
bluejetty:00120703:ios.summary:
Simule seu voto na urna eletrônica e conheça os candidatos das Eleições 2026 antes de votar de verdade.
O app da Urna reproduz a urna eletrônica oficial: o mesmo teclado, o mesmo som, a mesma sequência de cargos. Digite o número, confira a
bluejetty:00120703:ios.description:
Simule seu voto na urna eletrônica e conheça os candidatos das Eleições 2026 antes de votar de verdade.
O app da Urna reproduz a urna eletrônica oficial: o mesmo teclado, o mesmo som, a mesma sequência de cargos. Digite o número, confira a foto do candidato e aperte CONFIRMA. É a forma mais simples de treinar o voto e chegar seguro no dia da eleição.
CANDIDATOS DE 2026, COM DADOS REAIS
Consulte quem está concorrendo no seu estado a Presidente, Governador, Senador, Deputado Federal, Deputado Estadual e Distrital. Cada candidato tem:
• número, partido, coligação e foto
• patrimônio declarado
• quem financia a campanha
• plano de governo completo, com um resumo curto feito por inteligência artificial para você entender as propostas sem ler o PDF inteiro
• redes sociais oficiais
Os dados vêm de fontes públicas do TSE, da Câmara e do Senado.
A COLINHA PARA NÃO ERRAR O VOTO
Monte a sua lista de voto com cargo, número e foto de cada candidato escolhido. A colinha fica salva no aparelho e funciona sem internet no dia da votação. Dá para compartilhar como imagem com a família e os amigos.
SIMULAÇÃO DA ELEIÇÃO REAL
Escolha seu estado e vote em todos os cargos da eleição de verdade, com os candidatos que estarão na urna. Ao final você vê o seu voto completo, cargo por cargo.
RESULTADOS DAS ELEIÇÕES
Acompanhe a apuração e consulte os resultados oficiais das eleições brasileiras de 2004 a 2024, por cargo, estado e cidade.
CRIE SUA PRÓPRIA ELEIÇÃO
Grêmio estudantil, sala de aula, condomínio, igreja, empresa ou brincadeira em família: crie uma eleição do zero, com os cargos e candidatos que quiser, inclusive com foto. Proteja com senha, encerre a votação quando decidir e reabra se precisar. A apuração simulada mostra os votos entrando aos poucos, como na noite da eleição de verdade. Com a Eleição Compartilhada, você publica a eleição e convida família, amigos e colegas para votar pelo link.
FAVORITOS E CURIOSIDADES
Salve os candidatos que está acompanhando e descubra fatos e números curiosos sobre as eleições brasileiras.
Feito para eleitores, professores, estudantes e mesários que querem entender o processo eleitoral na prática. Simule, compare e vote com consciência.
Isenção de responsabilidade
O aplicativo "Urna - Simulador Eleições 2026" não tem qualquer afiliação com o Governo Brasileiro, com o Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) ou com qualquer entidade governamental. As informações apresentadas sobre os candidatos são baseadas em fontes públicas e confiáveis, mas não representam dados oficiais do governo. Este é um aplicativo educacional: o voto feito aqui não tem validade oficial.
Fontes dos dados:
https://divulgacandcontas.tse.jus.br/divulga
https://www.tse.jus.br/eleicoes/resultados-eleicoes
https://dadosabertos.camara.leg.br
https://www12.senado.leg.br/dados-abertos
Termos de uso da Apple para compras dentro do app:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00087274:ios.name: FC Schalke 04
bluejetty:00087274:ios.summary:
Glück auf!
With the official S04 app, you're always right at the heart of everything Royal Blue. All the news, matches and highlights – straight from the source.
Shape your personal app experience around your own interests: as part of the
bluejetty:00087274:ios.description:
Glück auf!
With the official S04 app, you're always right at the heart of everything Royal Blue. All the news, matches and highlights – straight from the source.
Shape your personal app experience around your own interests: as part of the club family, you can customize your home feed and discover exclusive news and advance information in the "Vereinsheim" (members' area). There you'll also find your newly designed digital membership card, which prominently displays how long you've been part of the club family, plus a handy service area where you can quickly and easily manage your personal data yourself. Surveys, votes and prediction games add extra variety.
Even if you're not a member (yet), the app offers you plenty of highlights: with its many features, it's the central digital companion for all Schalke fans. Look forward to quick access to the latest news from the Schalker Markt, story formats, an extensive match center with exclusive statistics, a detailed live ticker and audio commentary for all competitive matches of the first team, as well as squad overviews of the professionals, the women's team and the Knappenschmiede youth academy teams (U23 and U19).
Users with access to S04TV+ can watch the full re-live, in-depth highlights and exclusive post-match interviews shortly after every competitive first-team match. On top of that, there are numerous other exciting formats as well as regular livestreams of Knappenschmiede matches and the Schalke women's Regionalliga team. Members can watch some videos free of charge; full access (including licensed match footage) requires a subscription, available as an annual plan from as little as €2.66 per month.
At home matches, you can optionally activate Stadium Mode. This feature gives fans all the relevant tips and services for their stadium visit compactly at a glance – for example, real-time information on parking availability around the VELTINS-Arena, the ride-sharing board and the kiosk overview, plus direct access to the popular S04 Arena Quiz. Logged-in users also have access to their mobile home-match tickets and can top up their Knappenkarte directly in the app.
All content is designed to be accessible: you can adjust the font size to suit you or have content read aloud using the text-to-speech function.
We look forward to your feedback: digital@schalke04.de

bluejetty:00131532:ios.description:
From WebMD, the one healthcare app you need to check symptoms, set medication reminders, learn about conditions and drugs, research treatments and diagnoses, find doctors and specialists in your area, and save on prescriptions at your local pharmacy.
Key Features: 
• Symptom Checker – Choose your symptoms, learn about potential conditions or issues, and lookup treatment and care options.
• Medication Reminders – Never miss a dose. You’ll receive reminders when it’s time to take your medications. View daily prescription schedules and instructions, plus pill images with dosage and timing information for each drug. Reminders sync to your other mobile devices when you sign-in with your WebMD account.
• WebMD Rx – We partner with major pharmacy chains to find the lowest prescription drug prices, which often beat insurance co-pays. It’s 100% free to use. No registration required.
• Doctor Directory – Find the closest doctors and specialists based on your current location or search by city, state or zip. 
• Conditions – Find medically-reviewed information about conditions relevant to you and learn more about causes, treatments, and related symptoms. 
• Customization and Saving Functionality – Save your conditions, drugs, doctors, hospitals, pharmacies, and healthy living articles for secure, easy access and reference. 
• Drug Interaction Checker – Find and identify potentially harmful and unsafe combinations of prescription medications by entering two or more drugs in question.
If you are a California resident, California law may provide you with certain rights regarding our use of your personal information. For more information relevant to our users who are California residents, please review the "California Residents" section of our Privacy Policy linked on this download page or within our app.

WebMD Health Corp. (Nasdaq: WBMD) is the leading provider of health information services, serving consumers, physicians, healthcare professionals, employers, and health plans through our public and private online portals, mobile platforms and health-focused publications. More than 95 million unique visitors access the WebMD Health Network each month.
The WebMD Health Network includes WebMD Health, Medscape, MedicineNet, emedicineHealth, RxList, theheart.org, drugs.com and Medscape Education.
SOURCE WebMD Health Corp.
WebMD. Better Information. Better Health.
WebMD does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Always seek the advice of your physician or other qualified health provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition. Never disregard professional medical advice or delay in seeking it because of something you have read on the WebMD mobile application.
*Prescription savings vary by prescription and by pharmacy, and may reach up to 80% off cash price.

We are pleased to offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free Comox Taxi ride application.
Key Features of the Comox Taxi application include:
• Book a trip in as few as 2 clicks
• Monitor the progress of your vehicle on a map
• Create a list of favourite addresses and assign a custom name for each
• Review all reservations you have made over the past 30 days
• Provide feedback related to the application and/or service you received

• Download the free app
• Enter your phone number
• Validate your account (via the notification code you receive)

The Comox Taxi application retains a history of your previous reservations for expense management and to quickly rebook the same trip with the push of a button. You may also create a list of favourite locations (Home, Work, etc.) to speed the booking process.
Let us know how we can serve you better by providing feedback via the Comox Taxi application or calling us at +1 250-339-7955

bluejetty:00180154:ios.description:
Scam Shield gives you control over T-Mobile’s anti-scam protections like Scam ID, Scam Block, and Caller ID, and is available to all our customers.
- What is Scam Shield? -
ADVANCED NETWORK TECHNOLOGY
Our supercharged network analyzes every call using A.I., machine learning, and patented technologies. Our defenses update every six minutes to stay ahead of scammers.
BUILT-IN PROTECTION
Americans deal with billions of scam and robo calls every year. Our Scam ID and Scam Block technologies help identify and stop them before they ever reach your phone.
KNOW WHO'S CALLING
Now you'll see a caller's information, even if they're not in your contact list. With Scam Shield, full Caller ID access is automatically included, enable it.
- Included features -
• Scam Block – Our network will automatically block calls from likely scammers, when you turn it on, helping to keep them off your phone entirely.
• Scam Reporting – Help identify suspicious callers or fraudsters and prevent their calls from being received by you—or others—in the future.
• Caller ID – See who’s calling before you answer.
• Allow list – Calls from numbers on your Allow list will never be blocked by our network and always ring your phone.
- Premium features -
• Personal Number Blocking – Block specific numbers from calling you as soon as they hit the T-Mobile network.
• Category Manager – Tired of telemarketers? Or survey calls? We’ll identify and block call types you don’t want to see anymore.
• Reverse Number Lookup – Not sure who a number belongs to? We’ll do a reverse phone number lookup and show you anything we can about who is calling.
• Voicemail to Text - Get text messages containing readouts of blocked calls that were sent to voicemail.
---
Qualifying service & capable device required. Turning on Scam Block might block calls you want; disable any time.
For help and support, please contact callprotectionops@t-mobile.com.

bluejetty:00081639:ios.name: Offline Games - No WiFi Arcade
bluejetty:00081639:ios.summary: Offline Games - No Wifi Arcade is your ultimate collection of fun, addictive games that you can enjoy anywhere, anytime—no internet required! Perfect for quick breaks or long journeys, this arcade brings together 10 classic and modern games
bluejetty:00081639:ios.description:
Offline Games - No Wifi Arcade is your ultimate collection of fun, addictive games that you can enjoy anywhere, anytime—no internet required! Perfect for quick breaks or long journeys, this arcade brings together 10 classic and modern games that cater to all tastes. Whether you love strategy, action, or just some good old-fashioned fun, you'll find a game to dive into.
Game Highlights:
- Blade Toss: Test your precision and timing as you throw blades at targets. Hit the bullseye to score big!
- Snake: Guide your snake around the board, eating apples to grow longer. But watch out—don't crash into yourself!
- Bubble Aim: Match and pop colorful bubbles in this classic arcade challenge. Clear the screen to level up!
- Color Match: Sharpen your color recognition skills by matching blocks to the correct color as fast as you can.
- Hangman: Guess the word before your stickman is fully drawn. A great way to challenge your vocabulary and quick thinking.
- Word Puzzle: Unscramble the letters to form words. Perfect for puzzle lovers who enjoy a challenge.
- Tic-Tac-Toe: The classic Xs and Os game, now available to play against the computer or a friend.
- Air Hockey: Fast-paced and thrilling, challenge the computer or a friend in this table-top arcade favorite.
- Four Align: Get four in a row before your opponent does in this strategic connect-four game.
- Dice Dash: Roll the dice and race around the board in this exciting, luck-based game. Who will reach the finish line first?
Features:
- No WiFi Required: Enjoy all games offline—no internet needed!
- Quick & Fun: Games are designed for fast, exciting play.
- Simple Controls: Easy to learn but challenging to master.
- Colorful Graphics: Vibrant and engaging visuals for every game.
- Multiplayer Options: Play with friends or challenge the computer.
Whether you're looking to kill time, sharpen your skills, or just have fun, Offline Games - No Wifi Arcade has something for everyone.

- Check the goal card
- Swipe to move your hole across the board to eat tiles
- Swallow all goal tiles before time runs out
- Grow bigger - watch it collapse

bluejetty:00069014:ios.description:
Loterias Brasil mostra os resultados das loterias da Caixa de forma rápida e clara — no iPhone e no iPad, com modo claro e escuro.
Consulte dezenas, premiações, ganhadores, valor estimado do próximo concurso e prêmios acumulados. Volte a qualquer concurso anterior e compartilhe o resultado.
Loterias disponíveis:
• Mega-Sena
• Quina
• Lotofácil
• Lotomania
• Dupla Sena
• Timemania
• Dia de Sorte
• Super Sete
• Mais Milionária
• Federal
O que você pode fazer
• Ver os últimos sorteios na tela inicial, com o próximo jogo do dia em destaque
• Abrir o detalhe de cada concurso, navegar pelo histórico e compartilhar o card
• Ordenar ou ocultar loterias para deixar a home do seu jeito
• Receber um aviso quando o resultado das loterias que você escolheu for atualizado
• Marcar dezenas no card para conferir de relance
Meus Jogos (compra única)
Guarde suas apostas no aparelho e deixe o app conferir acertos e prêmios depois de cada sorteio — sem anotar dezenas no papel.
• Apostas simples, múltiplas, Teimosinha e jogos recorrentes
• Surpresinha: o app preenche um jogo válido na hora
• Mais Milionária (trevos), Timemania (Time do Coração) e Dia de Sorte (Mês da Sorte)
• Super Sete por colunas
• Saldo de investido, prêmio e lucro/prejuízo por concurso
• Seus jogos antigos no app são migrados automaticamente
A compra é única, sem assinatura. Restaure em qualquer iPhone com a mesma conta Apple.
Atenção
O Loterias Brasil é um aplicativo independente, só para consulta e conferência. Não somos a Caixa Econômica Federal e não temos vínculo oficial com as Loterias Caixa.

listings.name: Loterias Brasil
listings.description:
Loterias Brasil mostra os resultados das loterias da Caixa de forma rápida e clara — no iPhone e no iPad, com modo claro e escuro.

Consulte dezenas, premiações, ganhadores, valor estimado do próximo concurso e prêmios acumulados. Volte a qualquer concurso anterior e compartilhe o resultado.

Loterias disponíveis:
• Mega-Sena
• Quina
• Lotofácil
• Lotomania
• Dupla Sena
• Timemania
• Dia de Sorte
• Super Sete
• Mais Milionária
• Federal

O que você pode fazer
• Ver os últimos sorteios na tela inicial, com o próximo jogo do dia em destaque
• Abrir o detalhe de cada concurso, navegar pelo histórico e compartilhar o card
• Ordenar ou ocultar loterias para deixar a home do seu jeito
• Receber um aviso quando o resultado das loterias que você escolheu for atualizado
• Marcar dezenas no card para conferir de relance

Meus Jogos (compra única)
Guarde suas apostas no aparelho e deixe o app conferir acertos e prêmios depois de cada sorteio — sem anotar dezenas no papel.

• Apostas simples, múltiplas, Teimosinha e jogos recorrentes
• Surpresinha: o app preenche um jogo válido na hora
• Mais Milionária (trevos), Timemania (Time do Coração) e Dia de Sorte (Mês da Sorte)
• Super Sete por colunas
• Saldo de investido, prêmio e lucro/prejuízo por concurso
• Seus jogos antigos no app são migrados automaticamente

A compra é única, sem assinatura. Restaure em qualquer iPhone com a mesma conta Apple.

bluejetty:00128856:ios.summary: Welcome to Sponge Art, a puzzle game that will revolutionize your understanding of shapes and puzzles! This puzzle game immerses you in a unique world of creativity and entertainment, where each sponge can morph into any shape with a variet
bluejetty:00128856:ios.description:
Welcome to Sponge Art, a puzzle game that will revolutionize your understanding of shapes and puzzles! This puzzle game immerses you in a unique world of creativity and entertainment, where each sponge can morph into any shape with a variety of colorful rubber bands.
The rules of this fun puzzle game are simple: use rubber bands to mold the sponge into the image displayed on the screen. But this is not a simple puzzle - each image is unique and requires a distinctive approach. Where exactly should you tap to get the rubber band to create the right shape? This fun puzzle will challenge your logic and creativity at every stage.
This puzzle game is a creative playground where every tap on your screen turns an ordinary sponge into an amazing piece of art. Each tap is a step toward creating a unique shape, making the puzzle more intriguing.
There are many levels in this puzzle game. Each level presents a new shape for the sponge. It could be an amusing animal, an interesting object, or simply a beautiful pattern. To master this puzzle, you must determine where to tap the screen. The tasks start off as simple shapes, but they gradually become more complex, adding more fun to the puzzle game.
Sponge Art is a casual game suitable for all ages! It's a perfect game for those who want something more than a traditional casual game. This puzzle game not only entertains but also stimulates and inspires creativity.
So, don't wait, immerse yourself in this puzzle game right now! Every tap brings you closer to a new shape, and each level unlocks a new world of sponge art with rubber bands. Download Sponge Art today, and watch as a simple sponge transforms into extraordinary shapes under your guidance!

Welcome to the transformative experience of The Triple Flame: a powerful pausing technique that involves pausing for 3 minutes every 3 hours, alongside many people spread across the globe. Contemplate with others, and deepen your joy into the silence and beauty that we often miss in our busy lives.

· Track your pauses over time, privately and offline + export function
· Journeys: Got more than 20 minutes on your hands? Explore our incredible audio journeys ranging from Essential Meditations to Ecstatic Contemplations.
· Deepen your practise with enriching resources by author and mystic Richard Rudd, founder of the Gene Keys.
· Synchronicity Abounds: get inspired with daily contemplative quotes.
· Practise Schedule: Customise your perfect Triple Flame practise schedule, and get gently notified to take time to pause.
· Track your pause journey - cosily and privately.
· Dark Mode
The Triple Flame App is the perfect pause app for beginners and returning voyagers alike.

bluejetty:00186612:ios.description:
Make screen time active with 300+ dance videos, yoga exercises, and mindfulness activities for kids!
Trusted by teachers & used in 4 out of 5 US public elementary schools, GoNoodle videos create more than 667 million movement minutes each month in homes and schools. Download the free app (no subscription or login required) to play your kid’s favorite videos from school, at home!
- Educational videos by Blazer Fresh - Banana Banana Meatball, Celebrate, and Don’t Read Like A Robot
- Camp sing alongs by Moose Tube - Baby Shark, Peanut Butter in a Cup, and Boom Chicka Boom
- Call and response - Pop See Ko and Milkshake
- Pop songs and throwbacks - Dynamite, JUMP, Larger Than Life, and Bye Bye Bye
- And so much more!
NEW EVERY WEEK
You’ll always find new videos to entertain and engage your kids. Easily browse and play videos at home, on the road, or anywhere with a 3G or WiFi connection.
TYPES OF VIDEOS ON GONOODLE
-Dance
-Sports
-Exercise
-How-tos
-Yoga
-Stretching
-Deep breathing
-Mindfulness
KID SAFE & EASY TO USE
Everything is designed especially for kids (age 4-10). The GoNoodle App only includes content approved by GoNoodle’s team of child development experts and there are no in-app purchases. You can trust your kids are safe with GoNoodle. It’s a safe alternative to open platforms. 
QUALITY KIDS CONTENT
GoNoodle was developed by a team of seasoned designers, educators, child development specialists, and researchers. All GoNoodle videos are created by our team of child development experts working with choreographers, athletes and mindfulness experts who specialize in kid content.

**GoNoodle on-the-go** Dance in the carpool line, while waiting for dinner, or hanging at a sibling’s soccer game. GoNoodle brings more movement into your everyday places, spaces, and routines.
TEACHERS AND PARENTS LOVE GONOODLE
“GoNoodle brings such joy to our home. I love to watch my kids just be themselves and have fun while getting fit. Best invention for families!” - Melissa, mother of four
"GoNoodle Kids is the ‘Go To’ app for kids if you’d like to get them moving! This app is a Teacher Favorite, used in schools regularly. Best of all, it’s free and fantastic!" - BestAppsforKids.org
“GoNoodle is the most engaging, fun student program I have found, ever.” - Mr. McDonald, Kindergarten Teacher
“Where do I start with what I love most about GoNoodle? When my kids (or me!) need to have fun and move, there is always something awesome to do on GoNoodle.” - Ms. Lynch, 3rd Grade Teacher

Dive into stock research and catch market
bluejetty:00135183:ios.description:
Discover the Koyfin IOS app, part of the all-in-one platform for financial data and analytics, trusted by over half a million investors and rated 9.5 out of 10 for its value in the Kitces Report. 
Dive into stock research and catch market trends instantly with live & historical data, the latest news, and tools like customizable charts, watchlists, and stock alerts. Koyfin offers detailed tracking of various assets including equities, ETFs, indices, and more, ensuring your portfolio leads in opportunity.
Koyfin syncs across mobile and the web, keeping your data—from market research to portfolio management—synchronized and accessible anytime, anywhere.
Complete Data Coverage
Gain access to high-quality data, a user-friendly platform, and top trending financial news. A combination of live and delayed data with the global markets coverage for a wide array of assets — equities, ETFs, mutual funds, indices, bonds, forex, futures, and global economics. 
Quickly grasp the whole picture of the stock market by analyzing prices, key financials, consensus estimates, dividends, and valuation ratios for all global stocks.
Custom Watchlists
Tailor watchlists with a diverse range of metrics, including price, performance, valuation, estimates, financials, and growth, to enhance your portfolio management and investment tracking experience.
Alerts & Notifications
Never miss an opportunity with our alert system. Set up price alerts for specific market movements and stay ahead with instant notifications for press releases on equities and watchlists.
Market News
Stay informed with Koyfin’s enriched news section, featuring real-time press releases, articles, news, and transcripts tailored to your interests. Read market news sourced from the biggest media, including Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC, and others. Our Reuters news coverage, divided by thematic sections, gives you a real-time edge on what's moving stocks, sectors, and markets. Transform information into power.
Market Movers
Uncover the hottest stocks trading today on the markets from the major indices or your custom watchlists. Monitor daily stocks with the biggest daily gains, losses, and volume breakouts above their 10-day average in real-time all on one screen.
Snapshots
Gain the big financial picture with one tap on the phone. Identify market trends that can have a significant impact on investments, large and small.
Financial Charts
Unlock insight with our brilliant graphing tools that let you visualize stock performance. Analyze historical price charts to identify trends and spot investment opportunities. See performance charts to highlight the actual rate of return over any period. 
Earnings Estimates & Price Target
Keep an eye on earnings estimates and determine what the stock is worth and where the price will be to pinpoint your potential investment opportunities.
Custom Themes
Just make it yours. Choose from the carefully designed Koyfin color themes to make the app interface pleasant to your eye.
Free on mobile
Koyfin app is absolutely free to download — unlock insights, no matter your budget!
Please check https://www.koyfin.com/pricing/ for more details.

bluejetty:00151786:ios.description:
Welcome to Happy Screw Merge, a uniquely satisfying puzzle game that blends the fun of merging with the challenge of screw sorting—plus a dash of creative decoration! Step into your very own workshop, where every screw you merge and every nut you sort brings you closer to designing the ultimate creative space.
Core Gameplay: Merge + Screw Sorting
Merge & Upgrade: Combine identical screws, bolts, and nuts to create advanced tools—from simple wrenches to powerful electric drills! 
Sorting Puzzles: Arrange colorful screws in the right order, clear the toolboxes, and solve relaxing yet brain-teasing levels.
Decorate Your Workshop: Earn decor tokens and furniture blueprints with each completed level—design a space that’s truly yours!
Mini-Games Break: Enjoy quick challenges like “Speed Screw Matching” and “Nut Memory Game” to earn rare items and boosts.
Easy to Learn, Hard to Put Down
There’s no time pressure—play at your own pace and plan each merge and sort carefully. As you progress, puzzles grow more complex, offering a perfect mix of strategy and satisfaction.
Express Your Style
Choose from industrial, modern, vintage, or tech-themed decor
Show off your merged tools as wall art or functional furniture
Unlock full decoration sets and special animated items
Features You’ll Love
Handy Boosters: Use the “Multi-Wrench,” “Color Shifter,” or “Magic Bolt” to tackle tricky levels
Loyal Pet Companion: A cute robot dog joins your journey—sometimes even fetching hidden screws!
Weekly Events: Compete in global leaderboards and win exclusive furniture
Play Offline: Enjoy the game anytime, anywhere, no Wi-Fi needed
Whether you're a merge fanatic, a puzzle solver, or a budding interior designer—Happy Screw Merge offers a perfect blend of creativity, strategy, and fun.
Download Now and Start Building!
Merge screws, sort nuts, and decorate your dream workshop—one level at a time.

MBLE
bluejetty:00028729:ios.description:
MBLEx Prep 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass the Massage and Bodywork Licensure Examination (MBLEx) administered by the Federation of State Massage Therapy Boards (FSMTB) with a high score on your first attempt! 
MBLEx Prep 2026 will not only help you gain insight into concepts related to MBLEx exam preparation, but will also help you increase your confidence in passing the exam on your first attempt by practicing hundreds of exam-like questions.
### Pass the exam on the first attempt ###
In MBLEx Prep 2026, there are a large number of questions prepared by exam experts covering the range of official test requirements. According to the test requirements, you must master several subjects in order to successfully pass theMBLEx exam.
Specifically, these subjects include:
- Anatomy & Physiology (11%)
- Kinesiology (12%)
- Pathology, Contraindications, Areas of Caution, Special Populations (14%)
- Benefits and Effects of Soft Tissue Manipulation (15%)
- Client Assessment, Reassessment & Treatment Planning (17%)
- Ethics, Boundaries, Laws, Regulations (16%)
- Guidelines for Professional Practice (15%)
To help you pass the exam, our test experts have carefully analyzed and broken down the above subjects. You will need to practice all 7 subjects, which will help you pass the exam with confidence!
### Key features ###
- Over 1600 practice questions, each with detailed answer explanations
- Specialized practice by content area, with the flexibility to switch between them at any time
- View an analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the MBLEx exam is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the exam. You will find that each time you practice on MBLEx Prep 2026, your knowledge of the exam increases, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions while hinting to yourself that you will do the same tomorrow. After you have developed good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high on not only the MBLEx exam, but on any other exam!
### Purchases, subscriptions and terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged according to the rate and term chosen for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - https://www.yesmaster.pro/Terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy - https://www.yesmaster.pro/Privacy-Policy/
If you have any questions or comments about your use, please email us at contact@yesmaster.pro and we will resolve them for you within 3 working days at the latest.

Family Locator lets you stay connected with your family members during the day. Family Locator ensures family safety, even when they're far away!

• Create your own groups in the app

• The family locator app lets you find your loved ones easily with augmented reality
• Keeps you on the family map even if you are busy
• Check-in to share your location with family

- Find family members faster with AR

Subscription prices may vary by location. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. • Location services, to inform family of your current location
• Notifications, to inform you of your family's location changes
• Contacts, to find other users to join your circle
• Photos and Camera, to change your profile picture
• App tracking, to show relevant ads
Please note, GPS location sharing is only possible upon mutual consent of all members. Privacy of your family is the top concern for us - share your location only with people you trust.
For more information on our Privacy Policy & Terms of Use, click:

Search for anyone's online presence from just a picture of their face.
FEATURES
- Identity Verification: Stay safe online by uploading a picture of someone's face and quickly finding their social media profiles, appearances in blogs, video and news websites.
- Never get catfished again: Upload a screenshot from a dating profile to check for fake dating profiles, romance scammers, or sex offenders.
- Better than reverse image search: Use any photo of someone's face, even if their face is partially covered or at an angle.
- Wide coverage: Over 1 billion faces indexed and counting.
REVIEWS
"Probably saved me hundreds of dollars and kept me from wasting time with a person who was trying to scam me by impersonating someone else. Highly recommend if you’re doing online dating."
- SculptorSteve
"I currently have long hair and a beard but the algorithm managed to find pictures of me online when I used to have short hair and no beard. This is crazy!"
- javi3r
"Dude this app works. Was at a concert last night and it identified this random girl that snuck into our selfies"
- zach
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
- Credits are required to search for someone's online presence. You can either purchase these via a subscription or in-app purchase. Each subscription tier gives you an amount of credits per week. Unused credits can expire. You can top these up using in-app purchases.
- Payment will be charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel your subscription here: https://support.apple.com/en-gb/118428
- Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- When purchasing a subscription, any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited.
DISCLAIMER
Facial Recognition uses a third party tool, FaceCheck.ID for AI image search. We are NOT responsible for indexed images or associated with FaceCheck.ID in any way. You must use the app responsibly and we will not tolerate users who misuse the app in violation of the terms and conditions. For free image takedown requests, please contact FaceCheck.ID directly: https://facecheck.id/Face-Search/RemoveMyPhotos
Privacy Policy: https://facialrecognition.app/privacy-policy/en
Terms & Conditions: https://facialrecognitio

bluejetty:00171426:ios.description:
May your dreams become reality in Sunday City.
Sunday City is an eternal summer simulator, where each day is like a weekend, and the city hums to the rhythm of your desires. You don't need to wait for a vacation here — ocean, sun, and neon city lights are always right there with you. Choose your lifestyle: calm and relaxed or full of drive and adventure. Experience that unparalleled vibe and become a success!
Reach the Top
Go on an unbelievable journey from a simple courier to a multimillionaire. Complete quests: work and get paid, partake in sports car racing, chat with your friends, and open businesses. Express yourself in any way possible, and then, all the roads to Sunday City will be open for you.
Start a Business
Open your first café, electronics or comic book shop. That way, you'll be earning profits and thus gradually getting closer and closer to the status of a successful entrepreneur, simultaneously starting new businesses and building your capital. But not everything is so serious here, so relax, you've still got beach parties to go to!
Time for Fun
In Sunday City, you can hang out in the chat, socialize, and find new friends. As well as enjoy endless parties, shop around, and switch skins to your mood. Riding on a scooter or driving a sports car, luxury brands and private parties or athletic style and yoga classes, beach volleyball, cozy nights with friends — it's all up to you. All this will become your reality, just take a step towards your dream!
Loyal Friends
Adopt and raise a true friend — a cute kitty, a sweet dog, or a funny capybara? These wonderful guys are meant to restore your peace of mind after a workday. They can accompany you on your evening walks along the beach, shopping sprees, or hangouts in cafés.
The city where morning always brings the smell of the ocean and sunsets paint the sky in soft gold — it was made for bold adventurers. Here, you can just relax, build your business empire, and go after your dreams, step by step.
Welcome to Sunday City!

bluejetty:00088047:ios.summary: This game is perfect for puzzle lovers and sandcastle builders. A Sandtris puzzle with a twist. You have to manipulate different shapes of sand blocks that fall from the top of the screen and arrange them in a way that they form complete ho
bluejetty:00088047:ios.description:
This game is perfect for puzzle lovers and sandcastle builders. A Sandtris puzzle with a twist. You have to manipulate different shapes of sand blocks that fall from the top of the screen and arrange them in a way that they form complete horizontal rows at the bottom of the screen. The more rows you clear, the more points you get and the higher your level goes. Rotate and move the blocks to fit them better in the available space, but don't let them stack up too high or touch the top of the screen or you'll lose. This game is fun, challenging and relaxing at the same time. It tests your spatial skills, your reflexes and your creativity. Try it out and see how many rows you can clear and how high you can score!
Sand Blocks is a Tetris like sand puzzle game that combines satisfactory sand simulation with a beautiful art style.

bluejetty:00032990:ios.name: Trek Accessories
bluejetty:00032990:ios.summary:
The Trek Accessories App adds additional functionality to the Trek CarBack Radar Rear Bike Light by giving cyclists advanced alerts and a real-time visual depiction of rear approaching detected vehicles.
Helps you see cars.
Use the Trek A
bluejetty:00032990:ios.description:
The Trek Accessories App adds additional functionality to the Trek CarBack Radar Rear Bike Light by giving cyclists advanced alerts and a real-time visual depiction of rear approaching detected vehicles.
Helps you see cars.
Use the Trek Accessories App to receive visual and audible alerts of detected rear approaching vehicles. The Trek Accessories App and Trek CarBack Radar can detect rear approaching vehicles from up to 240M, with vehicles first appearing with an audible beep and a visual indicator at the bottom of the App screen. Once the detected vehicle approaches to within 150M, the vehicle is shown on screen in real time. Once within 75M the Vehicles location is depicted in both distance behind and distance to either side, indicating preparation for a potential pass. Once the vehicle completes a pass, an audible alert indicates the pass and the vehicle drops off the screen.
Helps cars see you.
The Trek Accessories App also gives the ability to turn on a connected Trek CarBack Rear bike Light, all from the App screen. The CarBack Radar offers Daytime Running Light Performance that can be seen from up to 2km during the day to help a cyclist be more visible on the road.
Audible and Visual Alerts
You can choose the best way to receive alerts – Alerts will be shown visually on screen as well as an audio alert when a detected rear approaching vehicle is first detected, and again when it passes. You can choose to turn audible alerts on and off. This allows you to use the app the way you ride – either with a phone mounted on your bike’s handlebars, or stowed in a jersey pocket.
*Please note that the Trek Accessories App currently only works with Trek CarBack Radar Rear Bike Lights.
Learn more about Trek CarBack Radar Rear Bike light here - https://www.trekbikes.com/us/en_US/carback/
Find Trek Accessories App FAQs here - https://www.trekbikes.com/us/en_US/FAQ/trek-carback-radar-rear-bike-light/
Having trouble? Contact our support team for assistance at RiderSupport@Trekbikes.com

BloodPressure Level Checker is your smart partner for effortlessly managing blood pressure, heart rate, blood glucose, and blood oxygen levels. Track your vital signs daily with precision, visualize trends through intuitive charts, and receive expert health insights – all designed to empower you to take control of your cardiovascular and metabolic wellness.

1. Accurate Blood Pressure Tracking: Log and monitor your BP in real time.
2. Automatic Heart Rate Monitoring: Record pulse trends with clear visuals.
3. Blood Sugar Logging: Track glucose levels to support metabolic health management. (New)
4. Blood Oxygen (SpO₂) Tracking: Monitor oxygen saturation for respiratory wellness insights. (New)
***Expert Health Tips: Get personalized, professional advice for cardiovascular and overall health.
Insightful Data Visualization: Interactive charts reveal trends across all your vital metrics.
Stay proactive. Stay informed. Stay healthy — with BloodPressure Level Checker.
***Important Notice:
Recording Functionality Only: This app records and tracks blood pressure, heart rate, blood glucose, and blood oxygen (SpO₂) data. It does NOT measure these metrics directly.
Reference Purpose: Heart rate, blood glucose, and SpO₂ data are for informational use only. Always use FDA/CE-certified medical devices for diagnostic measurements.
Content Disclaimer: Health information regarding BP, glucose, SpO₂, or related topics is sourced from public resources. Consult healthcare professionals for medical advice.
Independent Development: All app activities/content are organized solely by the developer and are not affiliated with Apple Inc.

bluejetty:00071228:ios.summary:

The ultimate Vacuum Control app is now available with all required features to control your Cleaning Robot at ease with only a smartphone needed. Now you can spend no effo
bluejetty:00071228:ios.description:
LESS Housework, MORE Relaxing Time with "Vacuum Robot Control" app.
The ultimate Vacuum Control app is now available with all required features to control your Cleaning Robot at ease with only a smartphone needed. Now you can spend no effort to create & schedule jobs, keep track of the robot via the live map, review job history & other custom settings exclusively for your Robot. An all-in-one Robot Control app that makes your daily housework much more convenient & easier. 
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with either iRobot Corporation or any robot vacuum-related platforms.
CONTROL & SCHEDULE
With just a tap, you can freely start the job, pause, resume & send the robot back to the Home base without using a physical remote or touching directly the robot. More conveniently, you can schedule the jobs beforehand at your favorite times of the day, for example at night or at the weekend at noon. It is super easy to edit, reschedule, on/off the jobs whenever you want. 
LIVE MAP TRACKING
Want to know where your robot is cleaning but you're too lazy to walk around the house to find him? Don't worry, our LIVE MAP will help you to do that within seconds while you're still laying on the couch! By looking at the live map, you can freely check the live position & movement of the robot, as well as giving you a bird's-eye view of your room. When seeing the robot is getting stuck at one position for too long, you can just simply press the "Music note" to activate the robot's sound for fast location investigation. After the job has been done, the complete live map will be saved in the History section. 
JOB HISTORY REVIEW
You can see the summary of all the jobs done by the robot such as the recap of the complete map, start and end time (in case you use our app to start and end the job), total time spent and battery consumption for each job. You can organize the job history list, delete the old ones based on your preference. 
OTHER SETTINGS
You can set up your favorite language, cleaning frequencies & bin full behavior in the Settings section. The Privacy Policy & Your Purchased Subscriptions can also be found here. If you like our app, you can rate us directly on AppStore and give us some suggested ideas for the latest updates. If you need any support, you can contact us via email with a brief summary of your issue and we will try our best to support you. 
CONNECTION INSTRUCTION
You just need to set up your Robot for the first time, and the Robot will automatically connect to the app whenever you open it. The setup details will be shown step-by-step inside the app. Please make sure that the Robot is fully charged and is connected to the same WiFi as your smartphone. 
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with either iRobot Corporation or any robot vacuum-related platforms.
• Subscribed user has unlimited access 
• Unsubscribed user can only use free features
• User can subscribe for one week (USD $3.99), one month (USD $9.99), or a lifetime ($19.99) auto-renewing subscription.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use: http://smartwidgetlabs.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: http://smartwidgetlabs.com/privacy-policy/
You are welcome to contact us at support@smartwidgetlabs.com

For over 25 years, we've walked with more than 1.7 million people on their victory journey to overcome lust and temptation.

Victory by Covenant Eyes helps you find freedom through transparency, stop using explicit content, and reclaim your life. Victory offers free features to help anyone get started and powerful screen accountability tools exclusively for subscribers. 
ABOUT THE VICTORY APP
The Victory App is the home base for free and paid users of Victory by Covenant Eyes. Get access to:
— Commitments and Daily Check-ins: Keep yourself on track and focused on your goals with daily commitments and check-ins. 
— Learning + Mini-courses: Increase awareness of your triggers and the path toward healing with counselor-reviewed mini-courses for men, women, spouses, allies, parents, and pastors. 
— Community Connection: The Community feature connects you to a supportive community where you can interact with like-minded individuals on your journey. Share your journey, offer prayers, and encourage others. 
UNLOCK THE FULL POWER OF VICTORY 
Paid subscribers get access to the Victory Shield™ utility app, which enables: 
— Content Blocking: Configure settings to change what content is accessible on devices protected by the Victory Shield app. 
— Screen Accountability: True freedom comes through transparency. Share your device activity with an ally of your choosing who can help keep you on track and encourage you toward your goals. 
— Activity Feed: Stay accountable with device usage tracking, accountability prompts, conversation guides, and more. 
FOR ALLIES HELPING A FRIEND OR LOVED ONE QUIT 
— Thanks for supporting your friend as they journey to live free from explicit content! If you haven't already accepted an Ally invitation from your friend, ask them to send you one. The invitation lets you create your Ally username and password to access the Victory App.
ABOUT US
Covenant Eyes is the maker of Victory and Victory Shield and is the pioneer in accountability software. Since 2000, we've dedicated ourselves to helping people on their journey to stop watching explicit content or never start. 
Learn more about how Covenant Eyes helps save relationships and transform lives at https://www.covenanteyes.com.

sahibinden.com is an online shopping and classifieds platform where you can post advertisements and conduct e-commerce transactions in many categories, such as apartments for sale and rent, new and used cars, shopping items, job listings, craftsmen and services, construction machinery, and spare parts.
In the Real Estate & Housing category:
• You can access numerous listings including detached houses, residences, summer homes, tourist facilities, houses for sale, commercial properties for rent, and daily rental apartments.
• You can choose options such as credit-eligible properties, purchases through banks, real estate agencies, construction companies, or directly from the owner.
• With the sahibinden.com app, which supports you in your search for houses, land, and commercial properties, you can access all listings for sale and rent-whether new or second-hand-and explore the latest projects.
• For listings that include virtual tours, you can navigate through the rooms within a property; and for listings with video clips, you can watch the listing’s visuals in video format.
In the Vehicles category:
• You can filter through thousands of up-to-date vehicle listings by your preferred criteria, making it easy to find exactly what you are looking for. You can easily use Türkiye’s largest classifieds platform, sahibinden.com, with dozens of categories such as automobiles, off-road vehicles, motorcycles, minivans, and marine vehicles.
• You can browse listings of new or used cars, SUVs, commercial vehicles, and motorcycles from brands like Mercedes, BMW, Volkswagen, Ford, and Renault—published by individual sellers and auto dealers—add vehicles of interest to your favorites, and easily contact the owners.
In the Shopping category:
• You can purchase all kinds of new and used items - from clothing and accessories to electronics, home decor, garden supplies, and building materials—using the Param Güvende Service, face-to-face or via cargo delivery. You can also turn your unused products into earnings by selling them through the Param Güvende Service.
What is Yepy?
Yepy is an eco-friendly platform where you can purchase certified, guaranteed refurbished tech devices at affordable prices, with installment options and with the assurance of sahibinden.com. You can also easily sell your used devices at a good price. Simply go to Yepy in the sahibinden.com app, explore, and easily buy the refurbished phone models you want.
With the iOS app;
- You can post, edit, and publish listings,
- You can view listings and call the listing owner with a single click,
- You can find nearby real estate listings with the “Search Nearby” feature,
- You can make your searches easier and faster using the suggestion feature,
- You can add listings, sellers, or searches you like to your favorites,
- You can share listings that you like or find interesting with your friends on social networks.
- With the Param Güvende, you can purchase both second-hand and new products on credit installments,
Thousands of listings in categories such as real estate, automobiles, shopping, and hundreds of other categories are available in this app!

fdroid:lu.knaff.alain.son_of_hacker.name: Son of Hacker's Keyboard
fdroid:lu.knaff.alain.son_of_hacker.summary: Son of Hacker's Keyboard: a PC style keyboard and the ideal companion for Termux
fdroid:lu.knaff.alain.son_of_hacker.description:
Son of Hacker's Keyboard is a PC style keyboard and the ideal companion for Termux
Are you missing the key layout you're used to from your computer when using an Android device? This software keyboard has separate number keys, punctuation in the usual places, and arrow keys. It is based on the AOSP Gingerbread soft keyboard, so it supports multitouch for the modifier keys.
This keyboard is especially useful if you use Termux and/or SSH access. It provides working Tab/Ctrl/Esc keys, and the arrow keys are convenient for command line editing or text mode editors.
The supported keyboard layouts include Armenian (Հայերեն), Arabic (العربية), British (en_GB), Bulgarian (български език), Czech (Čeština), Danish (dansk), Carpalx English (language "en-CX"), Dvorak English (language "en-DV"), English (QWERTY), Finnish (Suomi), French (Français, AZERTY), German (Deutsch, QWERTZ), German Neo2 (Deutsch, language "de-NE"), Greek (ελληνικά), Hebrew (עברית), Hungarian (Magyar), Italian (Italiano), Lao (ພາສາລາວ), Norwegian (Norsk bokmål), Persian (فارسی), Portuguese (Português), Romanian (Română), Russian (Русский), Russian phonetic (Русский, ru-rPH), Serbian (Српски), Slovak (Slovenčina), Slovenian (Slovenščina)/Bosnian/Croatian/Latin Serbian, Spanish (Español, Español Latinoamérica), Swedish (Svenska), Tamil (தமிழ்), Thai (ไทย), Turkish (Türkçe), and Ukrainian (українська мова).
To install, get Son-of-Hacker's Keyboard from F-Droid or directly from Github from the project's releases tab.
Son-of-Hacker's Keyboard is compatible with AnySoftKeyboard's dictionaries. Search for them on F-Droid. AnySoftKeyboard currently supplies no English dictionary, presumably because it is now builtin. However, an unofficial version can be found on apkpure: 
https://apkpure.com/english-for-anysoftkeyboard/com.anysoftkeyboard.languagepack.mirfatif.english
This is a fork of the original hacker's keyboard by Klaus Weidner. The original had fallen behind on evolution Android evolution, and was not even compilable any more in today's environments. I took it upon myself to bring it up to Sdk 37 level (Android 17), and, with Klaus' approval changed the name to put into F-Droid.
If you had already my fork with the original name, I have provided buttons to export settings of the old version, and import them into the new version.
